Đổi cận: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=-2\Rightarrow u=5 \\ x=\frac{1}{2}\Rightarrow u=0 \end{array} \right.$.
$\Rightarrow I_{1}=\frac{-1}{2}\int\limits_{5}^{0} f\left( u \right)\,\text{du}=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{5} f\left( u \right)\,\text{du}=\frac{5}{2}$
Tính $I_{2}=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2} f\left( 2x-1 \right)\text{d}x$. Đặt $t=2x-1\Rightarrow\text{dt}=2\,\text{d}x\Rightarrow dx=\frac{1}{2}dt$.
Đổi cận: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=2\Rightarrow t=3 \\ x=\frac{1}{2}\Rightarrow t=0 \end{array} \right.$.
$\Rightarrow I_{2}=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( u \right)\text{du}=-\frac{1}{2}$
Vậy $I=I_{1}+I_{2}=\frac{5}{2}-\frac{1}{2}=2$.

noi_dung: Biết $I=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{d}x}{e^{x}+2e^{-x}-3}=3\ln a-\ln b$ với $a$, $b\ $ là các số nguyên dương. Tính $P=ab.$
loi_giai:
$I=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{d}x}{e^{x}+2e^{-x}-3}=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x}{e^{2x}+2-3e^{x}}$
Đặt $t=e^{x}\Rightarrow dt=e^{x}dx$
Đổi cận:
$\begin{array}{l} x=\ln 3\rightarrow t=3 \\ x=\ln 6\rightarrow t=6 \end{array}$
$I=\int\limits_{3}^{6} \frac{1}{t^{2}-3t+2}dt=\int\limits_{3}^{6} \frac{1}{\left( t-2 \right)\left( t-1 \right)}dt=\int\limits_{3}^{6} \left( \frac{1}{t-2}-\frac{1}{t-1} \right)dt=\left. \ln\left| t-2 \right| \right|_{3}^{6}-\left. \ln\left| t-1 \right| \right|_{3}^{6}$
$=3\ln 2-\ln 5$
Vậy $P=a.b=2.5=10$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)=2x-3,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị của $I=\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)=2x-3\Leftrightarrow\left( 3x^{2}+3 \right)f\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)=\left( 3x^{2}+3 \right)\left( 2x-3 \right),\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow\int\limits_{-1}^{0} \left( 3x^{2}+3 \right)f\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)dx\,=\int\limits_{-1}^{0} \left( 3x^{2}+3 \right)\left( 2x-3 \right)dx \\ \Rightarrow\int\limits_{-1}^{0} f\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)d\left( x^{3}+3x+1 \right)\,=-\frac{33}{2} \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{33}{2}. \end{array}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$, thoả mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-5$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=10$. Giá trị của $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 3x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
$\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=10\Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}\left( \text{2}x \right)=10$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}\left( \text{2}x \right)=20\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=20$.
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 3x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{6} f\left( 3x \right)\text{d}\left( \text{3}x \right)=\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{6} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$=\frac{1}{3}\left[ \int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x \right]=\frac{1}{3}\left( -5+20 \right)=5$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{4} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=3$, $\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{5}{2}$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 4x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Xét tích phâm $J=\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{5}{2}$, đặt $t=2x\Rightarrow\text{d}t=2\text{d}x$, $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=2\Rightarrow t=4 \\ x=6\Rightarrow t=12 \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra: $\frac{5}{2}=\int\limits_{2}^{6} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{4}^{12} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t\Rightarrow\int\limits_{4}^{12} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=5$ hay $\int\limits_{4}^{12} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=5$.
Xét tích phâm $I=\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( 4x \right)\text{d}x$, đặt $t=4x\Rightarrow\text{d}t=4\text{d}x$, $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=0\Rightarrow t=0 \\ x=3\Rightarrow t=12 \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra: $I=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{12} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{4}\left( \int\limits_{0}^{4} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t+\int\limits_{4}^{12} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t \right)$$=\frac{1}{4}\left( 3+5 \right)=2$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1;4 \right]$ và thoả mãn $f\left( x \right)=\frac{f\left( 2\sqrt{x}-1 \right)}{\sqrt{x}}+\frac{\ln x}{x}$. Tính
$I=\int\limits_{3}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$?
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx+\int\limits_{3}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx-\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left( \frac{f(2\sqrt{x}-1)}{\sqrt{x}}+\frac{\ln x}{x} \right)dx-\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx$
Đặt $2\sqrt{x}-1=t\Rightarrow dt=\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}}$.
Đổi cận
$\begin{array}{l} x=1\Rightarrow t=1 \\ x=4\Rightarrow t=3 \end{array}$
$I=\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)dt+\frac{1}{2}\left( \ln x \right)^{2}\left| {}_{1}^{4} \right.-\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx+\frac{1}{2}\left( \ln x \right)^{2}\left| {}_{1}^{4} \right.-\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=2\ln^{2}2$.

noi_dung: Cho $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos x}{\sin^{2}x-5\sin x+6}\,dx=a\ln\frac{4}{c}+b$, với $a,\,b\in\mathbb{N},\,\,c\in\mathbb{N}^{*}$. Tính tổng $S=a+b+c$.
loi_giai:
Xét tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos x}{\sin^{2}x-5\sin x+6}\,dx$.
Đặt $t=\sin x\Rightarrow dt=\cos x.dx$.
Đổi cận:
[[ole:Visio.Drawing.15]]
Ta có: $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{t^{2}-5t+6}\,dt=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{1}{t-3}-\frac{1}{t-2} \right)\,dt=\left. \ln\left| \frac{t-3}{t-2} \right| \right|_{0}^{1}=\ln\frac{4}{3}$.
Vậy $a=1\,,\,\,b=0,\,\,c=3\Rightarrow S=a+b+c=4$.

noi_dung: Cho $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( x^{2}+x \right)e^{x}}{x+e^{-x}}dx=a.e+b\ln\left( e+c \right)$ với $a,b,c\in\mathbb{Z}$. Tính $P=a+2b-c$
loi_giai:
Ta có
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( x^{2}+x \right)e^{x}}{x+e^{-x}}dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( x^{2}+x \right)e^{x}}{x+\frac{1}{e^{x}}}dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x.e^{x}\left( x+1 \right)e^{x}.}{x.e^{x}+1}dx$
Đặt $u=xe^{x}+1\Rightarrow du=\left( e^{x}+xe^{x} \right)dx=\left( x+1 \right)e^{x}dx$
Khi đó
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( x^{2}+x \right)e^{x}}{x+e^{-x}}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{e+1} \frac{u-1}{u}du=\int\limits_{1}^{e+1} \left( 1-\frac{1}{u} \right)du=\left( u-\ln\left| u \right| \right)\left| {}_{1}^{e+1} \right.=e-\ln\left( e+1 \right)$
Suy ra $a=1,b=-1,c=1\Rightarrow P=a+2b-c=1-2-1=-2$

noi_dung: Biết $a,b,c$ là các số nguyên dương thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{dx}{(x+1)\sqrt{x}+x\sqrt{x+1}}=\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b}-c$. Tính giá trị biểu thức$P=a+b+c$.
loi_giai:
$\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{1}{(x+1)\sqrt{x}+x\sqrt{x+1}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{\text{d}x}{\sqrt{x(x+1)}\left( \sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x} \right)}=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{x+1}}{\sqrt{x(x+1)}\left( \sqrt{x}+\sqrt{x+1} \right)^{2}}\text{d}x$
Đặt $t=\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}\Rightarrow\text{d}t=\left( \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+1}}+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \right)\text{d}x\Leftrightarrow 2\text{d}t=\frac{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{x(x+1)}}\text{d}x$
Khi đó $I=\int\limits_{1+\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3}} \frac{2}{t^{2}}\text{d}t=\left. \left( \frac{-2}{t} \right) \right|_{1+\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3}}=-2\sqrt{3}+4\sqrt{2}-2=\sqrt{32}-\sqrt{12}-2$
Do đó $a=32,\;b=12,\;c=2\Rightarrow P=a+b+c=32+12+2=46.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có $f\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right)=-2$ và $f'\left( x \right)=\frac{4\cos 2x}{\sin^{2}2x}$, $\forall x\in\left( 0;\frac{\pi}{2} \right)$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( x \right)=\int f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int \frac{4\cos 2x}{\sin^{2}2x}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\sin 2x=t\Rightarrow 2\cos 2x\text{d}x=\text{d}t$.
Suy ra $f\left( x \right)=\int \frac{2\text{d}t}{t^{2}}=-\frac{2}{t}+C=-\frac{2}{\sin 2x}+C\xrightarrow{f\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right)=-2}C=0$.
Như vậy $f\left( x \right)=-\frac{2}{\sin 2x}\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} -\frac{2}{\sin 2x}\text{d}x=I$.
Xét $I=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{-2}{\sin 2x}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{-2\sin 2x}{\sin^{2}2x}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{-2\sin 2x}{1-\cos^{2}2x}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{-2\sin 2x}{\left( 1-\cos 2x \right)\left( 1+\cos 2x \right)}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\cos 2x=a\Rightarrow-2\sin 2x\text{d}x=\text{d}a$. Đổi cận: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=\frac{\pi}{3}\Rightarrow a=-\frac{1}{2} \\ x=\frac{\pi}{6}\Rightarrow a=\frac{1}{2} \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $I=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{-\frac{1}{2}} \frac{\text{d}a}{\left( 1-a \right)\left( 1+a \right)}=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{-\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{1}{a+1}-\frac{1}{a-1} \right)\text{d}a=\frac{1}{2}\left[ \int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{-\frac{1}{2}} \frac{\text{d}\left( a+1 \right)}{a+1}-\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{-\frac{1}{2}} \frac{\text{d}\left( a-1 \right)}{a-1} \right]$.
$=\frac{1}{2}\left( \ln\left| a+1 \right|\left| \begin{array}{l} -\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} \end{array} \right.-\ln\left| a-1 \right|\left| \begin{array}{l} -\frac{1}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} \end{array} \right. \right)=-\ln 3$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$. Biết $f\left( 0 \right)=4$và $f'\left( x \right)=2\sin^{2}x+3,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$, khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( x \right)=\int \left( 2\sin^{2}x+3 \right)\text{d}x=\int \left( 4-\cos 2x \right)\text{d}x=4x-\frac{1}{2}\sin 2x+C$.
Lại có $f\left( 0 \right)=4\Rightarrow C=4$. Vậy $f\left( x \right)=4x-\frac{1}{2}\sin 2x+4$
khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \left( 4x-\frac{1}{2}\sin 2x+4 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( 2x^{2}+\frac{1}{4}\cos 2x+4x \right) \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{\pi^{2}}{8}+\pi-\frac{1}{4}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $f^{5}\left( x \right)+3f\left( x \right)=5-x$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{1}^{5} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $u=f\left( x \right)$ khi đó ta có $u^{5}+3u=5-x\Rightarrow\left( 5u^{4}+3 \right)\text{d}u=-\text{d}x$
Đổi cận
$\begin{array}{l} x=1\Rightarrow u=1 \\ x=5\Rightarrow u=0 \end{array}$
Khi đó
$\int\limits_{1}^{5} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{1}^{0} u\left( 5u^{4}+3 \right)\text{d}u=\frac{7}{3}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 3 \right)=21$, $\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=9$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f'\left( 3x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f'\left( 3x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{9}\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3x.f'\left( 3x \right)\text{d}\left( 3x \right)=\frac{1}{9}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x.f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ \text{d}v=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\text{d}x \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x.f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. x.f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{3}-\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=3f\left( 3 \right)-9=3.21-9=54$.
Vậy $I=6$.

noi_dung: Cho $f\left( x \right)$; $g\left( x \right)$ là hai hàm số liên tục trên $\left[ 0\,;\,2 \right]$ thỏa mãn điều kiện $\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ f\left( x \right)+g\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=10$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ 3f\left( x \right)-g\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=6$. Tính $\int\limits_{2019}^{2021} f\left( 2021-x \right)\text{d}x+3\int\limits_{0}^{1} g\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x$:
loi_giai:
Theo gt: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ f\left( x \right)+g\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=10 \\ \int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ 3f\left( x \right)-g\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=6 \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow$$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( x \right)\text{d}x=10 \\ 3\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( x \right)\text{d}x=6 \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow$$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=4 \\ \int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( x \right)\text{d}x=6 \end{array} \right.$
Xét $I_{1}=\int\limits_{2019}^{2021} f\left( 2021-x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $2021-x=t$$\Rightarrow$$\text{d}x=-\text{d}t$
Với $x=2019$$\Rightarrow$$t=2$
$x=2021$$\Rightarrow$$t=0$
$\Rightarrow$$I_{1}=-\int\limits_{2}^{0} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=4$
Xét $I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} g\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $2x=t$$\Rightarrow$$\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\text{d}t$
Với $x=0$$\Rightarrow$$t=0$
$x=1$$\Rightarrow$$t=2$
$\Rightarrow$$I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} g\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( t \right).\frac{1}{2}\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{2} g\left( x \right)\text{d}x=3$
Vậy $\int\limits_{2019}^{2021} f\left( 2021-x \right)\text{d}x+3\int\limits_{0}^{1} g\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=I_{1}+3I_{2}=13$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$. Đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ như hình vẽ.
Giá trị của biểu thức $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f'\left( 4\sin x-2 \right)\cos x\text{d}x+\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{2} f'\left( x+2 \right)\text{d}x$bằng
loi_giai:
Dựa vào đồ thị hàm số ta có $f\left( -2 \right)=-2;\,f\left( 4 \right)=4$
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f'\left( 4\sin x-2 \right)\cos x\text{d}x+\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{2} f'\left( x+2 \right)\text{d}x$
$=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f'\left( 4\sin x-2 \right)\text{d}\left( 4\sin x-2 \right)+\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{2} f'\left( x+2 \right)\text{d}\left( x+2 \right)$
$=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{-2}^{2} f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t+\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{2}^{4} f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{-2}^{4} f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{f\left( 4 \right)-f\left( -2 \right)}{4}=\frac{3}{2}$

noi_dung: Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{4} x\ln\left( x^{2}+9 \right)\text{d}x=a\ln 5+b\ln 3+c,$ trong đó $a,b,c$ là các số nguyên. Giá trị của biểu thức $T=a+b+c$ là
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln\left( x^{2}+9 \right) \\ \text{d}v=x\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\frac{2x}{x^{2}+9}\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{1}{2}x^{2} \end{array} \right..$
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{4} x\ln\left( x^{2}+9 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \frac{1}{2}x^{2}\ln\left( x^{2}+9 \right) \right|_{0}^{4}-\int\limits_{0}^{4} \frac{x^{3}}{x^{2}+9}\text{d}x=16\ln 5-I$ (với $I=\int\limits_{0}^{4} \frac{x^{3}}{x^{2}+9}\text{d}x$).
Đặt $t=x^{2}+9\Rightarrow\text{d}t=2x\text{d}x\Rightarrow x\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\text{d}t.$
Đổi cận: với $x=0\Rightarrow t=9,$ với $x=4\Rightarrow t=25.$
Khi đó $I=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{9}^{25} \frac{t-9}{t}\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{9}^{25} \left( 1-\frac{9}{t} \right)\text{d}t=\left. \frac{1}{2}\left( t-9\ln t \right) \right|_{9}^{25}=8-9\ln 5+9\ln 3.$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{4} x\ln\left( x^{2}+9 \right)\text{d}x=16\ln 5-\left( 8-9\ln 5+9\ln 3 \right)=25\ln 5-9\ln 3-8.$
Vậy $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=25 \\ b=-9 \\ c=-8 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow T=a+b+c=25-9-8=8.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)=\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x^{2}\,\,\,\,\,\text{khi}\,\,x\ge 2 \\ 2+x\,\,\text{khi }x<2 \end{array} \right.$. Tính tích phân $\int_{0}^{5} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{3x+1} \right)}{\sqrt{3x+1}}\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Dễ thấy, hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ xác định và liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$.
Ta có: $\sqrt{3x+1}=2\Leftrightarrow 3x+1=4\Leftrightarrow x=1$.
Nhận xét: $3x+1>0\,\,\forall x\in\left( 0;5 \right)$, khi đó $I=\int_{0}^{5} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{3x+1} \right)}{\sqrt{3x+1}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2+\sqrt{3x+1}}{\sqrt{3x+1}}\text{d}x+\int\limits_{1}^{5} \sqrt{3x+1}\text{d}x$.
 Xét $I_{1}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2+\sqrt{3x+1}}{\sqrt{3x+1}}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $t=\sqrt{3x+1}\Rightarrow 2t\text{d}t=3\text{d}x$.
Khi $x=0$ thì $t=1$, khi $x=1$ thì $t=2$.
Khi đó, $I_{1}=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{2+t}{t}.\frac{2}{3}t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{2}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( 2+t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{2}{3}\left. \left( 2t+\frac{t^{2}}{2} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{2}{3}\left( 2.2-2.1+\frac{2^{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \right)=\frac{7}{3}$.
 Xét $I_{2}=\int\limits_{1}^{5} \sqrt{3x+1}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{5} \left( 3x+1 \right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{\text{d}\left( 3x+1 \right)}{3}=\frac{1}{3}\left. \left[ \frac{\left( 3x+1 \right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2}} \right] \right|_{1}^{5}=\frac{2}{9}\left. \left[ \left( 3x+1 \right)\sqrt{3x+1} \right] \right|_{1}^{5}$
$=\frac{2}{9}\left[ \left( 3.5+1 \right)\sqrt{3.5+1}-\left( 3.1+1 \right)\sqrt{3.1+1} \right]=\frac{112}{9}$.
Vậy $I=I_{1}+I_{2}=\frac{7}{3}+\frac{112}{9}=\frac{133}{9}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4x\sqrt{x}}=\frac{\ln x}{x}$. Biết $\int\limits_{1}^{17} f\left( x \right)dx=a\ln 4-b$ với $a,\,b\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị của $a+2b$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4x\sqrt{x}}=\frac{\ln x}{x}$$\Leftrightarrow 2xf\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{2\sqrt{x}}=2\ln x$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{4} 2xf\left( x^{2}+1 \right)dx+\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{2\sqrt{x}}dx=2\int\limits_{1}^{4} \ln xdx$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{2}^{17} f\left( u \right)du+\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( v \right)dv=2\left. \left( x\ln x-x \right) \right|_{1}^{4}$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{17} f\left( x \right)dx=8\ln 4-6$.
Vậy $a+2b=8+2.6=20$.

noi_dung: Biết $\int\limits_{1}^{e} \frac{\ln x}{\left( 1+x \right)^{2}}\,\text{d}x$$=\frac{a}{\text{e +1}}\,+b\ln\frac{2}{\text{e +1}}+c$ với $a$, $b$, $c\in\,\mathbb{Z}$. Tính $a+\,b+\,c$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln x \\ \text{d}v=\frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}\,}\,\text{d}x \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\frac{1}{x}\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{-1}{x+1}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.$.
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{\text{e}} \frac{\ln x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\,\text{d}x$$=\left. \frac{-\ln x}{x+1} \right|_{1}^{\text{e}}+\int\limits_{1}^{\text{e}} \frac{1}{x\left( x+1 \right)}\text{d}x$$=\left. \frac{-\ln x}{x+1} \right|_{1}^{\text{e}}+\left. \ln\frac{x}{x+1} \right|_{1}^{\text{e}}$$=-\frac{1}{\text{e}\,+1}+\ln\frac{\text{e}}{\text{e}+1}-\ln\frac{1}{2}$$=\frac{-1}{\text{e}\,+1}+\ln\text{e}\,-\ln\left( \text{e+1} \right)+\ln 2$$=\frac{-1}{\text{e}+1}+\ln\frac{2}{\text{e}+1}+1$.
$\Rightarrow a=-1$, $b=1$, $c=1$$\Rightarrow a+b+c=1$.

noi_dung: Giả sử $\int\limits_{3}^{5} x^{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{a\ln 3+b\ln 2}{3}-\frac{c}{9}$ với $a,b,c\in N^{*}$. Giá trị của biểu thức $b+c-a$ bằng
loi_giai:
$I=\int\limits_{3}^{5} x^{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln\left( x+1 \right) \\ \text{d}v=x^{2}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\frac{1}{x+1}\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{1}{3}x^{3} \end{array} \right.$, suy ra
$I=\int\limits_{3}^{5} x^{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \frac{x^{3}\ln\left( x+1 \right)}{3} \right|_{3}^{5}-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{3}^{5} \frac{x^{3}}{x+1}\text{d}x$
$=\frac{125\ln 6-27\ln 4}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{3}^{5} \left( x^{2}-x+1-\frac{1}{x+1} \right)\text{d}x$
$=\frac{125\ln 6-27\ln 4}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\left. \left( \frac{x^{3}}{3}-\frac{x^{2}}{2}+x-\ln\left| x+1 \right| \right) \right|_{3}^{5}$
$=\frac{126\ln 6-28\ln 4}{3}-\frac{80}{9}$
$=\frac{126\ln 3+70\ln 2}{3}-\frac{80}{9}=\frac{a\ln 3+b\ln 2}{3}-\frac{c}{9}\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=126 \\ b=70 \\ c=80 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow b+c-a=24$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)=\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 2x+1,\,khi\,x>3 \\ ax-3a+7,\,khi\,x\le 3 \end{array} \right.$ ($a$ là tham số thực). Nếu $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( \text{e}^{x}+1 \right)\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x=\text{e}^{2}$ thì $a$ bằng
loi_giai:
Xét: $I=\int_{0}^{1} f\left( e^{x}+1 \right)e^{x}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $t=\text{e}^{x}+1\Rightarrow\text{d}t=\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$.
Đổi cận: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=0\Rightarrow t=2 \\ x=1\Rightarrow t=\text{e}+1 \end{array} \right.$.
Khi đó: $I=\int_{2}^{\text{e}+1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int_{2}^{3} \left( at-3a+7 \right)\text{d}t+\int_{3}^{\text{e}+1} \left( 2t+1 \right)\text{d}t=\text{e}^{2}+3\text{e}-3-\frac{a}{2}=\text{e}^{2}$
$\Leftrightarrow a=6\text{e}-6$.

noi_dung: Biết rằng $\int\limits_{0}^{\ln 4} \frac{\text{d}x}{1+\sqrt{e^{x}}}=a+b\ln 2+c\ln 3$ với $a,\,\,b,\,\,c\,\in\,\mathbb{Z}$. Tính $T=a+b+c$.

Cho $I=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{x+\ln x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x=\frac{a}{b}\ln 2-\frac{1}{c}$ với $a$, $b$, $c$ là các số nguyên dương và $\frac{a}{b}$ là phân số tối giản. Tính giá trị biểu thức $S=\frac{a+b}{c}$.
loi_giai:
Xét $I=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{x+\ln x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x+\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\ln x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x$.
Tính $I_{1}=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\left( x+1 \right)-1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}\left( x+1 \right)=\left. \left( \ln\left| x+1 \right|+\frac{1}{x+1} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\ln 3-\ln 2-\frac{1}{6}$.
Tính $I_{2}=\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\ln x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln x\Rightarrow\text{d}u=\frac{1}{x}\text{d}x \\ \text{d}v=\frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\text{d}x,v=\frac{-1}{x+1} \end{array} \right.$, khi đó
$I_{2}=\left. \left( \frac{-1}{x+1}\ln x \right) \right|_{1}^{2}+\int_{1}^{2} \frac{1}{x\left( x+1 \right)}\text{d}x=\frac{-1}{3}\ln 2+\int_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x+1} \right)\text{d}x$
$=\frac{-1}{3}\ln 2+\left. \left( \ln\left| x \right|-\ln\left| x+1 \right| \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{5}{3}\ln 2-\ln 3$.
Suy ra: $I=I_{1}+I_{2}=\ln 3-\ln 2-\frac{1}{6}+\frac{5}{3}\ln 2-\ln 3=\frac{2}{3}\ln 2-\frac{1}{6}$.
Vậy: $a=2$, $b=3$, $c=6$$\Rightarrow S=\frac{a+b}{c}=\frac{5}{6}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)=\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x^{2}-1\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\left( x\ge 0 \right) \\ 2\cos x-3\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\left( x<0 \right) \end{array} \right.$. Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \left| 2\cos x-1 \right| \right)\sin x\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $2\cos x-1=t\Rightarrow dt=-2\sin xdx$
$x$
0
$\frac{\pi}{2}$

$t$

1

-1
Đổi cận:
Ta có $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \left| 2\cos x-1 \right| \right)\sin x\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{1}^{-1} f\left( \left| t \right| \right)dt=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-1}^{1} f\left( \left| t \right| \right)dt=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-1 \right)dx=\left. \left( \frac{x^{3}}{3}-x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=-\frac{2}{3}$
(Ở đây $y=f\left( \left| t \right| \right)$ là hàm số chẵn trên $\left[ -1;\,1 \right]$ nên ta có $\int\limits_{-1}^{1} f\left( \left| t \right| \right)dt=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt$)

noi_dung: Cho biết $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}\ln\frac{4-x^{2}}{4+x^{2}}\text{d}x=a+b\ln\frac{p}{q}$ với $a$, $b$ là các số hữu tỷ, $p$, $q$ là các số nguyên tố và $p<q$. Giá trị của biểu thức $S=ab+pq$ bằng?
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln\frac{4-x^{2}}{4+x^{2}} \\ \text{d}v=x^{3}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=-\frac{16x}{\left( 4+x^{2} \right)^{2}}.\frac{4+x^{2}}{4-x^{2}}\text{d}x=-\frac{16x}{16-x^{4}}\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{x^{4}}{4}-\frac{16}{4} \end{array} \right.$
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}\ln\frac{4-x^{2}}{4+x^{2}}\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{x^{4}-16}{4}\ln\frac{4-x^{2}}{4+x^{2}} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x\left( x^{4}-16 \right)}{16-x^{4}}=-\frac{15}{4}\ln\frac{3}{5}-\left. 2x^{2} \right|_{0}^{1}=-\frac{15}{4}\ln\frac{3}{5}-2$
Suy ra $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=-2 \\ b=-\frac{15}{4} \\ p=3 \\ q=5 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow S=ab+pq=\frac{15}{2}+15=\frac{45}{2}.$

noi_dung: Biết $\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{d}x}{\text{e}^{x}+2\text{e}^{-x}-3}=3\mathrm{lna}-\mathrm{lnb}$ với $a$, $b$ là các số nguyên dương. Tính $P=ab$.
loi_giai:
Có $\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{d}x}{\text{e}^{x}+2\text{e}^{-x}-3}=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x}{\left( \text{e}^{x} \right)^{2}+2-3e^{x}}=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \frac{\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-2 \right)\left( e^{x}-1 \right)}=\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \text{e}^{x}\left[ \frac{1}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-2 \right)}-\frac{1}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-1 \right)} \right]\text{d}x$
$\int\limits_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6} \left[ \frac{\text{e}^{x}}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-2 \right)}-\frac{\text{e}^{x}}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-1 \right)} \right]\text{d}x=\ln\left| \frac{\text{e}^{x}-2}{\left( \text{e}^{x}-1 \right)} \right|_{\ln 3}^{\ln 6}=\ln\frac{8}{5}=3\ln 2-\ln 5\Rightarrow a=2,b=5$
Vậy $P=ab=10$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm dương, liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ và $3\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right)\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}+\frac{1}{9} \right]dx\le 2\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right)dx$. Tính tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}dx$:
loi_giai:
Từ giả thiết suy ra: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ \left( 3\sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}-2.3\sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right)+1 \right]dx\le 0$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ 3\sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{2}dx\le 0$.
Suy ra $3\sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right)-1=0$$\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{f'\left( x \right)}f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{3}$$\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{9}$.
Vì $\left[ f^{3}\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=3.f^{2}\left( x \right)f'\left( x \right)$ nên suy ra $\left[ f^{3}\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=\frac{1}{3}$$\Rightarrow f^{3}\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{3}x+C$.
Vì $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ nên $f^{3}\left( 0 \right)=1$$\Rightarrow C=1$.
Vậy $\Rightarrow f^{3}\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{3}x+1$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}dx$$=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{1}{3}x+1 \right)dx=\frac{7}{6}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=1,\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{9}{5}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)\text{d}x=\frac{2}{5}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $t=\sqrt{x}\Rightarrow t^{2}=x\Rightarrow\text{d}x=2t\text{d}t$. Đổi cận $x=0\Rightarrow t=0;\,\,x=1\Rightarrow t=1$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)\text{d}x=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} t.f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} t.f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{5}$. Do đó $\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{5}$
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$=\frac{1}{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{5}=\frac{3}{10}$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{3}{5}$
Ta tính được $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 3x^{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{9}{5}$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 3x^{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)-3x^{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$
$\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)-3x^{2}=0$$\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=3x^{2}$$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{3}+C$.
Vì $f\left( 1 \right)=1$ nên $f\left( x \right)=x^{3}$
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{4}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;a \right]$, biết rằng với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;a \right]$ ta có $f\left( x \right)>0$ và $f\left( x \right).f\left( a-x \right)=k^{2},\left( k>0 \right)$. Giá trị của tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{\text{d}x}{k+f\left( x \right)}$ bằng
loi_giai:
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{\text{d}x}{k+f\left( x \right)}$. Đặt $t=a-x\Rightarrow\text{d}t=-\text{d}x$. Khi $x=0\Rightarrow t=a;x=a\Rightarrow t=0$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{\text{d}t}{k+f\left( a-t \right)}=\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{\text{d}t}{k+\frac{k^{2}}{f\left( t \right)}}=\frac{1}{k}\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{f\left( t \right)\text{d}t}{\left[ k+f\left( t \right) \right]}=\frac{1}{k}\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{f\left( x \right)\text{d}x}{k+f\left( x \right)}$.
Suy ra $2I=\frac{1}{k}\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{k\text{d}x}{k+f\left( x \right)}+\frac{1}{k}\int\limits_{0}^{a} \frac{f\left( x \right)\text{d}x}{k+f\left( x \right)}=\frac{1}{k}\int\limits_{0}^{a} \text{d}x=\frac{a}{k}$. Do đó $I=\frac{a}{2k}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $f(x)+f(-x)=\sqrt{2+2\cos 2x}$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(x)dx$.
loi_giai:
$I=\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(x)dx=\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(-x)dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \left[ f(x)+f(-x) \right]dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{2+2\cos 2x}dx$
=$\int\limits_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \left| \cos x \right|dx=2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos xdx=2$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số f có đạo hàm liên tục, $f\left( x \right)>-1,\,\,f\left( 0 \right)=0$ và thoả $f'\left( x \right)\sqrt{x^{2}+1}=2x\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}$. Tính $f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)\,.$
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$f'\left( x \right)\sqrt{x^{2}+1}=2x\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}}=\frac{2x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \frac{2x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}\text{d}x\,\,\,\left( 1 \right)$
Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}}\text{d}x$
Đặt $t=\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}\Rightarrow t^{2}=f\left( x \right)+1\Leftrightarrow 2t\,\text{d}t=f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)+1}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)+1}} \frac{2t\text{d}t}{t}=\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)+1}} 2\text{d}t=\left. 2t \right|_{1}^{\sqrt{f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)+1}}=2\sqrt{f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)+1}-2\,\,$ (2)
Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \frac{2x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}dx\,\,=2\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\left( 3 \right)$
Từ (1), (2), (3) có: $f\left( \sqrt{3} \right)=3\,.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm $f'\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ thỏa $f\left( 1 \right)=0$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{dx}=\frac{\pi^{2}}{8}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{cos}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\cos\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{2}{\pi}\sin\frac{\pi x}{2} \end{array} \right.$
Do đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{cos}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left. \frac{2}{\pi}\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{2}{\pi}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{\pi}{4}$.
Lại có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{sin}^{2}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}$
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( -\frac{2}{\pi}.f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x-2\left( -\frac{2}{\pi} \right)\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{sin}^{2}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)\text{d}x$
$=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( -\frac{2}{\pi}f'\left( x \right)-\text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{4}{\pi^{2}}\frac{\pi^{2}}{8}-\frac{2}{\pi}.\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{2}=0$
Vì $\left( -\frac{2}{\pi}f'\left( x \right)-\text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right) \right)^{2}\ge 0$ trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ nên
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( -\frac{2}{\pi}f'\left( x \right)-\text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Leftrightarrow-\frac{2}{\pi}f'\left( x \right)\text{=sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)$$\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)\text{=}-\frac{\pi}{2}\text{sin}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)$.
Suy ra $f\left( x \right)\text{=cos}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)+C$ mà $f\left( 1 \right)=0$ do đó $f\left( x \right)\text{=cos}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{cos}\left( \frac{\pi}{2}x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{2}{\pi}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ đồng biến, có đạo hàm đến cấp hai trên đoạn $\left[ 0;2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}-f\left( x \right).f''\left( x \right)+\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=0$. Biết $f\left( 0 \right)=1$, $f\left( 2 \right)=e^{6}$. Khi đó $f\left( 1 \right)$ bằng
loi_giai:
Theo bài ra ta có hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ đồng biến trên $\left[ 0;2 \right]$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)\ge f\left( 0 \right)=1>0$ do đó $f\left( x \right)>0\quad\forall x\in\left[ 0;2 \right]$.
Ta có $\left[ \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)} \right]^{\prime}=\frac{f''\left( x \right).f\left( x \right)-\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}$
Theo đề bài $\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}-f\left( x \right).f''\left( x \right)+\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=0$
$\Rightarrow f''\left( x \right).f\left( x \right)-\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}$$\Rightarrow\left[ \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)} \right]^{\prime}=1$
$\Rightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}=x+C$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( x+C \right)\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}\left( f\left( x \right) \right)=\left( \frac{x^{2}}{2}+Cx \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} {}^{2} \\ {}_{0} \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow\ln\left| f\left( x \right) \right|\left| \begin{array}{l} {}^{2} \\ {}_{0} \end{array} \right.=2+2C$$\Rightarrow\ln\left| \text{e}^{6} \right|-\ln\left| 1 \right|=2+2C\Rightarrow C=2$$\Rightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}=x+2$.
Do đó $\ln f\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} {}^{1} \\ {}_{0} \end{array} \right.=\left( \frac{x^{2}}{2}+2x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} {}^{1} \\ {}_{0} \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow\ln f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{5}{2}$$\Rightarrow f\left( 1 \right)=\text{e}^{\frac{5}{2}}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x+1 \right)\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{4}$ và$f\left( 1 \right)=0$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
loi_giai:
- Tính : $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x+1 \right)\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=$$\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=J+K$.
Tính $K=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\left[ \text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)+\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x \\ v=x \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow K=\left. \left( x\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ x\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)+x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x$$=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ $\left( \text{do }f\left( 1 \right)=0 \right)$
$\Rightarrow K=-J-\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow I=J+K=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
- Kết hợp giả thiết ta được :
$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{4} \\ -\int\limits_{0}^{1} xe^{x}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{4} \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{4}\text{      (1)} \\ 2\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{2}\text{ (2)} \end{array} \right.$
- Mặt khác, ta tính được :$\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}\text{e}^{2x}\text{d}x=\frac{\text{e}^{2}-1}{4}\text{  (3)}$.
- Cộng vế với vế các đẳng thức (1), (2), (3) ta được:
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}+2x\text{e}^{x}f'\left( x \right)+x^{2}\text{e}^{2x} \right)\text{d}x=0$ $\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{o}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)+x\text{e}^{x} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Leftrightarrow\pi\int\limits_{o}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)+x\text{e}^{x} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$
hay thể tích hình phẳng giới hạn bởi đồ thị hàm số $y=f'\left( x \right)+x\text{e}^{x}$, trục $Ox$, các đường thẳng $x=0$, $x=1$ khi quay quanh trục $Ox$ bằng $0$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)+x\text{e}^{x}=0$$\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=-x\text{e}^{x}$
$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\int x\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x=\left( 1-x \right)\text{e}^{x}+\text{C}$.
- Lại do $f\left( 1 \right)=0\Rightarrow\text{C}=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\left( 1-x \right)\text{e}^{x}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 1-x \right)\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$$=\left. \left( \left( 1-x \right)\text{e}^{x} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$$=-1+\left. \text{e}^{x} \right|_{0}^{1}=\text{e}-2$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1;2 \right]$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{3}$, $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=7$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $u=f\left( x \right)\Rightarrow\text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$, $\text{d}v=\left( x-1 \right)^{2}\text{d}x\Rightarrow v=\frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{3}}{3}$
Ta có $-\frac{1}{3}=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$=\left. \frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{3}}{3}.f\left( x \right) \right|_{1}^{2}-\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{3}}{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow-\frac{1}{3}=-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=1$$\Rightarrow-\int\limits_{1}^{2} 2.7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-14$
Tính được $\int\limits_{1}^{2} 49\left( x-1 \right)^{6}\text{d}x=7$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x$$-\int\limits_{1}^{2} 2.7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$+\int\limits_{1}^{2} 49\left( x-1 \right)^{6}\text{d}x=0$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ 7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}-f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}+C$.
Do $f\left( 2 \right)=0$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}-\frac{7}{4}$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}-\frac{7}{4} \right]\text{d}x$$=-\frac{7}{5}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{16} \frac{16f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x=6$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos x\text{d}x=3$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{4} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
+ Xét $I=\int\limits_{1}^{16} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x=6$, đặt $\sqrt{x}=t\Rightarrow\frac{dx}{2\sqrt{x}}=dt$
Đổi cận:
$x$
$1$

$16$
$t$
$1$

$4$
 $I=2\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( t \right)dt=6$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( t \right)dt=\frac{6}{2}=3$.
+ $J=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos x\text{d}x=3$, đặt $\sin x=u\Rightarrow\cos xdx=du$
Đổi cận:
$x$
$0$

$\frac{\pi}{2}$
$u$
$0$

$1$
$J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( u \right)du=3$
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{4} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=3+3=6$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ thỏa mãn: $f\left( 1 \right)=0,\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\,\text{d}x=7$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}.f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{3}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Xét tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}.f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=x^{2}\,\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{x^{3}}{3} \end{array} \right.$
$\frac{1}{3}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}.f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=\frac{x^{3}}{3}f\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$$=-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=-1$
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{6}\,dx=\frac{1}{7}$.
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\,\text{d}x+14\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x+49\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{6}\,\text{d}x=0$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)+7x^{3} \right)^{2}\,\text{d}x=0$
Mà $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)+7x^{3} \right)^{2}\,\text{d}x\ge 0$. Dấu “=” xảy ra khi $f'\left( x \right)+7x^{3}=0\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=-7x^{3}$ $\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\int f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=-\int 7x^{3}\,\text{d}x$$=-\frac{7x^{4}}{4}+C$.
$f\left( 1 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=\frac{7}{4}$ $\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{7x^{4}}{4}+\frac{7}{4}$.
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( -\frac{7x^{4}}{4}+\frac{7}{4} \right)\,\text{d}x=-\frac{7x^{5}}{20}\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.+\frac{7x}{4}\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.$ $=-\frac{7}{20}+\frac{7}{4}=\frac{7}{5}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=3,\,\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{4}{11}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{7}{11}$. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx$ là
loi_giai:
Xét $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{7}{11}$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ dv=x^{4}dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'\left( x \right)dx \\ v=\frac{x^{5}}{5} \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f\left( x \right)dx=\left. \frac{1}{5}x^{5}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{5}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx$$=\frac{3}{5}-\frac{1}{5}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx=\left. \frac{1}{5}x^{5}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{5}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx$ ( vì $f\left( 1 \right)=3$)
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx=5\left( \frac{3}{5}-\frac{7}{11} \right)=-\frac{2}{11}$.
Xét$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{4}{11} \\ \int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{2}{11} \\ \int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{10}dx=\frac{1}{11}\left. x^{11} \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{11} \end{array} \right.$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{5}f'\left( x \right)dx+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{10}dx=0$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ \left( f'\left( x \right)+2x^{5} \right) \right]^{2}dx=0$$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=-2x^{5}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{-x^{6}}{3}+C$. Do $f\left( 1 \right)=3\Rightarrow C=\frac{10}{3}$ nên $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{-x^{6}}{3}+\frac{10}{3} \right)dx=\frac{23}{7}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\left[ 0;3 \right];$ $f\left( 3-x \right).f\left( x \right)=1,f\left( x \right)\ne-1$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;3 \right]$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{1}{2}$. Tính tích phân: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{x.f'\left( x \right)}{\left[ 1+f\left( 3-x \right) \right]^{2}.f^{2}\left( x \right)}dx$.
loi_giai:
$\left( 1+f\left( 3-x \right) \right)^{2}.f^{2}\left( x \right)$$=f^{2}\left( x \right)+2.f\left( 3-x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right)+f^{2}\left( 3-x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right)$
$=f^{2}\left( x \right)+2.f\left( x \right)+1$$=\left( f\left( x \right)+1 \right)^{2}$.
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{x.f'\left( x \right)}{\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ dv=\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{du}=\text{d}x \\ v=-\frac{1}{1+f\left( x \right)} \end{array} \right.$
$I=\left. \frac{-x}{1+f\left( x \right)} \right|_{0}^{3}+\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{dx}{1+f\left( x \right)}=\frac{-3}{1+f\left( 3 \right)}+I_{1}$
$f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{1}{2}\Rightarrow f\left( 3 \right)=2$
Đặt $t=3-x\Rightarrow dt=-dx$
Đổi cận $x=0\Rightarrow t=3$
$x=3\Rightarrow t=0$
$I_{1}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{dt}{1+f\left( 3-t \right)}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{dx}{1+\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f\left( x \right).dx}{1+f\left( x \right)}$
$2I_{1}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{1+f\left( x \right)}{1+f\left( x \right)}dx=3\Rightarrow I_{1}=\frac{3}{2}$
Vậy $I=-1+\frac{3}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $f(x)$ liên tục $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f(1)=0$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx=80,\text{ }\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f(x)dx=-2$.
Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx$
loi_giai:
Ta có: $-2=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f(x)dx=\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2}f(x) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}.f'\left( x \right)dx\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=4\Rightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'(x)\left( 20x^{2} \right)dx=160$.
Lại có: $\int_{0}^{1} x^{4}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} \left( 20x^{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=80$.
Nên: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f^{/}(x) \right]^{2}dx-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{/}(x)\left( 20x^{2} \right)dx+\int_{0}^{1} \left( 20x^{2} \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-20x^{2} \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=20x^{2}$
$\Rightarrow f(x)=\frac{20x^{3}}{3}-\frac{20}{3}$ ( vì $f(1)=0$)
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{20x^{3}}{3}-\frac{20}{3} \right)dx=-5$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục thỏa mãn $f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=0$, $\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{4}$ và $\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{4}$. Tính $f\left( 2018\pi \right)$.
loi_giai:
Tính: $\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{4}$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\cos x\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=\mathrm{sinx} \end{array} \right.$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} f'\left( x \right)\sin x\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} 2f'\left( x \right)\sin xdx=-\frac{\pi}{2},\,\,\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sin^{2}xdx=\frac{\pi}{4}\left( 1 \right)$.
Từ $\left( 1 \right)$ và giả thiết $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \left[ f'\left( x \right)+\sin x \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$
$\Rightarrow\sin x+f'\left( x \right)=0\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=-\sin x$ $\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\cos x+C$.
Mà $f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=0\Rightarrow C=0$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\cos x\Rightarrow f\left( 2018\pi \right)=1$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\frac{\pi}{4} \right]$ và $f\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right)=0$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f^{2}\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{8}$, $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f'\left( x \right)\sin 2x\text{d}x=-\frac{\pi}{4}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f'\left( x \right)\sin 2x\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2x\text{d}f\left( x \right)$$=\left. \left[ f\left( x \right)\sin 2x \right] \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}\sin 2x$
$=f\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right)\sin\left( 2.\frac{\pi}{4} \right)-f\left( 0 \right)\sin\left( 2.0 \right)-2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\cos 2x\text{d}x$
$=f\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \right)-2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\cos 2x\text{d}x$$=-2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\cos 2x\text{d}x$.
Do đó $2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\cos 2x\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{4}$.
Mặt khác: $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cos^{2}2x\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \left( 1+\cos 4x \right)\text{d}x$$=\left. \left( \frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{8}\sin 4x \right) \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}$$=\frac{\pi}{8}$.
Bởi vậy:
$\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f^{2}\left( x \right)\text{d}x-2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( x \right)\cos 2x\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cos^{2}2x\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{8}$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \left[ f^{2}\left( x \right)-2f\left( x \right)\cos 2x+\cos^{2}2x \right]\text{d}x=0$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \left[ f\left( x \right)-\cos 2x \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\cos 2x$.
Nên:
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}} \cos 4x\text{d}x$$=\left. \frac{1}{4}\sin 4x \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{8}}=\frac{1}{4}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 1;2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( 2 \right)=0,$ $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}dx=\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{2}{3}$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=-\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{3}{2}.$ Tính tích phân $\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx.$
loi_giai:
$\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=-\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{3}{2}.$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right)\Rightarrow du=f'\left( x \right)dx \\ dv=\frac{dx}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}\Rightarrow v=-\frac{1}{x+1} \end{array} \right.$
$\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=-\left. \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x+1} \right|_{1}^{2}+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx=\frac{f\left( 1 \right)}{2}-\frac{f\left( 2 \right)}{3}+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx=\frac{f\left( 1 \right)}{2}+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}dx+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2}dx+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx=0$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}dx-\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2}dx+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx=0$
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}+\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}-\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2} \right]dx=0 \\ \Leftrightarrow\left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}+\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}-\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2}=0 \\ \Leftrightarrow\left[ \begin{array}{l} f'\left( x \right)=0 \\ f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2}=0 \end{array} \right.\Leftrightarrow\left[ \begin{array}{l} f\left( x \right)=C \\ f\left( x \right)=\frac{x}{2}-\ln\left| x+1 \right|+C \end{array} \right. \end{array}$
TH1: $f\left( x \right)=C,f\left( 2 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=0$ (loại)
TH2: $f\left( x \right)=\frac{x}{2}-\ln\left| x+1 \right|+C,f\left( 2 \right)=0\Leftrightarrow C=\ln 3-1\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x}{2}-\ln\left| x+1 \right|+\ln 3-1$
$\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{3}{4}-2\ln\frac{3}{2}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=0$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{4}{3}-\ln 3$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{4f\left( x \right)}{\left( 2x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=2\ln 3-\frac{8}{3}$. Tính tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{4}dx$ bằng.
loi_giai:
Ta tính. $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{4f\left( x \right)}{\left( 2x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=2\ln 3-\frac{8}{3}$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( 2x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-\frac{2}{3}$
Đặt:$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f(x) \\ dv=\frac{1}{\left( 2x+1 \right)^{2}}dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'(x)dx \\ v=-\frac{1}{2}.\frac{1}{2x+1}+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{x}{2x+1} \end{array} \right.$
$\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-\frac{2}{3}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( 2x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=\left. -\frac{xf(x)}{2x+1} \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{xf'(x)}{2x+1}dx=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{2x+1}f'(x)\mathrm{dx}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{2x+1}f'\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{1}{2}\ln 3+\frac{2}{3}$ $\Leftrightarrow 4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{2x+1}f'\left( x \right)dx=-2\ln 3+\frac{8}{3}$
Tính tích phân: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{2x}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 1-\frac{1}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx$
$=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 1-\frac{2}{2x+1}+\frac{1}{(2x+1)^{2}} \right)dx$
$=\left. \frac{1}{4}\left( x-\ln\left| 2x+1 \right|-\frac{1}{2\left( 2x+1 \right)} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{4}\ln 3$
$\Rightarrow 4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx=\frac{4}{3}-\ln 3$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx-4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{2x+1}f'\left( x \right)dx+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx=0$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'(x)-\frac{2x}{2x+1} \right)^{2}dx=0\Rightarrow f'(x)=\frac{2x}{2x+1}=1-\frac{1}{2x+1}$
$\Rightarrow f(x)=x-\frac{1}{2}\ln\left( 2x+1 \right)+C$ vì $x\in\left( 0;1 \right)$
Vì $f\left( 1 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-1$
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{4}dx=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-\frac{1}{2}\ln\left( 2x+1 \right)+\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-1 \right)dx$ $=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x+\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-1 \right)dx-\frac{1}{8}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \ln\left( 2x+1 \right)dx$
$A=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x+\frac{1}{2}\ln 3-1 \right)dx=\frac{1}{4}\left. \left( \frac{x^{2}}{2}+\frac{x}{2}\ln 3-x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}$$=-\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{8}\ln 3$
$B=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \ln\left( 2x+1 \right)dx$ đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\ln\left( 2x+1 \right) \\ dv=dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=\frac{2}{2x+1}dx \\ x=x \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow B=\left. x\ln(2x+1) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2x}{2x+1}dx$ $=\ln 3-\left. \left( x-\frac{1}{2}\ln(2\mathrm{x}+1) \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{3}{2}\ln 3-1$
$\Rightarrow I=A-\frac{1}{8}B=-\frac{1}{16}\ln 3$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f(x)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=1$; $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{30}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 2x-1 \right)f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{30}$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\left( 2x-1 \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=x^{2}-x \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 2x-1 \right)f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( x^{2}-x \right)f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{30}$
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{4}-2x^{3}+x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$$=\left. \left( \frac{x^{5}}{5}-\frac{x^{4}}{2}+\frac{x^{3}}{3} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}$$=\frac{1}{30}$.
Do đó, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-\left( x^{2}-x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=x^{2}-x$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-\frac{x^{2}}{2}+C$.
Vì $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ nên $C=1$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-\frac{x^{2}}{2}+1$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x^{3}}{3}-\frac{x^{2}}{2}+1 \right)\text{d}x$$=\left. \left( \frac{x^{4}}{12}-\frac{x^{3}}{6}+x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}$$=\frac{11}{12}$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$ và $f'\left( x \right)>0,\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$. Biết rằng
$f\left( 2 \right)=\frac{7}{4}$ và $4x^{3}f\left( x \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{3}-x^{3},\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$. Giá trị của $f\left( 4 \right)$ bằng:
loi_giai:
Ta có $f'\left( x \right)>0,\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$ nên hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ đồng biến trên $\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$.
Suy ra $f\left( x \right)\ge f\left( 2 \right)=\frac{7}{4}>0,\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$ (1).
Mặt khác, từ giả thiết ta có $x^{3}\left[ 4f\left( x \right)+1 \right]=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{3},\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$
Kết hợp với (1) ta suy ra: $4x=\frac{4f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{4f\left( x \right)+1}},\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 2;\,4 \right]$.
Lấy tích phân 2 vế cận từ 2 đến 4 ta được:
$24=\int\limits_{2}^{4} 4x\text{d}x=\int\limits_{2}^{4} \frac{4f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{4f\left( x \right)+1}}\text{d}x=\left. \frac{3}{2}\sqrt[3]{\left[ 4f\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}} \right|_{2}^{4}$
$\begin{array}{l} \left. \Leftrightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left[ 4f\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}} \right|_{2}^{4}=16 \\ \Leftrightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left[ 4f\left( 4 \right)+1 \right]^{2}}-\sqrt[3]{\left[ 4.\frac{7}{4}+1 \right]^{2}}=16 \\ \Leftrightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left[ 4f\left( 4 \right)+1 \right]^{2}}=20 \\ \Rightarrow\left[ 4f\left( 4 \right)+1 \right]^{2}=8000 \\ \Rightarrow f\left( 4 \right)=\frac{40\sqrt{5}-1}{4}. \end{array}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ xác định trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $f'\left( x \right)+2f'\left( -x \right)=\frac{2\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}$ với mọi số thực $x$. Giả sử $f\left( 2 \right)=m$, $f\left( -3 \right)=n$. Tính giá trị của biểu thức $T=f\left( -2 \right)-f\left( 3 \right)$.
loi_giai:
Với mọi số thực $x$, thay $x$ bởi $-x$ vào biểu thức $f'\left( x \right)+2f'\left( -x \right)=\frac{2\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}$ (1), ta được
$f'\left( -x \right)+2f'\left( x \right)=\frac{2\left| -x \right|}{\left( -x \right)^{6}+\left( -x \right)^{2}+1}$ hay $2f'\left( x \right)+f'\left( -x \right)=\frac{2\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}$ (2).
Nhân hai vế của (2) với 2 sau đó trừ theo vế cho (1), rút gọn suy ra $f'\left( x \right)=\frac{2}{3}.\frac{\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}$ với mọi số thực $x$.
Xét $I=\int\limits_{-3}^{2} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{-3}^{2} \frac{2}{3}.\frac{\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$. Đặt $u=-x$, khi đó ta được $\text{d}u=-\text{d}x$.
Đổi cận: Khi $x=-3\Rightarrow u=3$ và $x=2\Rightarrow u=-2$.
Ta được
$I=\int\limits_{3}^{-2} \frac{2}{3}.\frac{\left| -u \right|}{\left( -u \right)^{6}+\left( -u \right)^{2}+1}\left( -\text{d}u \right)=\int\limits_{-2}^{3} \frac{2}{3}.\frac{\left| u \right|}{u^{6}+u^{2}+1}\text{d}u=\int\limits_{-2}^{3} \frac{2}{3}.\frac{\left| x \right|}{x^{6}+x^{2}+1}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{-2}^{3} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Mà $I=\int\limits_{-3}^{2} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 2 \right)-f\left( -3 \right)$ (3) và $I=\int\limits_{-2}^{3} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 3 \right)-f\left( -2 \right)$ (4).
Từ (3) và (4), ta được $f\left( 2 \right)-f\left( -3 \right)=f\left( 3 \right)-f\left( -2 \right)$ suy ra
$f\left( -2 \right)-f\left( 3 \right)=f\left( -3 \right)-f\left( 2 \right)=n-m$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;\pi \right]$. Biết $f\left( 0 \right)=2\text{e}$ và $f\left( x \right)$ thỏa mãn hệ thức $f'\left( x \right)+\sin x.f\left( x \right)=\cos x.\text{e}^{\cos x},\forall x\in\left[ 0;\pi \right]$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ (làm tròn đến hàng phần trăm).
loi_giai:
Giả thiết $f'\left( x \right)+\sin x.f\left( x \right)=\cos x.\text{e}^{\cos x}$ $\Leftrightarrow\text{e}^{-\cos x}.f'\left( x \right)+\text{e}^{-\cos x}.\sin x.f\left( x \right)=\cos x$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \text{e}^{-\cos x}.f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=\cos x$ $\Rightarrow\text{e}^{-\cos x}.f\left( x \right)=\sin x+C_{1}$ (1).
Do $f\left( 0 \right)=2\text{e}$, thế vào (1) ta được $C_{1}=2$ suy ra $f\left( x \right)=\left( 2+\sin x \right)\text{e}^{\cos x}$.
Dùng máy tính thì $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} \left( 2+\sin x \right).\text{e}^{\cos x}\text{d}x\approx 10,30532891$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương và có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ sao cho $f\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $f\left( x \right).f\left( 1-x \right)=e^{x^{2}-x}$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0;1 \right].$ Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( 2\text{x}^{3}-3\text{x}^{2} \right)f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}d\text{x}$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=2\text{x}^{3}-3\text{x}^{2} \\ dv=\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}d\text{x} \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=\left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)d\text{x} \\ v=\ln f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$ (do $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$)
Ta có $I=\left. \left( 2\text{x}^{3}-3\text{x}^{2} \right)\ln f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( x \right)d\text{x}$
$=\ln 1-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( x \right)d\text{x}=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( x \right)d\text{x}$.
Đặt $t=1-x\Rightarrow dt=-d\text{x}.$
Ta có $I=\int\limits_{1}^{0} \left[ 6\left( 1-t^{2} \right)-6\left( 1-t \right) \right]\ln f\left( 1-t \right)dt=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6t^{2}-6t \right)\ln f\left( 1-t \right)dt$
$=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( 1-x \right)d\text{x}.$
Suy ra,$2I=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( x \right)d\text{x}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( 1-x \right)d\text{x}$
$\begin{array}{l} \text{    }=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\left[ \ln f\left( x \right)+\ln f\left( 1-x \right) \right]d\text{x} \\ \text{    }=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\ln f\left( x \right).f\left( 1-x \right)d\text{x}=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 6\text{x}^{2}-6\text{x} \right)\mathrm{lne}^{x^{2}-x}d\text{x} \\ \text{    }=-6\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}-x \right)^{2}d\text{x}=-6\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{4}-2\text{x}^{3}+x^{2} \right)d\text{x}=-\frac{1}{5}. \end{array}$
Như vậy, $2I=-\frac{1}{5}\Rightarrow I=-\frac{1}{10}$

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương và thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=1$, $\left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}=e^{x}\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2},\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$.
Tính $f\left( 3 \right)$
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{3}=e^{x}\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2},\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\sqrt[3]{e^{x}}.\sqrt[3]{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}}=\sqrt[3]{e^{x}}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}}dx=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \sqrt[3]{e^{x}}dx\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}}df\left( x \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{3} e^{\frac{x}{3}}dx\Leftrightarrow\left. 3\sqrt[3]{f\left( x \right)} \right|_{0}^{3}=\left. 3e^{\frac{x}{3}} \right|_{0}^{3}$
$\sqrt[3]{f\left( 3 \right)}-\sqrt[3]{f\left( 0 \right)}=e-1\Leftrightarrow\sqrt[3]{f\left( 3 \right)}-1=e-1\Leftrightarrow f\left( 3 \right)=e^{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \tan xf\left( \cos^{2}x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{8} \frac{f\left( \sqrt[3]{x} \right)}{x}dx=6$. Tính tích phân $\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( x^{2} \right)}{x}dx$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $t=\cos x\Rightarrow dt=-\sin xdx\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \tan xf\left( \cos^{2}x \right)dx=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t^{2} \right)}{t}dt=6$.
Đặt $t^{2}=\sqrt[3]{x}\Rightarrow x=t^{6},dx=6t^{5}dt$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{8} \frac{f\left( \sqrt[3]{x} \right)}{x}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( t^{2} \right)}{t^{6}}.6t^{5}dt=6\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( t^{2} \right)}{t}dt=6\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( t^{2} \right)}{t}dt=1$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( x^{2} \right)}{x}dx=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( x^{2} \right)}{x}dx+\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{f\left( x^{2} \right)}{x}dx=6+1=7$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ dương và liên tục trên $\left[ 1\,;3 \right]$ thỏa mãn $\max\limits_{\left[ 1\,;3 \right]}f\left( x \right)=2$, $\min\limits_{\left[ 1\,;3 \right]}f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{3}$ và biểu thức $S=\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x.\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}x$ đạt giá trị lớn nhất. Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{8} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x+1} \right)}{\sqrt{x+1}}\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $\frac{1}{3}\le f\left( x \right)\le 2\Rightarrow\left( 3f\left( x \right)-1 \right)\left( f\left( x \right)-2 \right)\le 0$
$\Rightarrow 3f\left( x \right)+\frac{2}{f\left( x \right)}\le 7\Rightarrow\frac{1}{2}\le\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}\le\frac{7-3f\left( x \right)}{2}$.
Suy ra
$S\le\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x.\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{7-3f\left( x \right)}{2}\text{d}x\le\frac{2}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3}{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x.\left( 7-\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3f\left( x \right)}{2}\text{d}x \right)$
$\le\frac{2}{3}\left( \frac{\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3}{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+7-\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3f\left( x \right)}{2}\text{d}x}{2} \right)^{2}=\frac{49}{6}$.
Ta tìm được $\max S=\frac{49}{6}$, xảy ra khi $\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3f\left( x \right)}{2}\text{d}x=7-\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{3f\left( x \right)}{2}\text{d}x\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{7}{3}$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{8} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x+1} \right)}{\sqrt{x+1}}\text{d}x=2\int\limits_{0}^{8} f\left( \sqrt{x+1} \right)\text{d}\left( \sqrt{x+1} \right)=2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{14}{3}$.

noi_dung: Giả sử hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm cấp 2 trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=f'\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $f\left( 1-x \right)+x^{2}.f''\left( x \right)=2x$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f'\left( x \right) \\ dv=x\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{x^{2}}{2}f'\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Do $f\left( 1-x \right)+x^{2}.f''\left( x \right)=2x\Rightarrow\frac{x^{2}}{2}.f''\left( x \right)=x-\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1-x \right)$.
Vậy $I=\frac{1}{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ x-\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1-x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$.
Đặt $t=1-x$ suy ra $I=-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{1}^{0} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ dv=\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=x \end{array} \right.$
Suy ra$I=\frac{1}{2}\left[ xf\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.-\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)dx \right]\Leftrightarrow I=\frac{1}{2}\left( 1-I \right)\Leftrightarrow I=\frac{1}{3}$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ xác định và có đạo hàm $f'\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$,$f\left( x \right)\ne 0$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1\,;3 \right]$, đồng thời $f'\left( x \right)\left[ 1+f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=\left[ \left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=-1$. Biết rằng
$\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=a\ln 3+b\,\,\,\left( a\in\mathbb{Z},\,\,b\in\mathbb{Z} \right)$, tính tổng $S=a+b^{2}$.
loi_giai:
Với $x\in\left[ 1;\,\,3 \right]$ ta có: $f'\left( x \right)\left[ 1+f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=\left[ \left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)\left[ 1+f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{4}}=\left( x-1 \right)^{2}$.
$\,\,\,\Leftrightarrow\left( \frac{1}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{4}}+\frac{2}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}}+\frac{1}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}} \right)f'\left( x \right)=x^{2}-2x+1$
Suy ra: $-\frac{1}{3\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}}-\frac{1}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}-\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-x^{2}+x+C$ (lấy nguyên hàm hai vế).
Ta lại có:$f\left( 1 \right)=-1\Rightarrow\frac{1}{3}-1+1=\frac{1}{3}-1+1+C\Rightarrow C=0$.
Dẫn đến: $-\frac{1}{3}\left( \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)} \right)^{3}-\left( \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)} \right)^{2}-\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=-\frac{1}{3}\left( -x \right)^{3}-\left( -x \right)^{2}-\left( -x \right)\,\,\,\,\left( * \right)$.
Vì hàm số $g\left( t \right)=-\frac{1}{3}t^{3}-t^{2}-t$ nghịch biến trên $\mathbb{R}$ nên $\left( * \right)\Rightarrow\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=-x\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{1}{x}$.
Hàm số này thỏa các giả thiết của bài toán.
Do đó$\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( -\frac{1}{x} \right)\text{d}x=-\ln 3\Rightarrow a=-1,\,\,b=0$. Vậy $S=a+b^{2}=-1$.

loi: công thức hỏng hoặc có hình
noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số bậc 3 có đồ thị như hình vẽ bên.
[[img:image498.jpeg]]
Biết $\int\limits_{1}^{4} x.f''\left( x-1 \right)\text{d}x=7$ và$\int\limits_{1}^{2} 2x.f'\left( x^{2}-1 \right)\text{d}x=-3$. Phương trình tiếp tuyến với đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ tại điểm có hoành độ $x=3$ là
loi_giai:
Từ đồ thị ta có $f\left( 0 \right)=2$, $f'\left( 0 \right)=0$ (vì $x=0$ là điểm cực trị).
Từ giả thiết ta có
$-3=\int\limits_{1}^{2} 2xf'\left( x^{2}-1 \right)\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{2} f'\left( x^{2}-1 \right)\text{d}\left( x^{2}-1 \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{3} f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t=f\left( 3 \right)-f\left( 0 \right)\Rightarrow f\left( 3 \right)=-1$.
$7=\int\limits_{1}^{4} xf''\left( x-1 \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left[ \left( x-1 \right)+1 \right]f''\left( x-1 \right)\text{d}x=\int_{0}^{3} \left( t+1 \right)f''\left( t \right)\text{d}t$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=t+1 \\ dv=f''\left( t \right)\text{d}t \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\text{d}t \\ v=f\left( t \right) \end{array} \right.$.
$7=\left. \left( t+1 \right)f'\left( t \right) \right|_{0}^{3}-\int\limits_{0}^{3} f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t=4f'\left( 3 \right)-f'\left( 0 \right)+3$ $\Rightarrow f'\left( 3 \right)=1$.
Vậy phương trình tiếp tuyến tại điểm có hoành độ $x=3$ là $y=x-4$. Chọn#A.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 1;2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn: $f\left( 2 \right)=0,\,\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f^{\prime}(x) \right)^{2}dx=\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{2}{3}$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f(x)}{(x+1)^{2}}\,dx=-\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{3}{2}$. Tính tích phân $\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}dx=\left. -\frac{1}{x+1}f\left( x \right) \right|_{1}^{2}+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx=-\frac{1}{3}f\left( 2 \right)+\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1 \right)+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx$
Do $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ nên $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{x+1}dx+\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1 \right)=-\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{3}{2}$
Lại có $\int\limits_{1}^{2} f'\left( x \right)dx=f\left( 2 \right)-f\left( 1 \right)$ $\Rightarrow f\left( 1 \right)=-\int\limits_{1}^{2} f'\left( x \right)dx$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2} \right]f'\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{3}{2}$
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2} \right)^{2}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}-\frac{1}{x+1}+\frac{1}{4} \right)dx=\left. \left( -\frac{1}{x+1}-\ln\left| x+1 \right|+\frac{1}{4}x \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{2}{3}$
Vậy:
$\begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}dx+2\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2} \right]f'\left( x \right)dx+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2} \right)^{2}dx \\ =\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{2}{3}+2\left( -\frac{5}{12}-\ln\frac{2}{3} \right)+\frac{5}{12}+\ln\frac{2}{3}=0 \end{array}$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{x+1}-\frac{1}{2} \right)^{2}dx=0$ $\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{x+1}$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\ln\left| x+1 \right|+\frac{1}{2}x+\ln 3-1$
do $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\left. \left[ \frac{1}{4}x^{2}-x+x\ln 3-\left( \left( x+1 \right)\ln\left( x+1 \right)-\left( x+1 \right) \right) \right] \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{3}{4}+2\ln\frac{2}{3}$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số$f(x)$có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)\,\text{d}x=1$, $f\left( 1 \right)=\cot 1$.
Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right)\,\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
CÁCH 1:
Xét tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right)\,\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\,\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\tan x\,\text{d}x=I_{1}+I_{2}$.
Tính $I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\tan x\,\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\tan x \\ \text{d}v=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\text{d}u=\left( 1+\tan^{2}x \right)\text{d}x$, chọn $v=f\left( x \right)$.
Khi đó $I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\tan x\,\text{d}x=\left. f\left( x \right).\tan x \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\left( 1+\tan^{2}x \right)\text{d}x.$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow I_{2}=f\left( 1 \right).\tan 1-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\text{d}x. \\ \Rightarrow I_{2}=\cot 1.\tan 1-1-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\text{d}x=-I_{1}. \\ \Rightarrow I_{1}+I_{2}=0\Rightarrow I=0. \end{array}$
CÁCH 2:
Ta có
$\begin{array}{l} I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right)\,\text{d}x \\ \,\,\,\,=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\left( \frac{\,1}{\cos^{2}x}-1 \right)+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right)\text{d}x. \\ \,\,\,\,=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\frac{\,1}{\cos^{2}x}+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x. \\ \,\,\,\,=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f\left( x \right)\tan x \right)^{\prime}\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x. \\ \,\,\,\,=\left. \left( f\left( x \right)\tan x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-1=\cot 1.\tan 1-1=0 \end{array}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ có đạo hàm đến cấp hai liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$. Biết rằng các tiếp tuyến với đồ thị $y=f(x)$ tại các điểm có hoành độ $x=-1$; $x=0$; $x=1$ lần lượt tạo với chiều dương trục $Ox$ các góc $30{}^{\circ}$, $45{}^{\circ}$, $60{}^{\circ}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{-1}^{0} f'\left( x \right).f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{3}.f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x$?
loi_giai:
Hệ số góc của tiếp tuyến với đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ tại điểm có hoành độ $x=-1$ là
$f'\left( -1 \right)=\tan 30{}^{\circ}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$.
Hệ số góc của tiếp tuyến với đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ tại điểm có hoành độ $x=0$là
$f'\left( 0 \right)=\tan 45{}^{\circ}=1$
Hệ số góc của tiếp tuyến của đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ tại điểm có hoành độ $x=1$ là
$f'\left( 1 \right)=\tan 60{}^{\circ}=\sqrt{3}$.
Ta có
