$I=\int\limits_{-1}^{0} f'\left( x \right).f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{3}.f''\left( x \right)dx=\left. \frac{\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}{2} \right|_{-1}^{0}+\left. \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{4} \right|_{0}^{1}$
$=\frac{\left[ f'\left( 0 \right) \right]^{2}}{2}-\frac{\left[ f'\left( -1 \right) \right]^{2}}{2}+\left[ f'\left( 1 \right) \right]^{4}-\left[ f'\left( 0 \right) \right]^{4}=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{6}+9-1=\frac{25}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f(x)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \tan\,x.f\left( co\,s^{2}x \right)dx=1$, $\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{f(\ln^{2}x)}{x\ln x}dx=1$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f(2x)}{x}dx$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \tan\,x.f\left( co\,s^{2}x \right)dx=1=J$
Đặt $t=co\,s^{2}x\Rightarrow dt=-2\sin x.co\,sx.dx$
Đổi cận $x=0\Rightarrow t=1;\,\,x=\frac{\pi}{4}\Rightarrow t=\frac{1}{2}$
$\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt=1\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt=2$
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{f(\ln^{2}x)}{x\ln x}dx=1$
Đặt $t=\ln^{2}x\Rightarrow dt=2\ln x.\frac{1}{x}.dx$
Đổi cận $x=e\Rightarrow t=1;\,\,x=e^{2}\Rightarrow t=4$
$\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{f(\ln^{2}x)}{x\ln x}dx=1\Rightarrow\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{f(t)}{t}dt=1\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{f(t)}{t}dt=2$
$I=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f(2x)}{x}dx=2\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f(2x)}{2x}dx$
Đặt $t=2x\Rightarrow dt=2.dx$
Đổi cận $x=\frac{1}{4}\Rightarrow t=\frac{1}{2};\,\,x=2\Rightarrow t=4$
$I=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f(2x)}{x}dx=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{4} \frac{f(t)}{t}dx=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt+\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt=4$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ không âm, có đạo hàm trên đoạn $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=1$, $\left[ 2f\left( x \right)+1-x^{2} \right]f'\left( x \right)=2x\left[ 1+f\left( x \right) \right]$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Xét trên đoạn $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$, theo đề bài: $\left[ 2f\left( x \right)+1-x^{2} \right]f'\left( x \right)=2x\left[ 1+f\left( x \right) \right]$
$\Leftrightarrow 2f\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right)=2x+\left( x^{2}-1 \right).f'\left( x \right)+2x.f\left( x \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ f^{2}\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=\left[ x^{2}+\left( x^{2}-1 \right).f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}$
$\Leftrightarrow f^{2}\left( x \right)=x^{2}+\left( x^{2}-1 \right).f\left( x \right)+C$ $\left( 1 \right)$.
Thay $x=1$ vào $\left( 1 \right)$ ta được: $f^{2}\left( 1 \right)=1+C\Leftrightarrow C=0$ (vì $f\left( 1 \right)=1$).
Do đó, $\left( 1 \right)$ trở thành: $f^{2}\left( x \right)=x^{2}+\left( x^{2}-1 \right).f\left( x \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow f^{2}\left( x \right)-1=x^{2}-1+\left( x^{2}-1 \right).f\left( x \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ f\left( x \right)-1 \right].\left[ f\left( x \right)+1 \right]=\left( x^{2}-1 \right).\left[ f\left( x \right)+1 \right]$
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)-1=x^{2}-1$ (vì $f\left( x \right)\ge 0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)+1>0$ $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$)
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}\text{d}x=\left. \frac{x^{3}}{3} \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$ thỏa mãn $2xf'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2x$ $\forall x\in\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$, $f\left( 1 \right)=1$. Giá trị của biểu thức $f\left( 4 \right)$ là:
loi_giai:
Xét phương trình $2xf'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2x$ $\left( 1 \right)$ trên $\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$: $\left( 1 \right)\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{2x}\cdot f\left( x \right)=1$ $\left( 2 \right)$.
Đặt $g\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{2x}$, ta tìm một nguyên hàm $G\left( x \right)$ của $g\left( x \right)$.
Ta có $\int g\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int \frac{1}{2x}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\ln x+C=\ln\sqrt{x}+C$. Ta chọn $G\left( x \right)=\ln\sqrt{x}$.
Nhân cả 2 vế của $\left( 2 \right)$ cho $\text{e}^{G\left( x \right)}=\sqrt{x}$, ta được: $\sqrt{x}\cdot f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\cdot f\left( x \right)=\sqrt{x}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( \sqrt{x}.f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}=\sqrt{x}$ $\left( 3 \right)$.
Lấy tích phân 2 vế của $\left( 3 \right)$ từ $1$ đến 4, ta được: $\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left( \sqrt{x}.f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \sqrt{x}\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\left. \left( \sqrt{x}.f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{1}^{4}=\left. \left( \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}} \right) \right|_{1}^{4}\Rightarrow 2f\left( 4 \right)-f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{14}{3}\Rightarrow f\left( 4 \right)=\frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{14}{3}+1 \right)=\frac{17}{6}$ (vì $f\left( 1 \right)=1$).
Vậy $f\left( 4 \right)=\frac{17}{6}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $\sqrt{x^{3}+1}.\left[ 4x.f'\left( 1-x \right)-f\left( x \right) \right]=x^{5}$. Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ có kết quả dạng $\frac{a-b\sqrt{2}}{c}$, ($a,\,\,b,\,\,c\in\mathbb{Z},\,\,\frac{a}{c},\,\,\frac{b}{c}$ là phân số tối giản). Giá trị của biểu thức $T=a-2b+3c$ bằng
loi_giai:
Trên đoạn $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$, phương trình đã cho tương đương với: $4x.f'\left( 1-x \right)-f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{5}}{\sqrt{x^{3}+1}}$ $\left( 1 \right)$.
Lấy tích phân 2 vế của $\left( 1 \right)$ từ $0$ đến 1: $\underbrace{\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4x.f'\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x}_{J}-\underbrace{\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x}_{I}=\underbrace{\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{5}}{\sqrt{x^{3}+1}}\text{d}x}_{K}$ $\left( 2 \right)$.
 Để tính $K$, ta đặt $t=\sqrt{x^{3}+1}\Rightarrow t^{2}-1=x^{3}\Rightarrow 2t\text{d}t=3x^{2}\text{d}x\Rightarrow x^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{2}{3}t\text{d}t$.
Đổi cận: Với $x=0$ thì $t=1$. Với $x=1$ thì $t=\sqrt{2}$.
$\Rightarrow K=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{3}}{\sqrt{x^{3}+1}}\cdot x^{2}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \frac{t^{2}-1}{t}\cdot\frac{2t}{3}\text{d}t=\frac{2}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{\sqrt{2}} \left( t^{2}-1 \right)\text{d}t=\left. \frac{2}{3}\left( \frac{t^{3}}{3}-t \right) \right|_{1}^{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{4-2\sqrt{2}}{9}$.
 Để tính $J$, ta đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=4x \\ \text{d}v=f'\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=4\text{d}x \\ v=-f\left( 1-x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
$\Rightarrow J=\left. -4x.f\left( 1-x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$
$=-4f\left( 0 \right)+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$ (với $t=1-x$)
$=-4f\left( 0 \right)+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-4f\left( 0 \right)+4I$.
Thay $x=0$ vào $\left( 1 \right)$, ta được: $f\left( 0 \right)=0\Rightarrow J=4I$.
Do đó, $\left( 2 \right)$ trở thành $3I=\frac{4-2\sqrt{2}}{9}\Leftrightarrow I=\frac{4-2\sqrt{2}}{27}\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=4 \\ b=2 \\ c=27 \end{array} \right.$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm và liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn
$2f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right)=2x+1,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=1$. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
Lời giải
$2f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right)=2x+1,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$.
$\Leftrightarrow e^{2x}.2f\left( x \right)+e^{2x}.f'\left( x \right)=e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)\Leftrightarrow\left[ e^{2x}.f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)$.
$\int \left[ e^{2x}.f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}dx=\int e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)dx$.
Tìm $\int e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)dx$.
Đặt $u=2x+1\Rightarrow du=2dx$.
$dv=e^{2x}dx$ chọn $v=\frac{1}{2}e^{2x}$.
$\int e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)dx=\frac{1}{2}\left( 2x+1 \right)e^{2x}-\int e^{2x}dx=\frac{1}{2}e^{2x}.2x+C$.
Do đó ta suy ra $\int \left[ e^{2x}.f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}dx=\int e^{2x}\left( 2x+1 \right)dx\Leftrightarrow e^{2x}.f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{2}e^{2x}.2x+C$
$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\left( \frac{1}{2}e^{2x}.2x+C \right).\frac{1}{e^{2x}}$.
$f\left( 0 \right)=1\Rightarrow C=1$.
$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x+\frac{1}{e^{2x}}$.
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x+e^{-2x} \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{x^{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{2e^{2x}} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=1-\frac{1}{2e^{2}}$.

Cho đa thức bậc bốn $y=f\left( x \right)$ đạt cực trị tại $x=1$ và $x=2$. Biết $\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow\,0}\frac{2x+f'\left( x \right)}{2x}=2$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Hàm đa thức bậc bốn đạt cực trị tại $x=1$ và $x=2\Rightarrow f'\left( 1 \right)=f'\left( 2 \right)=0$.
mà $\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow\,0}\frac{2x+f'\left( x \right)}{2x}=2\Rightarrow\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2x}=1$. Giả sử $f'\left( 0 \right)\ne 0\Rightarrow\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow\,0}\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2x}$ bằng vô cực (vô lí).
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=0$.
$f\left( x \right)$ là hàm bậc bốn $\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)$ là hàm bậc ba, nên $f'\left( x \right)=ax\left( x-1 \right)\left( x-2 \right)$.
Theo đề bài ta có $\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow\,0}\frac{2x+ax\left( x-1 \right)\left( x-2 \right)}{2x}=2\Rightarrow\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow\,0}\frac{2+a\left( x-1 \right)\left( x-2 \right)}{2}=2\Leftrightarrow a=1$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\left( x-1 \right)\left( x-2 \right)dx=\frac{1}{4}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$xác định và có đạo hàm $f'(x)$ liên tục trên $[1;3]$; $f(x)\ne 0,\forall x\in[1;3];$ $f'(x)[1+f(x)]^{2}=(x-1)^{2}[f(x)]^{4}$ và $f(1)=-1$. Biết rằng $\int\limits_{e}^{3} f(x)\text{d}x=a\ln 3+b\,(a,b\in\mathbb{Z})$, giá trị của $a+b^{2}$ bằng
loi_giai:
Từ $f'(x)[1+f(x)]^{2}=(x-1)^{2}[f(x)]^{4}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'(x)}{f^{4}(x)}+\frac{2f'(x)}{f^{3}(x)}+\frac{f'(x)}{f^{2}(x)}=(x-1)^{2}$.
Hay $\int \left( \frac{f'(x)}{f^{4}(x)}+\frac{2f'(x)}{f^{3}(x)}+\frac{f'(x)}{f^{2}(x)} \right)\text{d}x=\int (x-1)^{2}\text{d}x\Rightarrow-\left( \frac{1}{3f^{3}(x)}+\frac{1}{f^{2}(x)}+\frac{1}{f(x)} \right)=\frac{1}{3}(x-1)^{3}+C$(2).
Do $f(1)=-1$ nên $C=\frac{1}{3}$. Thay vào (2) ta được $\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{3}=-(x-1)^{3}\Rightarrow f(x)=\frac{-1}{x}$.
Khi đó: $\int\limits_{e}^{3} \frac{-1}{x}\text{d}x=\left. -\ln\left| x \right| \right|_{e}^{3}=-\ln 3+1\Rightarrow a=-1,b=1$, nên $a+b^{2}=0$.
Cách khác
Từ $f'(x)[1+f(x)]^{2}=(x-1)^{2}[f(x)]^{4}\Leftrightarrow\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{2}.\frac{f'(x)}{f^{2}(x)}=(x-1)^{2}$.
$\Leftrightarrow-\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{2}.\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{/}=(x-1)^{2}$.
Nên $-\int \left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{2}.\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{/}\mathrm{d}x=\int (x-1)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\Rightarrow-\int \left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{2}\mathrm{d}\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)=\int (x-1)^{2}\mathrm{d}x$.
Suy ra $-\frac{1}{3}\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{3}=\frac{1}{3}\left( x-1 \right)^{3}+C$(2).
Do $f(1)=-1$ nên $C=0$. Thay vào (2) ta được $\left( \frac{1}{f(x)}+1 \right)^{3}=-(x-1)^{3}\Rightarrow f(x)=\frac{-1}{x}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1\,;2 \right]$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{3}$, $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=7$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\left( x-1 \right)^{2}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=\frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{3}}{3} \end{array} \right.$.
Khi đó, $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{3}f\left( x \right)}{3} \right|_{1}^{2}-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow-\frac{1}{3}=-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ (vì $f\left( 2 \right)=0$)
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=1$.
Ta lại có: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=7 \\ \int\limits_{1}^{2} 14\left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=14 \\ \int\limits_{1}^{2} 49\left( x-1 \right)^{6}\text{d}x=\left. 7\left( x-1 \right)^{7} \right|_{1}^{2}=7 \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x-\int\limits_{1}^{2} 14\left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{1}^{2} 49\left( x-1 \right)^{6}\text{d}x=0$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-7\left( x-1 \right)^{3} \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$ $\left( 1 \right)$, mà $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-7\left( x-1 \right)^{3} \right]^{2}\text{d}x\ge 0$.
nên $\left( 1 \right)\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)-7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}=0\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}+C$.
Mà $f\left( 2 \right)=0\Leftrightarrow\frac{7}{4}+C=0\Leftrightarrow C=-\frac{7}{4}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{7}{4}\left[ \left( x-1 \right)^{4}-1 \right]$.
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{7}{4}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \left( x-1 \right)^{4}-1 \right]\text{d}x=\left. \frac{7}{4}\left[ \frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{5}}{5}-x \right] \right|_{1}^{2}=-\frac{7}{5}$.
Vậy $I=-\frac{7}{5}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $3f'\left( x \right).\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)-x^{2}-1}-\frac{2x}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=0$ với $\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Biết $f\left( 0 \right)=1$, tính tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $3f'\left( x \right).\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)-x^{2}-1}-\frac{2x}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=0$$\Leftrightarrow$$3f^{2}\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right).\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=2x.\text{e}^{x^{2}+1}$
$\Rightarrow\int 3f^{2}\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right).\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\int 2x.\text{e}^{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow\int \text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}\text{d}\left( f^{3}\left( x \right) \right)=\int \text{e}^{x^{2}+1}\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)$ $\Rightarrow\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=\text{e}^{x^{2}+1}+C$. Mặt khác, vì $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ nên $C=0$.
Do đó $\text{e}^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=\text{e}^{x^{2}+1}$$\Leftrightarrow f^{3}\left( x \right)=x^{2}+1$$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}\,\text{d}x$$=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} \sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}\,\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)$$=\frac{3}{8}\left. \left[ \left( x^{2}+1 \right)\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1} \right] \right|_{0}^{\sqrt{7}}$$=\frac{45}{8}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục và có đạo hàm trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $3f^{2}\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right)-4x.e^{-f^{3}\left( x \right)+2x^{2}+x+1}=1=f\left( 0 \right)$. Biết rằng $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{-1+\sqrt{4089}}{4}} \left( 4x+1 \right)f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{a}{b}$ là phân số tối giản. Tính $T=a-3b$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $3f^{2}\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right)-4x.e^{-f^{3}\left( x \right)+2x^{2}+x+1}=1\Leftrightarrow 3f^{2}\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-4x.e^{2x^{2}+x+1}=e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-e^{2x^{2}+x+1} \right)^{\prime}=e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-e^{2x^{2}+x+1}\Leftrightarrow\left( \ln\left| e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-e^{2x^{2}+x+1} \right| \right)^{\prime}=1$
$\Rightarrow\int \left( \ln\left| e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-e^{2x^{2}+x+1} \right| \right)^{\prime}\text{d}x=\int \text{d}x\Rightarrow e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-e^{2x^{2}+x+1}=C.e^{x}$.
Với $x=0$$\Rightarrow e^{f^{3}\left( 0 \right)}-e=C\Rightarrow C=0$ (vì $f\left( 0 \right)=1$)$\Rightarrow e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=e^{2x^{2}+x+1}\Leftrightarrow f^{3}\left( x \right)=2x^{2}+x+1$.
Do đó $f\left( x \right)=\sqrt[3]{2x^{2}+x+1}\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{-1+\sqrt{4089}}{4}} \left( 4x+1 \right)\sqrt[3]{2x^{2}+x+1}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $t=\sqrt[3]{2x^{2}+x+1}\Leftrightarrow t^{3}=2x^{2}+x+1\Rightarrow 3t^{2}\text{d}t=\left( 4x+1 \right)\text{d}x.$ Đổi cận $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=0\Rightarrow t=1 \\ x=\frac{-1+\sqrt{4089}}{4}\Rightarrow t=8 \end{array} \right..$
Khi đó $I=\int\limits_{1}^{8} \text{3t}^{3}\text{dt}=\frac{12285}{4}$. Suy ra $a=12285\,,\,\,b=4\Rightarrow T=12273$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$, thỏa mãn $\left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}+4f\left( x \right)=8x^{2}+4,\,\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=2$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Có $\left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}+4f\left( x \right)=8x^{2}+4\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 8x^{2}+4 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{20}{3}$. (1)
Ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x\Rightarrow-4\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-8+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$. (2)
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 2x \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{4}{3}$. (3)
Cộng vế với vế của (1), (2), (3) ta được $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)-2x \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=2x\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}+C$.
Có $f\left( 1 \right)=C+1=2\Rightarrow C=1\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}+1$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x^{2}+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{4}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ thoả mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=5$ và $2xf'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=6x$ với mọi $x>0$. Tính $\int\limits_{4}^{9} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $2xf'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=6x\Rightarrow\sqrt{x}.f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}.f\left( x \right)=3\sqrt{x}$.
$\Rightarrow\left( \sqrt{x}.f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}=3\sqrt{x}\Rightarrow\int \left( \sqrt{x}.f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}\text{d}x=3\int \sqrt{x}\text{d}x\Rightarrow\sqrt{x.}f\left( x \right)=2x\sqrt{x}+C\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=2x+\frac{C}{\sqrt{x}}.$Mặt khác $f\left( 1 \right)=5\Rightarrow 2+C=5\Rightarrow C=3$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=2x+\frac{3}{\sqrt{x}}$.
Khi đó $\int\limits_{4}^{9} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{4}^{9} \left( 2x+\frac{3}{\sqrt{x}} \right)\text{d}x=71$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ x.f'\left( 1-x \right)-f\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}$, tính $f\left( 0 \right)$.
loi_giai:
+ Xét $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ f'\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=\text{d}v \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\text{d}x \\ v=-f\left( 1-x \right) \end{array} \right.$
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=\left. -xf\left( 1-x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=-f\left( 0 \right)+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$
+ Xét $J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $t=1-x\Rightarrow dt=-dx$.
Đổi cận
$J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{1}^{0} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Do đó $I=-f\left( 0 \right)+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=-f\left( 0 \right)+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Như vậy, $\frac{1}{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ x.f'\left( 1-x \right)-f\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=-f\left( 0 \right)+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x\Rightarrow f\left( 0 \right)=-\frac{1}{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1\,;2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{21}$, $f\left( 1 \right)=0$, $\int_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}$. Tính $\int_{1}^{2} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{21}$.
Đặt: $u=f\left( x \right)\Rightarrow\text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$; $\text{d}v=\left( x-2 \right)^{2}\text{d}x\Rightarrow v=\frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{3}}{3}$.
$\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{3}}{3}f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{1}^{2}-\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{3}}{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
= $-\int_{1}^{2} \frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{3}}{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
$\Rightarrow\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}$.
Do đó, $\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}$
Mà $\int_{1}^{2} \left( x-2 \right)^{6}\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{7}}{7} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{1}{7}$.
Vậy, $\int_{1}^{2} \left( \left( x-2 \right)^{6}-2\left( x-2 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)+\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2} \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}-\frac{2}{7}+\frac{1}{7}=0$
$\Rightarrow\int_{1}^{2} \left( \left( x-2 \right)^{3}-f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0\Rightarrow\left( x-2 \right)^{3}-f'\left( x \right)=0$
$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{4}}{4}+C$.
Mà $f\left( 1 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=\frac{-1}{4}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{4}}{4}-\frac{1}{4}$.
$\int_{1}^{2} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\int_{1}^{2} \left( x\left( x-2 \right)^{4}-x \right)\text{d}x$$=\frac{1}{4}\int_{1}^{2} \left( \left( x-2 \right)^{5}+2\left( x-2 \right)^{4}-x \right)\text{d}x$$=\frac{1}{4}\left. \left( \frac{\left( x-2 \right)^{6}}{6}+\frac{2\left( x-2 \right)^{5}}{5}-\frac{1}{2}x^{2} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}$
$=\frac{1}{4}\left( -2-\frac{1}{6}+\frac{2}{5}+\frac{1}{2} \right)=-\frac{19}{60}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị không âm và liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]\,$. Đặt $g\left( x \right)=1+2\int\limits_{0}^{x} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$. Biết $g\left( x \right)\ge\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\text{d}x$ có giá trị lớn nhất bằng
loi_giai:
Gọi $F\left( x \right)$ là một hàm số thoả mãn $F\left( x \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{x} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} F'\left( x \right)=f\left( x \right) \\ g\left( x \right)=1+2F\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
Ta có $1+2F\left( x \right)=g\left( x \right)\ge\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}\Rightarrow\frac{f\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{1+2F\left( x \right)}}\le 1\Rightarrow\frac{F'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{1+2F\left( x \right)}}-1\le 0$.
Xét $\frac{F'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{1+2F\left( x \right)}}=1\Rightarrow\int \frac{F'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{1+2F\left( x \right)}}\text{d}x=\int \text{d}x\Rightarrow\frac{1}{2}\int \left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)^{-\frac{1}{3}}\text{d}\left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)=x+C$
$\Rightarrow\frac{3}{4}.\sqrt[3]{\left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}=x+C$.
Xét hàm số $h\left( x \right)=\frac{3}{4}.\sqrt[3]{\left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}-\left( x+C \right),\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$.
Ta có $h'\left( x \right)=\frac{F'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{1+2F\left( x \right)}}-1\le 0$ nên $h\left( x \right)$ nghịch biến trên $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$.
Do đó $h\left( x \right)\le h\left( 0 \right)=\frac{3}{4}.\sqrt[3]{\left( 1+2F\left( 0 \right) \right)^{2}}-C$.
Ta có $F\left( 0 \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{0} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=0$ nên $h\left( x \right)\le\frac{3}{4}-C$. Ta chọn $C$sao cho $\frac{3}{4}-C=0\Rightarrow C=\frac{3}{4}$.
Khi đó $\frac{3}{4}.\sqrt[3]{\left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}\le x+\frac{3}{4}\Rightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left( 1+2F\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}\le\frac{4}{3}x+1\Rightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\le\frac{4}{3}x+1$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\text{d}x\le\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{4}{3}x+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{5}{3}$.
Cách khác.
Với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ta có $g\left( x \right)=1+2\int\limits_{0}^{x} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} g\left( x \right)\ge 1 \\ g\left( 0 \right)=1 \\ g'\left( x \right)=2f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $g\left( x \right)\ge\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{3}\Rightarrow g\left( x \right)\ge\left[ \frac{1}{2}g'\left( x \right) \right]^{3}\Rightarrow\frac{g'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt[3]{g\left( x \right)}}\le 2$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{x} \frac{g'\left( t \right)}{\sqrt[3]{g\left( t \right)}}\text{d}t\le\int\limits_{0}^{x} 2\text{d}t\Rightarrow\frac{3}{2}\left[ \sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}-1 \right]\le 2x$
$\Rightarrow\sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\le\frac{4}{3}x+1\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\text{d}x\le\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{4}{3}x+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{5}{3}$.
Dấu bằng xảy ra khi $g\left( x \right)=\sqrt{\left( \frac{4}{3}x+1 \right)^{3}}$.
Vậy $\max\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt[3]{\left[ g\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}\text{d}x=\frac{5}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương thỏa mãn $f'\left( x \right)=\frac{2f\left( x \right)}{x}+2x^{3}$, $\forall x\in\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$ và $\int\limits_{2}^{3} \frac{x^{5}}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{20}$. Giá trị của biểu thức $f\left( 2 \right)+f\left( 3 \right)$ bằng
loi_giai:
Với $x\in\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$:
Ta có $f'\left( x \right)=\frac{2f\left( x \right)}{x}+2x^{3}$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{x^{2}f'\left( x \right)-2xf\left( x \right)}{x^{4}}=2x$$\Leftrightarrow\left( \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}} \right)^{\prime}=2x$
$\Rightarrow\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}=x^{2}+C$$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}\left( x^{2}+C \right)$.
$\Leftrightarrow f^{2}\left( x \right)=x^{4}\left( x^{2}+C \right)^{2}$.
Khi đó $\int\limits_{2}^{3} \frac{x^{5}}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{20}$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{2}^{3} \frac{x}{\left( x^{2}+C \right)^{2}}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{20}$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{2}^{3} \frac{\text{d}\left( x^{2}+C \right)}{\left( x^{2}+C \right)^{2}}=\frac{1}{20}$ $\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{2}^{3} \frac{\text{d}\left( x^{2}+C \right)}{\left( x^{2}+C \right)^{2}}=\frac{1}{10}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left. -\frac{1}{x^{2}+C} \right|_{2}^{3}=\frac{1}{10}$ $\Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{4+C}-\frac{1}{9+C}=\frac{1}{10}$$\Leftrightarrow C^{2}+13C-14=0$$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \begin{array}{l} C=1 \\ C=-14 \end{array} \right.$.
+ Với $C=-14$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}\left( x^{2}-14 \right)$.
Chọn $x=1\in\left( 0\,;\,+\infty \right)$ ta được $f\left( 1 \right)=-13<0$ (vô lý vì $f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số dương).
+ Với $C=1$ $\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x^{2}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)$ là hàm số dương.
Khi đó $f\left( 2 \right)+f\left( 3 \right)=110$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn: $3f(x)+f(2-x)=2(x-1)e^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tính giá trị của tích phân$I\,=\int_{0}^{2} f(x)dx$.
loi_giai:
Cách 1:
$3f(x)+\mathrm{f}(2-x)=2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$.
$\Rightarrow 3\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x+\int_{0}^{2} f(2-x)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} (2x-2)e^{x^{2}-2x+1}\text{d}x+4\int\limits_{0}^{2} \text{d}x\,\,(1)$.
Đặt $t=2-x\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{2} f(2-x)\text{d}(x)=-\int_{2}^{0} f(t)\text{d}t=\int_{0}^{2} f(t)\text{d}t=\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x\,\,(2)$.
Đặt $u=x^{2}-2x+1\Rightarrow\text{d}u=(2x-2)\text{d}x\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} (2x-2)e^{x^{2}-2x+1}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{1} e^{u}\text{d}u=0\,\,(3)$.
Thay $(2)$và $(3)$vào $(1)$$\Rightarrow 4\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x=4\int\limits_{0}^{2} \text{d}x$$\Rightarrow I=\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x=2$. Chọn phương án$C$.
Cách 2: Do $3f(x)+\mathrm{f}(2-x)=2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\,\,(1)$
Thay $x=2-x$ vào $(1)$ ta có: $3f(2-x)+f(x)=-2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\,\,(2)$
Từ $(1)$ và $(2)$ ta có hệ phương trình: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3f(x)+\mathrm{f}(2-x)=2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R} \\ f(x)+3f(2-x)=-2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\,\,\,\, \end{array} \right.$
$\Leftrightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 9f(x)+3\mathrm{f}(2-x)=6(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+12 \\ f(x)+3f(2-x)=-2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+4\,\,\,\, \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow f(x)=2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+1$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 2(\mathrm{x}-1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-2x+1}+1 \right)\text{d}x=2$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$, thỏa mãn $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \tan x.f\left( \cos^{2}x \right)\mathrm{d}x=2$ và $\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{\mathrm{e}^{2}} \frac{f\left( \ln x^{2} \right)}{x\ln x}\mathrm{d}x=2$. Tính $\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f\left( 2x \right)}{x}\mathrm{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $t=\cos^{2}x$ suy ra $\mathrm{d}t=-2\sin x.\cos x\mathrm{d}\text{x}$.
Suy ra$I_{1}=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \tan x.f\left( \cos^{2}x \right)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}.f\left( \cos^{2}x \right)\mathrm{d}x=-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{-2\sin x\cos x}{\cos^{2}x}.f\left( \cos^{2}x \right)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}\mathrm{d}t$Đặt $t=\ln^{2}x$ suy ra $\mathrm{d}t=2\frac{\ln x}{x}\mathrm{d}x$.
Suy ra $I_{2}=\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{\mathrm{e}^{2}} \frac{f\left( \ln^{2}x \right)}{x\ln x}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{\mathrm{e}^{2}} \frac{2\ln x.f\left( \ln^{2}x \right)}{x\ln^{2}x}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{4} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}\mathrm{d}t$.
Đặt $t=2x$ suy ra $\mathrm{d}t=2\mathrm{d}x$.
Ta có $I=\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f\left( 2x \right)}{x}\mathrm{d}x=\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{2} \frac{f\left( 2x \right)}{2x}\mathrm{d}\left( 2x \right)=\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{4} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}\mathrm{d}\left( t \right)=\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}\mathrm{d}t+\int_{1}^{4} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}\mathrm{d}t=2\left( I_{1}+I_{2} \right)=2\left( 2+2 \right)=8.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ và $f\left( 0 \right)+f\left( 1 \right)=0$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{2}\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2},\text{ }\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\text{cos}\left( \pi x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{2}$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Xét tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\text{cos}\left( \pi x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{2}$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\cos\left( \pi x \right) \\ dv=f'\left( x \right)dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=-\pi\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$, ta có
$I=\left. f\left( x \right)\cos\left( \pi x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+\pi\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx=-f\left( 1 \right)-f\left( 0 \right)+\pi\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx=\pi\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx$
Mà $I=\frac{\pi}{2}\Leftrightarrow\pi\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx=\frac{\pi}{2}\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)dx=\frac{1}{2}$
Mặt khác: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sin^{2}\left( \pi x \right)dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ 1-\cos\left( 2\pi x \right) \right]dx=\left. \frac{1}{2}\left[ x-\frac{1}{2\pi}\sin\left( 2\pi x \right) \right] \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{2}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f^{2}\left( x \right)-2.f\left( x \right)\sin\left( \pi x \right)+\sin^{2}\left( \pi x \right) \right]dx=\frac{1}{2}-2.\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2}=0$.
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right)-\sin\left( \pi x \right) \right]^{2}dx=0$
Vì $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ và $\left[ f\left( x \right)-\sin\left( \pi x \right) \right]^{2}\ge 0,\forall x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]$ nên ta suy ra $f\left( x \right)-\sin\left( \pi x \right)=0\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=\sin\left( \pi x \right)$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sin\left( \pi x \right)dx=\left. -\frac{1}{\pi}\cos\left( \pi x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{2}{\pi}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số y = f(x) có đạo hàm liên tục trên (0; 1) thỏa mãn f(0) = 0 và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{2}(x)\mathrm{d}\text{x}=\frac{9}{2}$; $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'(x).\cos\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx}=\frac{3\pi}{4}$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)\mathrm{dx}$ bằng:
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'(x).\cos\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx}=\frac{3\pi}{4}$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{cos}\frac{\pi x}{2}=u \\ f'(x)\mathrm{dx}=\mathrm{dv} \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=-\frac{\pi}{2}.\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx} \\ v=f(x) \end{array} \right.$
Suy ra: [[EQ-FAILED:oleObject961.bin:template sel=22 var=0x0070: expected 3 slots (main, lower, upper), got 4]].
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow\frac{3\pi}{4}=\cos\frac{\pi}{2}.f(1)-\cos 0.f(0)+\frac{\pi}{2}.\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x).\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx}. \\ \Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x).\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx}=\frac{3}{2}. \end{array}$ [[eq-empty:oleObject963.bin]]
Theo đề: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{2}(x)\mathrm{dx}=\frac{9}{2}$.
Mặt khác: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sin^{2}\frac{\pi x}{2}\text{dx}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{1-\cos\pi x}{2}\text{dx}=\frac{1}{2}\left( x-\frac{\sin(\pi x)}{\pi} \right)\left| \underset{0}{\overset{1}{}} \right.=\frac{1}{2}$.
Nên ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f^{2}(x)-6f(\mathrm{x}).\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}+9\sin^{2}\frac{\pi x}{2} \right]\text{dx}=\frac{9}{2}-6.\frac{3}{2}+9.\frac{1}{2}=0$.
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f(\mathrm{x})-3\sin\frac{\pi x}{2} \right)^{2}\text{dx}=0$.
Do hàm số $y=f(x)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên (0; 1) nên $f(\mathrm{x})=3\sin\frac{\pi x}{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$có đạo hàm trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$ thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)=x.\ln\left( \frac{x^{3}}{x.f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)} \right)$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=0$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{1}^{5} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Từ giả thiết và $f\left( x \right)=x.\ln\left( \frac{x^{3}}{x.f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)} \right)$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}=\ln\frac{x^{3}}{x.f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)}$
$\Leftrightarrow\text{e}^{\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}}=\frac{x^{3}}{x.f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)}$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{x.f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}.\text{e}^{\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}}=x$$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x} \right]^{\prime}.\text{e}^{\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}}=x$ (1)
Lấy nguyên hàm hai vế của (1) suy ra $\text{e}^{\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}}=\frac{x^{2}}{2}+C$.
Do $f\left( 1 \right)=0$$\Rightarrow$$C=\frac{1}{2}$, nên$\text{e}^{\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}}=\frac{x^{2}+1}{2}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x\ln\frac{x^{2}+1}{2}$ với $x\in\left( 0;+\infty \right)$.
$I=\int\limits_{1}^{5} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{5} x.\ln\frac{x^{2}+1}{2}\text{d}x$ (2).
Đặt $u=\ln\frac{x^{2}+1}{2}\Rightarrow\text{d}u=\frac{2x}{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$; $\text{d}v=x\text{d}x$, chọn $v=\frac{x^{2}+1}{2}$.
Theo công thức tích phân từng phần, ta được:
$I=\left. \left( \frac{x^{2}+1}{2}.\ln\frac{x^{2}+1}{2} \right) \right|_{1}^{5}-\int\limits_{1}^{5} x\text{d}x=13\ln 13-\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2} \right|_{1}^{5}$$=13\ln 13-12$.

noi_dung: Hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm cấp hai trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn: $f^{2}\left( 1-x \right)=\left( x^{2}+3 \right).f\left( x+1 \right)\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Biết $f\left( x \right)\ne 0\,,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$, tính $I=\int_{0}^{2} \left( 2x-1 \right)f"\left( x \right).\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt: $u=2x-1\Rightarrow\text{d}u=2\text{d}x$,
$\text{d}v=f"\left( x \right)\text{d}x\Rightarrow v=f'\left( x \right)$.
$I=\int_{0}^{2} \left( 2x-1 \right)f"\left( x \right).\text{d}x=\left. \left( 2x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int_{0}^{2} 2f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-\left. 2f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-2f\left( 2 \right)+2f\left( 0 \right)$(*).
Ta có: $f^{2}\left( 1-x \right)=\left( x^{2}+3 \right).f\left( x+1 \right)\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$
Ta lấy:
* $x=1\Rightarrow f^{2}\left( 0 \right)=4.f\left( 2 \right)$.
* $x=-1\Rightarrow f^{2}\left( 2 \right)=4.f\left( 0 \right)\Rightarrow f^{4}\left( 2 \right)=64.f\left( 2 \right)$.
Mà theo đề $f\left( x \right)\ne 0\,,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\Rightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=4$.
Vậy, ta có: $f\left( 2 \right)=f\left( 0 \right)=4$(1).
Ta có: $-2f'\left( 1-x \right)f\left( 1-x \right)=2x.f\left( x+1 \right)\,+\left( x^{2}+3 \right).f'\left( x+1 \right)$.
Ta lấy:
$x=1\Rightarrow-2f'\left( 0 \right)f\left( 0 \right)=2f\left( 2 \right)+4f'\left( 2 \right)\Rightarrow f'\left( 2 \right)+2f'\left( 0 \right)=-2$.$x=-1\Rightarrow-2f'\left( 2 \right)f\left( 2 \right)=-2f\left( 0 \right)+4f'\left( 0 \right)\Rightarrow 2f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)=2$.
Vậy, ta có: $f'\left( 0 \right)=-2$, $f'\left( 2 \right)=2$(2).
Thế (1) và (2) vào (*), suy ra $I=\int_{0}^{2} \left( 2x-1 \right)f"\left( x \right).\text{d}x=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-2f\left( 2 \right)+2f\left( 0 \right)$
$=3.2-2-2.4+2.4=4$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( \tan\,x \right)\text{d}x=4$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x=2$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Có $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} f\left( \tan\,x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t^{2}+1}\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}\text{dx=4;}$
Đặt $t=\tan\,x;\text{d}t=\left( \tan^{2}x+1 \right)\text{d}x;\text{d}x=\frac{\text{d}t}{t^{2}+1}$ và đổi cận $\begin{array}{l|ll} x & 0 & \frac{\pi}{4} \\ \hline  &  &  \\ t & 0 & 1 \end{array}$
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{\left( x^{2}+1 \right)f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2}f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x=4+2=6$.

loi: công thức hỏng hoặc có hình
noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $3f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right)\ge x^{2018}$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$. Tìm giá trị nhỏ nhất của $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$3f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right)\ge x^{2018}$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;1 \right]$$\Leftrightarrow 3x^{2}f\left( x \right)+x^{3}.f'\left( x \right)\ge x^{2020}$$\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( x^{3}f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}\ge x^{2020}$, [[img:image1015.wmf]]
$\Rightarrow x^{3}f\left( x \right)\ge\int_{}^{} x^{2020}\text{d}x$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$$\Rightarrow x^{3}f\left( x \right)\ge\frac{x^{2021}}{2021}+C$, $\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$.
Cho $x=0\Rightarrow$ $C=0$$\Rightarrow x^{3}f\left( x \right)\ge\frac{x^{2021}}{2021}$,$\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)\ge\frac{x^{2018}}{2021},\,\forall x\in\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$.
$\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x\ge\int_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{2018}}{2021}\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{x^{2019}}{2019.2021} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{2019.2021}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0;\,\,-1 \right\}$ thỏa mãn điều kiện $f\left( 1 \right)=2\ln 2$ và $x\left( x+1 \right).f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=x^{2}+3x+2$. Giá trị $f\left( 2 \right)=a+b\ln 3$, với$a,\,b\in\mathbb{Q}$. Tính $a^{2}+b^{2}$.
loi_giai:
Do hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0;\,\,-1 \right\}$ nên
$x\left( x+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=x^{2}+3x+2$
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow\frac{x}{x+1}f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}f\left( x \right)=\frac{x+2}{x+1} \\ \Leftrightarrow\left( \frac{x}{x+1}f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}=\frac{x+2}{x+1} \end{array}$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{x}{x+1}f\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{x+2}{x+1}dx \\ \Leftrightarrow\left. \left( \frac{x}{x+1}f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=1+\ln\frac{3}{2} \\ \Leftrightarrow\frac{2}{3}f\left( 2 \right)-\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1 \right)=1+\ln\frac{3}{2} \\ \Leftrightarrow\frac{2}{3}f\left( 2 \right)-\ln 2=1+\ln\frac{3}{2}\Leftrightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=\frac{3}{2}+\frac{3}{2}\ln 3. \end{array}$
$\Rightarrow a=b=\frac{3}{2}\Rightarrow a^{2}+b^{2}=\frac{9}{2}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\text{[}0;1]$ thỏa mãn $f(1)=3,\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{4}{11}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f(x)dx=\frac{7}{11}$. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx$ là:
loi_giai:
Xét $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f(x)dx=\frac{7}{11}$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f(x) \\ dv=x^{4}dx \end{array}\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'(x)dx \\ v=\frac{x^{5}}{5} \end{array} \right. \right.$
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f(x)dx=\left. \left( \frac{x^{5}}{5}.f(x) \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{5}}{5}.f'(x)dx=\frac{7}{11}$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{5}}{5}.f'(x)dx=\frac{f(1)}{5}-\frac{7}{11}=\frac{-2}{55}$
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x^{5}}{5} \right)^{2}dx=\frac{1}{275}$
Ta có:
$\begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx+2.10.\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{5}}{5}.f'(x)dx+10^{2}.\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{x^{5}}{5} \right)^{2}dx=0 \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'(x)+2x^{5} \right]^{2}dx=0 \\ \Rightarrow f'(x)=-2x^{5} \end{array}$
Do đó $f(x)=\frac{-x^{6}}{3}+C$. Mà $f(1)=3$ nên $f(x)=\frac{-x^{6}}{3}+\frac{10}{3}$
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1} (-x^{6}+10)dx=\frac{23}{7}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ với $f\left( 0 \right)=f\left( 1 \right)=1.$ Biết rằng: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx=ae+b,$ $a,b\in\mathbb{Z}.$ Giá trị biểu thức $a^{2019}+b^{2019}$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}.f\left( x \right)dx+\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}.f'\left( x \right)dx=I_{1}+I_{2}$
Xét:$I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}.f'\left( x \right)dx$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=e^{x} \\ dv=f'(x)dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=e^{x}dx \\ v=f(x) \end{array} \right.$ khi đó:
$I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}.f'\left( x \right)dx=\left. e^{x}.f(x) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}.f\left( x \right)dx=e.f(1)-f(0)-I_{1}=e-1-I_{1}$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x}\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx=I_{1}+I_{2}=I_{1}+e-1-I_{1}=e-1$.
Suy ra: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=1 \\ b=-1 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow a^{2019}+b^{2019}=1^{2019}+\left( -1 \right)^{2019}=1-1=0$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$ thỏa mãn:$f\left( 4-x \right)=f\left( x \right)$, $\forall x\in\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{3} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2$. Gía trị $2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng:
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( 4-x \right)=f\left( x \right)$ và$\int\limits_{1}^{3} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} xf\left( 4-x \right)\text{d}x=-2$.
Xét $I=\int\limits_{1}^{3} xf\left( 4-x \right)\text{d}x=-2$:
Đặt $t=4-x$ ta được $x=4-t$$\Rightarrow\text{d}x=-\text{d}t$.
Khi $x=1$thì $t=3$, khi $x=3$thì $t=1$.
Suy ra $I=\int\limits_{1}^{3} xf\left( 4-x \right)\text{d}x=-2$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( 4-t \right)f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=-2$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} 4f\left( t \right)\text{d}t-\int\limits_{1}^{3} tf\left( t \right)\text{d}t=-2$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} 4f\left( t \right)\text{d}t+2=-2$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=-1$$\Rightarrow 2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị không âm và có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f'\left( x \right)=\left( 2x+1 \right)\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2},\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=-1$. Giá trị của tích phân $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
$\begin{array}{l} f'\left( x \right)=\left( 2x+1 \right)\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2},\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\Rightarrow\frac{-f'\left( x \right)}{\left[ f\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}=-\left( 2x+1 \right),\forall x\in\mathbb{R} \\ \Rightarrow\left( \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)} \right)^{\prime}=-\left( 2x+1 \right),\forall x\in\mathbb{R} \end{array}$
Vậy $\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=-\int \left( 2x+1 \right)\text{d}x=-x^{2}-x+C\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{-x^{2}-x+C}$.
Do $f\left( 0 \right)=-1\Rightarrow C=-1$. Vậy $f\left( x \right)=-\frac{1}{x^{2}+x+1}$.
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{x^{2}+x+1}\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{\left( x+\frac{1}{2} \right)^{2}+\frac{3}{4}}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $x+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\tan t,\,\,t\in\left( \frac{-\pi}{2}\,;\,\frac{\pi}{2} \right)$. Suy ra $I=-\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\left( 1+\tan^{2}t \right)}{\frac{3}{4}\left( 1+\tan^{2}t \right)}\text{dt}=-\frac{2\sqrt{3}}{3}\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \text{dt}=-\frac{\pi\sqrt{3}}{9}.$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $f(x)$ liên tục trên $\left[ -1;2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn điều kiện $f(x)=\sqrt{x+2}+xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)$.
Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{-1}^{2} f(x)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có$I=\int\limits_{-1}^{2} \left[ \sqrt{x+2}+xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right) \right]\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{-1}^{2} \sqrt{x+2}\text{d}x+\int\limits_{-1}^{2} xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$ $=\frac{14}{3}+\int\limits_{-1}^{2} xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$.
Xét $\int\limits_{-1}^{2} xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$ đặt $t=3-x^{2}$ $\Rightarrow\text{d}t=-2x\text{d}x\Rightarrow x\text{d}x=-\frac{\text{d}t}{2}$.
Đổi cận khi $x=-1\Rightarrow t=2$; $x=2\Rightarrow t=-1$. Suy ra $\int\limits_{-1}^{2} xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{2}^{-1} f(t)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-1}^{2} f(t)\text{d}t$.

noi_dung: Cho $f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=-\frac{1}{18}$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{36}$. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ dv=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\text{d}x \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$, khi đó ta có
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} x.f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. x.f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 1 \right)-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{36}$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 1 \right)-\frac{1}{36}=-\frac{1}{12}$.
Khi đó $I=\frac{14}{3}+\int\limits_{-1}^{2} xf\left( 3-x^{2} \right)dx$$=\frac{14}{3}+\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-1}^{2} f(t)\text{d}t=\frac{14}{3}+\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{-1}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x$$\Leftrightarrow I=\frac{14}{3}+\frac{I}{2}\Rightarrow I=\frac{28}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $4x.f\left( x^{2} \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right)=\sqrt{1-x^{2}}$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Lấy tích phân hai vế, ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ 4x.f\left( x^{2} \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x\,\,\,\left( * \right)$.
Xét tích phân $J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x$. Đặt $x=\sin t\Rightarrow\text{d}x=\cos t\text{d}t$. Khi đó, ta có
$J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{1-\sin^{2}t}.\cos t\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos^{2}t\text{d}t$$=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \left( 1+\cos 2t \right)\text{d}t=\left. \frac{1}{2}\left( t+\frac{\sin 2t}{2} \right) \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.
Xét tích phân $K=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4x.f\left( x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$. Đặt $t=x^{2}\Rightarrow\text{d}t=2x\text{d}x$. Khi đó, ta có
$K=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4x.f\left( x^{2} \right)\text{d}x=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Xét tích phân $L=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$. Đặt $t=1-x\Rightarrow\text{d}t=-\text{d}x$. Khi đó, ta có
$L=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=3\int\limits_{1}^{0} f\left( t \right)\left( -\text{d}t \right)=3\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=3\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Vậy $\left( * \right)\Leftrightarrow 5\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{4}\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{20}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ biết $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{1}{2}$ và $f'\left( x \right)=xe^{x^{2}}$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( x \right)=\int f'\left( x \right).\text{d}x=\int x.e^{x^{2}}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int e^{x^{2}}.\text{d}\left( x^{2} \right)=\frac{1}{2}e^{x^{2}}+C$.
Mà $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{1}{2}\Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{2}+C=\frac{1}{2}\Leftrightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{2}e^{x^{2}}$.
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} xe^{x^{2}}dx=\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{x^{2}}d\left( x^{2} \right)=\left. \frac{1}{4}e^{x^{2}} \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{e-1}{4}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right).$ Biết$f\left( 3 \right)=3$ và $xf'\left( 2x+1 \right)-f\left( 2x+1 \right)=x^{3},\forall x\in\left( 0;+\infty \right).$ Giá trị của $\int\limits_{3}^{5} f\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$\begin{array}{l} xf'\left( 2x+1 \right)-f\left( 2x+1 \right)=x^{3}\Leftrightarrow\frac{2x^{2}f'\left( 2x+1 \right)-2xf\left( 2x+1 \right)}{x^{4}}=2,\forall x\in\left( 0;+\infty \right). \\ \Leftrightarrow\left( \frac{f\left( 2x+1 \right)}{x^{2}} \right)^{'}=2\Leftrightarrow\frac{f\left( 2x+1 \right)}{x^{2}}=2x+C.\,\,\left( 1 \right) \end{array}$
Cho$x=1$từ $\left( 1 \right)$$\Rightarrow\frac{f\left( 3 \right)}{1^{2}}=2.1+C\Leftrightarrow\frac{3}{1^{2}}=2.1+C\Rightarrow C=1\Rightarrow f\left( 2x+1 \right)=x^{2}\left( 2x+1 \right)=2x^{3}+x^{2}.$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( 2x+1 \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( 2x^{3}+x^{2} \right)dx=\left. \left( 2\frac{x^{4}}{4}+\frac{x^{3}}{3} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\frac{59}{6}.$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{3}^{5} f\left( x \right)dx=2\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( 2x+1 \right)dx=\frac{59}{3}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm và đồng biến trên $\left[ 1;4 \right]$, thỏa mãn $x+2xf\left( x \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$. Biết $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2}$, tính $I=\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
Do $f\left( x \right)$ đồng biến trên $\left[ 1;4 \right]$ nên $f\left( x \right)\ge f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2}>-\frac{1}{2}$, ngoài ra $f'\left( x \right)\ge 0,\forall x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$. Khi đó ta có biến đổi sau:
$x+2xf\left( x \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{2f\left( x \right)+1}}=\sqrt{x}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( \sqrt{2f\left( x \right)+1} \right)^{\prime}=\left( \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}}+C \right)^{\prime}\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{2f\left( x \right)+1}=\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}}+C$
Mà $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2}\Rightarrow C=\frac{4}{3}$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{\left( \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}}+\frac{4}{3} \right)^{2}-1}{2}=\frac{2}{9}x^{3}+\frac{8}{9}\sqrt{x^{3}}+\frac{7}{18}$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx=\left. \left( \frac{1}{18}x^{4}+\frac{16}{45}x^{2}\sqrt{x}+\frac{7}{18}x \right) \right|_{1}^{4}=\frac{1186}{45}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=10$, $f\left( 1 \right)=\cot 1$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right]\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Cách 1:
+ $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right]\text{d}x$$=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\tan x\text{d}x\,\,\,\,\,\left( 1 \right)$.
+ Tính $J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f'\left( x \right)\tan x\text{d}x$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\tan x \\ \text{d}v=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.$, ta có $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\left( 1+\tan^{2}x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
$\Rightarrow J=\left. f\left( x \right).\tan x \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\left( 1+\tan^{2}x \right)\text{d}x$
$=f\left( 1 \right).\tan 1-f\left( 0 \right).\tan 0-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\tan^{2}x\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$=\cot 1.\tan 1-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\tan^{2}x\text{d}x-10$
$=1-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\tan^{2}x\text{d}x-10=-9-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\tan^{2}x\text{d}x$.
Thay $J$ vào $\left( 1 \right)$ ta được:
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x\text{d}x+\left( -9-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right).\tan^{2}x\text{d}x \right)=-9$.
Cách 2:
Ta có: $\left( f\left( x \right)\tan x \right)^{\prime}=f'\left( x \right)\tan x+f\left( x \right)\left( \tan^{2}x+1 \right)=f'\left( x \right)\tan x+f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f\left( x \right)$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)\tan x+f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x=\left[ f\left( x \right)\tan x \right]^{\prime}-f\left( x \right)$.
$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f\left( x \right)\tan^{2}x+f'\left( x \right)\tan x \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left\{ \left[ f\left( x \right)\tan x \right]^{\prime}-f\left( x \right) \right\}\text{d}x$
$=\left. f\left( x \right)\tan x \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 1 \right)\tan 1-10=\cot 1.\tan 1-10=-9$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ thỏa mãn $\left[ f^{'}(x) \right]^{2}+f(x).f^{''}(x)=x^{3}-2x,\,\forall x\in R$ và $f(0)=f^{'}(0)=2$. Tính giá trị của $T=f^{2}(2)$
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\left[ f^{'}(x) \right]^{2}+f(x).f^{''}(x)=x^{3}-2x,\,\forall x\in R$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( f^{'}(x).f(x) \right)^{'}=x^{3}-2x,\,\forall x\in R$
Lấy nguyên hàm hai vế ta có:
$\begin{array}{l} \int \left( f^{'}(x).f(x) \right)^{'}dx=\int \left( x^{3}-2x \right)dx \\ \Leftrightarrow f^{'}(x).f(x)=\frac{x^{4}}{4}-x^{2}+C \end{array}$
Theo đề ra ta có: $f^{'}(0).f(0)=C=4$
Suy ra:
$\int\limits_{0}^{2} f^{'}(x).f(x).dx=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( \frac{x^{4}}{4}-x^{2}+4 \right)\,dx$
$\Leftrightarrow\left. \frac{f^{2}(x)}{2} \right|_{0}^{2}=\frac{104}{15}$$\,\,\,\Leftrightarrow\,\,\,f^{2}(2)=\frac{268}{15}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục, có đạo hàm trên $R$ thỏa mãn điều kiện $f(x)+x\left( f^{\prime}(x)-2\sin x \right)=x^{2}\cos x,x\in R$ và $f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$.Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} xf''\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
Từ giả thiết $f(x)+x\left( f^{\prime}(x)-2\sin x \right)=x^{2}\cos x$
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow f(x)+xf^{\prime}(x)=x^{2}\cos x+2x\sin x \\ \Leftrightarrow\left( xf\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}\,\,\,\,\,\,=\left( x^{2}\sin x \right)^{\prime} \\ \Leftrightarrow xf\left( x \right)\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,=x^{2}\sin x+C \end{array}$
Mặt khác: $f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=\frac{\pi}{2}\Rightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=x\sin x.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{9} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}dx=4$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos xdx=2.$ Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{3} f(x)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $\text{t}=\sqrt{\text{x}}\Rightarrow\text{dt}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{\text{x}}}\text{dx}$. Khi đó $x=1\Rightarrow t=1;x=9\Rightarrow t=3$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{1}^{9} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}dx=2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f(t)dt=4\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f(t)dt=2.$
Đặt $t=\sin x;x\in\left[ -\frac{\pi}{2};\frac{\pi}{2} \right]\Rightarrow dt=\cos dx$. Khi đó. $x=0\Rightarrow t=0;x=\frac{\pi}{2}\Rightarrow t=1$
Suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{3} f(x)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx+\int\limits_{1}^{3} f(x)dx=2+2=4.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;3 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 3 \right)=0$, $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{7}{6}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{x+1}}dx=-\frac{7}{3}$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx$ bằng:
loi_giai:
Xét: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{x+1}}dx=-\frac{7}{3}$
Đặt: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ dv=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x+1}}dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'\left( x \right)dx \\ v=2\left( \sqrt{x+1}-1 \right) \end{array} \right.$
Khi đó: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{x+1}}dx=\left. \left[ 2\left( \sqrt{x+1}-1 \right)f\left( x \right) \right] \right|_{0}^{3}-2\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( \sqrt{x+1}-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)dx$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( \sqrt{x+1}-1 \right).f'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{7}{6}$ (1)
Mặt khác: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( \sqrt{x+1}-1 \right)^{2}dx=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( x+2-2\sqrt{x+1} \right)dx=\frac{7}{6}$ (2)
$\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{7}{6}\text{  }\left( 3 \right)$
Từ (1) và (2) suy ra: $\left[ \begin{array}{l} f'\left( x \right)=0 \\ f'\left( x \right)=\sqrt{x+1}-1 \end{array} \right.$
+) $f'\left( x \right)=0\Rightarrow$ (3) vô lý
+)$f'\left( x \right)=\sqrt{x+1}-1\Rightarrow$$f\left( x \right)=\frac{2}{3}\left( x+1 \right)\sqrt{x+1}-x+C$, mà $f\left( 3 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=-\frac{7}{3}$
$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{2}{3}\left( x+1 \right)\sqrt{x+1}-x-\frac{7}{3}$
Vậy: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ \frac{2}{3}\left( x+1 \right)\sqrt{x+1}-x-\frac{7}{3} \right]dx=-\frac{97}{30}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{2}{3}$ và $\left( \sqrt{x}+\sqrt{x+1} \right)f'\left( x \right)=1,\forall x\ge-1.$ Biết rằng $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{a\sqrt{2}+b}{15}$ với $a,b\in\mathbb{Z}.$ Tính $T=a+b.$
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\left( \sqrt{x}+\sqrt{x+1} \right)f'\left( x \right)=1,\forall x\ge-1.$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}} \\ \Rightarrow\int f'\left( x \right)dx=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}dx \\ \Rightarrow\int f'\left( x \right)dx=\int \left( \sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt{x} \right)dx \\ \Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{\left( x+1 \right)^{3}}-\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}}+C. \end{array}$
Mặt khác: $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{2}{3}\Rightarrow\frac{2}{3}=\frac{2}{3}-\frac{2}{3}+C\Leftrightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f(x)=\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{\left( x+1 \right)^{3}}-\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}}.$
Do đó: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( \frac{2}{3}\sqrt{\left( x+1 \right)^{3}}-\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{x^{3}} \right)\,dx=\left. \left( \frac{2}{3}.\frac{2}{5}\sqrt{\left( x+1 \right)^{5}}-\frac{2}{3}.\frac{2}{5}\sqrt{x^{5}} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{16\sqrt{2}-8}{15}.$
$\Rightarrow a=16;\,b=-8\Rightarrow T=a+b=8.$

noi_dung:
Cho$f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa $f\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\frac{1}{3}$. Tính
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin 2x.f'\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$
loi_giai:
Đặt $t=\sin\,x,\,\,\text{d}t=\cos x\,\text{d}x$.
Đổi cận
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin 2x.f'\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 2t.f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t$.
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=2t \\ \text{d}v=f'\left( t \right)\text{d}t \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=2\text{d}t \\ v=f\left( t \right) \end{array} \right.$
$I=\left( 2t.f\left( t \right) \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2.f\left( 1 \right)-2.\frac{1}{3}=\frac{4}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{9} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x=4,\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos x\text{d}x=2$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\int\limits_{1}^{9} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x=2\int\limits_{1}^{9} f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)\text{d}\left( \sqrt{x} \right)=2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$.
Mà $\int\limits_{1}^{9} \frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x=4$ nên $2\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=4\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2$
Vì tích phân không phụ thuộc vào biến số nên $\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2$.
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos x\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}\left( \sin x \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$.
Mà $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\cos x\text{d}x=2$ nên $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2$.
Vì tích phân không phụ thuộc vào biến số nên $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2$.
Khi đó $I=\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2+2=4$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ -\ln 2;\ln 2 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)+f\left( -x \right)=\frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}+1}$. Biết $\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=a\ln 2+b\ln 3,\,\,\left( a,b\in\mathbb{Q} \right)$. Tính $P=a+b$.
loi_giai:
Từ giả thiết suy ra $\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \left[ f\left( x \right)+f\left( -x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}+1}\text{d}x$.
Ta có $\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \left[ f\left( x \right)+f\left( -x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} f\left( -x \right)\text{d}\left( -x \right)=2\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}+1}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \frac{1}{\left( \text{e}^{x}+1 \right)\text{e}^{x}}\text{d}\left( \text{e}^{x} \right)=\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \left[ \frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}}-\frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}+1} \right]\text{d}\left( \text{e}^{x} \right)$
$=\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}}\text{d}\left( \text{e}^{x} \right)-\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} \frac{1}{\text{e}^{x}+1}\text{d}\left( \text{e}^{x}+1 \right)=\left. x \right|_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2}-\left. \ln\left( \text{e}^{x}+1 \right) \right|_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2}=\ln 2+\ln 2-\ln 3+\ln\frac{3}{2}=\ln 2$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{-\ln 2}^{\ln 2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\ln 2$$\Rightarrow a=\frac{1}{2},b=0\Rightarrow a+b=\frac{1}{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f(x)$liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn điều kiện $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=2$và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf(x)dx=\frac{3}{2}$. Hỏi giá trị nhỏ nhất của $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{2}(x)dx$ bằng bao nhiêu?
loi_giai:
Ta tìm hàm $ax+b$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f(x)-(ax+b) \right]^{2}dx=0\Rightarrow f(x)=ax+b$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=2 \\ \int\limits_{0}^{1} xf(x)dx=\frac{3}{2} \end{array} \right.\Leftrightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \left. \left( \frac{a}{2}x^{2}+bx \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=2 \\ \left. \left( \frac{a}{3}x^{3}+\frac{b}{2}x^{2} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{3}{2} \end{array} \right.\Leftrightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac{a}{2}+b=2 \\ \frac{a}{3}+\frac{b}{2}=\frac{3}{2} \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow a=6;b=-1. \\ +\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f(x)-(6x-1) \right]^{2}dx\ge 0 \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f^{2}(x)dx\ge 2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)(6x-1)dx-\int\limits_{0}^{1} (6x-1)^{2}dx=12\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf(x)dx-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx-\int\limits_{0}^{1} (6x-1)^{2}dx=7 \end{array}$

noi_dung: Cho $f\left( x \right)$liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)=f\left( 2020-x \right)$ và $\int\limits_{3}^{2017} f\left( x \right)d\text{x}=4.$Khi đó $\int\limits_{3}^{2017} xf\left( x \right)d\text{x}$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $u=2020-x\Rightarrow x=2020-u$. Ta có $d\text{x}=-du$.
Với $x=3$ thì $u=2017$.
Với $x=2017$ thì $u=3$.
Khiđó$\int\limits_{3}^{2017} xf\left( x \right)d\text{x}$= $\int\limits_{3}^{2017} \left( 2020-u \right)f\left( 2020-u \right)du=\int\limits_{3}^{2017} \left( 2020-x \right)f\left( x \right)dx$
Suy ra $2\int\limits_{3}^{2017} xf\left( x \right)d\text{x = }\int\limits_{3}^{2017} 2020f\left( x \right)d\text{x = 8080.}$ Do đó $\int\limits_{3}^{2017} xf\left( x \right)d\text{x  = 4040.}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)>0$ và có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$, thỏa mãn $\left( x+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)=\frac{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}{x+2}$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=\left( \frac{\ln 2}{2} \right)^{2}$. Giá trị $f\left( 3 \right)$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $\left( x+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)=\frac{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}{x+2}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}=\frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)\left( x+2 \right)}$.
Khi đó
$\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)\left( x+2 \right)}\text{d}x\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{d\left( f\left( x \right) \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)\left( x+2 \right)}\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow\left. 2\sqrt{f\left( x \right)} \right|_{0}^{3}=\left. \ln\frac{x+1}{x+2} \right|_{0}^{3}\Leftrightarrow 2\sqrt{f\left( 3 \right)}-2\sqrt{f\left( 0 \right)}=\ln\frac{4}{5}-\ln\frac{1}{2}$
$\Leftrightarrow 2\sqrt{f\left( 3 \right)}=\ln\frac{8}{5}+2\sqrt{f\left( 0 \right)}$$\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{f\left( 3 \right)}=\frac{1}{2}\left( \ln 8-\ln 5 \right)+\sqrt{f\left( 0 \right)}$$\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{f\left( 3 \right)}=\frac{1}{2}\left( 3\ln 2-\ln 5 \right)+\frac{\ln 2}{2}$$\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{f\left( 3 \right)}=\frac{1}{2}\left( 4\ln 2-\ln 5 \right)$.
Vậy $f\left( 3 \right)=\frac{1}{4}\left( 4\ln 2-\ln 5 \right)^{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có $f\left( 1 \right)=e^{2}$ và $f'\left( x \right)=\frac{2x-1}{x^{2}}e^{2x}$ với mọi $x$ khác $0$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{1}^{\ln 3} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Xét tích phân $\int f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int \frac{2x-1}{x^{2}}e^{2x}\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\left( 2x-1 \right)e^{2x} \\ \text{d}v=\frac{1}{x^{2}}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=4xe^{2x}\text{d}x \\ v=-\frac{1}{x} \end{array} \right.$, khi đó
$\int f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int \frac{2x-1}{x^{2}}e^{2x}\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{x}\left( 2x-1 \right)e^{2x}+4\int e^{2x}\text{d}x$$=-\frac{1}{x}\left( 2x-1 \right)e^{2x}+2e^{2x}+C$.
Do $f\left( 1 \right)=e^{2}\Rightarrow C=0$. Vậy $f\left( x \right)=-\frac{1}{x}\left( 2x-1 \right)e^{2x}+2e^{2x}$.
Khi đó, ta có $\int\limits_{1}^{\ln 3} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{\ln 3} \left[ \left( 1-2x \right)e^{2x}+2xe^{2x} \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{\ln 3} e^{2x}\text{d}x=\left. \frac{e^{2x}}{2} \right|_{1}^{\ln 3}=\frac{1}{2}\left( 9-e^{2} \right)$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4x\sqrt{x}}=\frac{2x+1}{2x}\ln\left( x+1 \right)$. Biết $\int\limits_{1}^{17} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=a\ln 5-2\ln b+c$ với $a,b,c\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị của $a+b+2c$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4x\sqrt{x}}=\frac{2x+1}{2x}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\Leftrightarrow xf\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4\sqrt{x}}=\frac{2x+1}{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left[ xf\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4\sqrt{x}} \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{2x+1}{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}x$.
Ta có $\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left[ xf\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\frac{f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{4\sqrt{x}} \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x^{2}+1 \right)\frac{\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)}{2}+\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( \sqrt{x} \right)\frac{\text{d}\left( \sqrt{x} \right)}{2}$
$=\int\limits_{2}^{17} \frac{1}{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{1}{2}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{1}^{17} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
$\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{2x+1}{2}\ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{1}^{4} \ln\left( x+1 \right)\text{d}\left( x^{2}+x \right)=\frac{1}{2}\left[ \left. \left( x^{2}+x \right)\ln\left( x+1 \right) \right|_{1}^{4}-\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left( x^{2}+x \right)\frac{1}{x+1}\text{d}x \right]$
$=\frac{1}{2}\left[ 20\ln 5-2\ln 2-\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2} \right|_{1}^{4} \right]=\frac{1}{2}\left[ 20\ln 5-2\ln 2-\frac{15}{2} \right]$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{1}^{17} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=20\ln 5-2\ln 2-\frac{15}{2}\Rightarrow a=20,b=2,c=-\frac{15}{2}$.
Vậy $a+b+2c=7$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm và xác định trên $\mathbb{R}$. Biết $f\left( 1 \right)=2$ và $\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{4} \frac{1+3\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x}}f\left( 2-\sqrt{x} \right)\text{d}x=4$. Giá trị của $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có
$4=\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( x^{2}f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int_{0}^{1} 2xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2-2\int_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-1$
Đặt $t=2-\sqrt{x}\Rightarrow\text{d}t=-\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\text{d}x$
Khi đó
$\int_{1}^{4} \frac{1+3\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x}}f\left( 2-\sqrt{x} \right)\text{d}x=4\Leftrightarrow-\int_{1}^{0} \left( 1+3\left( 2-t \right) \right)f\left( t \right)\text{dt}=4$$\Leftrightarrow\int_{0}^{1} 7f\left( t \right)\text{dt}-3\int_{0}^{1} tf\left( t \right)\text{dt}=4$
Suy ra $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{dt}=\frac{4+3\int_{0}^{1} tf\left( t \right)\text{dt}}{7}=\frac{4+3.\left( -1 \right)}{7}=\frac{1}{7}$.
Vậy $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm cấp hai trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$đồng thời thỏa mãn các điều kiện $f'\left( 0 \right)=-1,f'\left( x \right)<0,\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=f''\left( x \right),\forall x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]$. Giá trị $f\left( 0 \right)-f\left( 1 \right)$ thuộc khoảng
loi_giai:
$\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=f''\left( x \right)\Leftrightarrow\frac{f''\left( x \right)}{\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}=1\Leftrightarrow\int \frac{f''\left( x \right)}{\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}}dx=\int dx\Leftrightarrow\frac{-1}{f'\left( x \right)}=x+C$$f'\left( 0 \right)=-1\Rightarrow\frac{-1}{-1}=0+C\Leftrightarrow C=1\Rightarrow\frac{-1}{f'\left( x \right)}=x+1\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\frac{-1}{x+1}$
$f\left( 0 \right)-f\left( 1 \right)=\int\limits_{1}^{0} f'\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{0} \frac{-1}{x+1}dx=-\ln\left| x+1 \right|\left| \begin{array}{l} 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right.=\ln 2\in\left( 0;1 \right)$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=5$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$
loi_giai:
Ta có$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$,
Tính $\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $x=\pi-t$
$\text{d}x=-\text{dt}$
$xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\left( \pi-t \right)f\left[ \sin\left( \pi-t \right) \right]\left( -\text{dt} \right)=\left( t-\pi \right)f\left( \sin t \right)\text{dt}$
Đổi cận $\begin{array}{l} x=\frac{\pi}{2}\Rightarrow t=\frac{\pi}{2} \\ x=\pi\Rightarrow t=0 \end{array}$
$\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{0} \left( t-\pi \right)f\left( \sin t \right)\text{dt}=\pi\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin t \right)\text{dt}-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} tf\left( \sin t \right)\text{dt}=\pi\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$ Do đó $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} xf\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\pi\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=5\pi$
