noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0\,;\,1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $6x^{2}f\left( x^{3} \right)+4f\left( 1-x \right)=3\sqrt{1-x^{2}}$. Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Từ giả thiết $6x^{2}f\left( x^{3} \right)+4f\left( 1-x \right)=3\sqrt{1-x^{2}}$, lấy tích phân từ 0 đến 1 của 2 vế ta được
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} 6x^{2}f\left( x^{3} \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x$
Đặt $I_{1}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 6x^{2}f\left( x^{3} \right)\text{d}x$, $I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$, $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} 3\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x$.
+) Đặt $t=x^{3}$ ta được $I_{1}=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
+) Đặt $v=1-x$ ta được $I_{2}=4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( v \right)\text{d}v=4\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
Từ đó ta được $I=6\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
+) Đặt $u=\sin x$ ta được $I=\frac{3\pi}{4}$, suy ra $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{8}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$. Biết $f\left( 4x \right)=f\left( x \right)+4x^{3}+2x$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=2$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( 4x \right)=f\left( x \right)+4x^{3}+2x$$\Rightarrow f\left( 4x \right)-f\left( x \right)=4x^{3}+2x$ $\left( 1 \right)$.
Suy ra: $f\left( x \right)$ và $f\left( 4x \right)$ là hàm số bậc ba.
Khi đó: $f\left( x \right)=ax^{3}+bx^{2}+cx+d\left( a\ne 0 \right)$ và $f\left( 4x \right)=64ax^{3}+16bx^{2}+4cx+d$.
Ta có: $f\left( 4x \right)-f\left( x \right)=63ax^{3}+15bx^{2}+3cx$ $\left( 2 \right)$.
Từ $\left( 1 \right)$ và $\left( 2 \right)$ ta suy ra: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=\frac{4}{63} \\ b=0 \\ c=\frac{2}{3} \end{array} \right.$. Mặt khác: vì $f\left( 0 \right)=2$ nên $d=2$.
Do đó, $f\left( x \right)=\frac{4}{63}x^{3}+\frac{2}{3}x+2$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( \frac{4}{63}x^{3}+\frac{2}{3}x+2 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{352}{63}$.
* Chứng minh $f\left( x \right)$ là duy nhất.
Ta có: $f\left( x \right)=\frac{4}{63}x^{3}+\frac{2}{3}x+2$ và $f\left( 4x \right)=\frac{256}{63}x^{3}+\frac{8}{3}x+2$; $f\left( 4x \right)-f\left( x \right)=4x^{3}+2x$.
Suy ra: $f\left( 4x \right)-\frac{4}{63}\left( 4x \right)^{3}-\frac{2}{3}\left( 4x \right)=f\left( x \right)-\frac{4}{63}x^{3}-\frac{2}{3}x$.
Đặt $g\left( 4x \right)=f\left( 4x \right)-\frac{4}{63}\left( 4x \right)^{3}-\frac{2}{3}\left( 4x \right)$ và $g\left( x \right)=f\left( x \right)-\frac{4}{63}x^{3}-\frac{2}{3}x$.
Ta có: $g\left( 4x \right)=g\left( x \right)$; $g\left( 0 \right)=f\left( 0 \right)=2$.
Suy ra: $g\left( x \right)=g\left( \frac{x}{4} \right)=g\left( \frac{x}{4^{2}} \right)=...=g\left( \frac{x}{4^{n}} \right),n\in\mathbb{N}^{*}$
Khi $n\rightarrow+\infty$ suy ra $g\left( x \right)=g\left( 0 \right)=2$.
Vậy $f\left( x \right)=\frac{4}{63}x^{3}-\frac{2}{3}x+2,\forall x$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 1\,;\,2 \right]$ thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{1}{3}$, $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ và $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=7$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx$.
loi_giai:
$-\frac{1}{3}=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)d\left( x-1 \right)^{3}=\frac{1}{3}\left[ \left. \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f\left( x \right) \right|_{1}^{2}-\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)dx \right]$$=-\frac{1}{3}\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)dx$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{3}f'\left( x \right)dx=1\,\,\left( 1 \right)$
Ta có $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-7\left( x-1 \right)^{3} \right]^{2}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx-14\int\limits_{1}^{2} f'\left( x \right)\left( x-1 \right)^{3}dx+49\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( x-1 \right)^{6}dx=0$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=7\left( x-1 \right)^{3}$$\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=7\int \left( x-1 \right)^{3}dx=\frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}+C$.
Mà $f\left( 2 \right)=0$ nên $C=-\frac{7}{4}$. Suy ra $f\left( x \right)=\frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}-\frac{7}{4}$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left[ \frac{7\left( x-1 \right)^{4}}{4}-\frac{7}{4} \right]dx=-\frac{7}{5}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thảo mãn $\sin x\,f\left( \cos x \right)+\,\cos x\,f\left( \sin x \right)=\sin 2x-\frac{1}{3}\sin^{3}2x$ với $\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
$\sin x\,f\left( \cos x \right)+\,\cos x\,f\left( \sin x \right)=\sin 2x-\frac{1}{3}\sin^{3}2x$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin x\,f\left( \cos x \right)\text{d}x+\,\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos x\,f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x=\,\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \left( \sin 2x-\frac{1}{3}\sin^{3}2x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \,f\left( \cos x \right)\text{d}\left( \cos x \right)+\,\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}\left( \sin x \right)=-\frac{1}{2}\,\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \left( 1-\frac{1-\cos^{2}2x}{3} \right)\text{d}\left( \cos 2x \right)$.
$\Rightarrow-\int\limits_{1}^{0} \,f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t+\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( u \right)\,\text{d}u=\left. -\frac{1}{2}\,\left( \frac{2}{3}\cos 2x+\frac{\cos^{3}2x}{9} \right) \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \,f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t+\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( u \right)\,\text{d}u=-\frac{1}{2}\left[ \left( -\frac{2}{3}+\frac{-1}{9} \right)-\left( \frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{9} \right) \right]$
$\Rightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{1} \,f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=\frac{7}{9}\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \,f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=\frac{7}{18}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $2f\left( x \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right)=\sqrt{1-x^{2}}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]$. Tính $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $2f\left( x \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right)=\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} \left[ 2f\left( x \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x$.
Xét $\int_{0}^{1} \left[ 2f\left( x \right)+3f\left( 1-x \right) \right]\text{d}x=2\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+3\int_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}x$;
$=2\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-3\int_{0}^{1} f\left( 1-x \right)\text{d}\left( 1-x \right)=2\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+3\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}\left( x \right)=5\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
+) $\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x$ là diện tích của một phần tư hình tròn có bán kính bằng $1$ nên $\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\pi$.
Vậy $\int_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\pi}{20}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)=x\left[ \sin x+f'\left( x \right) \right]+\cos x$ và $f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=\frac{\pi}{2}$. Giá trị của $f\left( \pi \right)$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( x \right)=x\left[ \sin x+f'\left( x \right) \right]+\cos x,\,\,\forall x>0$
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)-x\,f'\left( x \right)=x\sin x+\cos x,\,\,\,\forall x>0$
$\Leftrightarrow\frac{f\left( x \right)-x\,f'\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}=\frac{x\sin x+\cos x}{x^{2}},\,\,\,\forall x>0$
$\Leftrightarrow\frac{x\,f'\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}=\frac{-x\sin x-\cos x}{x^{2}},\,\,\,\forall x>0$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x} \right]^{'}=\left( \frac{\cos x}{x} \right)^{'},\,\,\,\forall x>0$ (1)
Lấy tích phân hai vế của (1) từ $\frac{\pi}{2}$ đến $\pi$, ta được
$\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \left[ \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x} \right]^{'}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \left( \frac{\cos x}{x} \right)^{'}\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow$$\frac{f\left( \pi \right)}{\pi}-\frac{f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)}{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{\cos\pi}{\pi}-\frac{\cos\frac{\pi}{2}}{\frac{\pi}{2}}$$\Rightarrow$$f\left( \pi \right)=-1+\pi$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $R$ và thỏa mãn $f^{3}\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=x\forall x\in R$.Tính $\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$\begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)dx=\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( f^{3}\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right) \right)f'\left( x \right)dx \\ =2f\left( 2 \right)-\left. \left( \frac{f^{4}\left( x \right)}{4}+\frac{f^{2}\left( x \right)}{2} \right) \right|_{0}^{2} \end{array}$
Mặt khác: $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f^{3}\left( 2 \right)+f\left( 2 \right)=2\Rightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=1 \\ f^{3}\left( 0 \right)+f\left( 0 \right)=0\Rightarrow f\left( 0 \right)=0 \end{array} \right.$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=2-\left. \left( \frac{f^{4}\left( x \right)}{4}+\frac{f^{2}\left( x \right)}{2} \right) \right|_{0}^{2}=\frac{5}{4}$.

noi_dung:
Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$liên tục trên tập số thực thỏa mãn
$f(x)+(5x-2)f\left( 5x^{2}-4x \right)=50x^{3}-60x^{2}+23x-1\forall x\in R$. Giá trị của biểu thức $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} (50x^{3}-60x^{2}+23x-1)dx-\int\limits_{0}^{1} (5x-2)f(5x^{2}-4x)dx=3-\int\limits_{0}^{1} (5x-2)f(5x^{2}-4x)dx$ (1)
Xét tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} (5x-2)f(5x^{2}-4x)dx$:
Đặt $t=5x^{2}-4x$ thì $dt=(5.2x-4)dx=2(5x-2)dx$
Khi $x=1$thì $t=1$
Khi $x=0$thì $t=0$
Suy ra:
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} (5x-2)f(5x^{2}-4x)dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(t)dt=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx$
Thay vào (1) ta được:
$\begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=3-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx \\ \Leftrightarrow\frac{3}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=3 \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f(x)dx=2 \end{array}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm và đồng biến trên $\left[ 1;4 \right],$ thoả mãn $x+2xf\left( x \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;4 \right].$ Biết rằng $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2},$tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
Ta có: $x+2xf\left( x \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}$
$\Leftrightarrow x\left( 1+2f\left( x \right) \right)=\left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}$
$\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{x}\sqrt{1+2f\left( x \right)}=f'\left( x \right)$ (do $f\left( x \right)$ đồng biến trên $\left[ 1;4 \right]$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2}$>0 nên $f\left( x \right)>0,\forall x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$)
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{1+2f\left( x \right)}}=\sqrt{x} \\ \Leftrightarrow\left( \sqrt{1+2f\left( x \right)} \right)'=\sqrt{x} \\ \Leftrightarrow\int \left( \sqrt{1+2f\left( x \right)} \right)^{\prime}dx=\int \sqrt{x}dx \\ \Leftrightarrow\sqrt{1+2f\left( x \right)}=\frac{2}{3}x^{\frac{3}{2}}+C. \end{array}$
Thay$f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{2}\Rightarrow C=\frac{4}{3}.$
Suy ra $f\left( x \right)=\left( \frac{2}{3}x^{\frac{3}{2}}+\frac{4}{3} \right)^{2}-1\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{1186}{45}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$ và thỏa mãn $2\sqrt{x^{5}}.f\left( x^{3} \right)-f\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=2\sqrt{x}.\ln\left( x+1 \right),\,\,\forall x\in\left( 0;+\infty \right)$. Biết $\int\limits_{4}^{64} f\left( x \right).dx=a\ln 5-6\ln b+c$ với $a,b,c\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị $a-b+c$bằng
loi_giai:
- Gọi $F\left( x \right)$ là một nguyên hàm của $f\left( x \right)$ trên khoảng $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$, khi đó:
$\int\limits_{4}^{64} f\left( x \right).dx=F\left( 64 \right)-F\left( 4 \right)$.
- Với mọi $x>0$, ta có:
$2\sqrt{x^{5}}.f\left( x^{3} \right)-f\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=2\sqrt{x}.\ln\left( x+1 \right)\Leftrightarrow 3x^{2}.f\left( x^{3} \right)-\frac{3}{2\sqrt{x}}.f\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=3.\ln\left( x+1 \right)$
$\Rightarrow\int 3x^{2}.f\left( x^{3} \right).dx-\int \frac{3}{2\sqrt{x}}.f\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right).dx=3\int \ln\left( x+1 \right).dx$
$\Rightarrow\int f\left( x^{3} \right).d\left( x^{3} \right)-\int f\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right).d\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=3\left( \left( x+1 \right).\ln\left( x+1 \right)-x+C \right)$
$\Rightarrow F\left( x^{3} \right)-F\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=3\left( \left( x+1 \right).\ln\left( x+1 \right)-x+C \right)$, với $C$ là hằng số thực.
- Cho $x=1$ ta được: $F\left( 1 \right)-F\left( 1 \right)=3\left( 2.\ln 2-1+C \right)\Rightarrow C=1-2\ln 2$
$\Rightarrow F\left( x^{3} \right)-F\left( 3\sqrt{x}-2 \right)=3\left( \left( x+1 \right).\ln\left( x+1 \right)-x+1-2\ln 2 \right)$.
- Cho $x=4$ ta được: $F\left( 64 \right)-F\left( 4 \right)=3\left( 5\ln 5-3-2\ln 2 \right)=15\ln 5-6\ln 2-9$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{4}^{64} f\left( x \right).dx=15\ln 5-6\ln 2-9\Rightarrow a=15,\,b=2,\,c=-9$.
Vậy $a-b+c=4$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm xác định trên $\mathbb{R}.$ Biết $f\left( 1 \right)=2$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{\ln x}{x}f\left( 2-\ln x \right)\text{d}x=6.$ Giá trị $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $6=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left[ x^{2}f\left( x \right) \right]\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array}-2 \right.\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2.$
Lại có $6=2\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{\ln x}{x}f\left( 2-\ln x \right)\text{d}x\Leftrightarrow I=\int\limits_{e}^{e^{2}} \frac{\ln x}{x}f\left( 2-\ln x \right)\text{d}x=3$
Đặt $t=2-\ln x\Rightarrow\ln x=2-t\Rightarrow\frac{1}{x}\text{d}x=-\text{d}t$
Suy ra $I=-\int\limits_{1}^{0} \left( 2-t \right)f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow 3=2\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+2\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}.$
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}.$

noi_dung: Cho $f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số liên tục có đạo hàm $f'\left( x \right)$ trên $\left[ 0;\,1 \right]$, $f\left( 0 \right)=0$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{3}$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{3}$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$-\frac{1}{3}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}\left( x-1 \right)=\left. f\left( x \right).\left( x-1 \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{1}{3}$.
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{3}$.
Khi đó: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right)-\left( x-1 \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\text{d}x-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x\,+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}\text{d}x=0$.
Vậy $f'\left( x \right)-\left( x-1 \right)=0\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\left( x-1 \right)\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\int \left( x-1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{2}}{2}+C$.
Do $f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{1}{2}+C=0\Rightarrow C=-\frac{1}{2}$. Vậy $f\left( x \right)=\frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{2}$.
Khi đó: $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \left( \frac{\left( x-1 \right)^{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{5}{48}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thoả mãn $2f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right)=2x+1$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=-3$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ 2f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( 2x+1 \right)\text{d}x=2$.
Mặt khác $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ 2f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=2I+\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=2I+\left( \left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x \right)=2I+f\left( 1 \right)-I$.
Suy ra: $I-3=2\Rightarrow I=5$.

noi_dung:
Cho$f(x)$xác định và liên tục trên tập số thực thỏa
$f\left( x^{3}+x-1 \right)+f(-x^{3}-x-1)=-6x^{6}-12x^{4}-6x^{2}-2,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$ Tính $I=\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f(x)dx.$
loi_giai:
Nhân cả hai vế phương trình đã cho với $x^{2}+1$ và lấy tích phân ta có
$\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( 3x^{2}+1 \right)f\left( x^{3}+x-1 \right)dx+\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( 3x^{2}+1 \right)f(-x^{3}-x-1)dx=\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( 3x^{2}+1 \right)\left( -6x^{6}-12x^{4}-6x^{2}-2 \right)dx=-40$
Ta có
$\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( 3x^{2}+1 \right)f\left( x^{3}+x-1 \right)dx=\int\limits_{-1}^{1} f\left( x^{3}+x-1 \right)d\left( x^{3}+x-1 \right)=\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt$
$\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( 3x^{2}+1 \right)f(-x^{3}-x-1)dx=-\int\limits_{-1}^{1} f(-x^{3}-x-1)d\left( -x^{3}-x-1 \right)=-\int\limits_{1}^{-3} f\left( t \right)dt=\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt$
Do đó ta được $2\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt=-40\Rightarrow\int\limits_{-3}^{1} f\left( t \right)dt=-20$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f(x)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$và thỏa mãn $\left[ f(x) \right]^{3}+2f(x)=1-x$với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{-2}^{1} f(x)\text{d}x=\frac{a}{b}$ biết $\frac{a}{b}$ là phân số tối giản. Tính $a^{2}+b^{2}$?
loi_giai:
Đặt $y=f(x)\Rightarrow y^{3}+2y=1-x\Rightarrow-y^{3}-2y+1=x$ do đó d$x=\left( -3y^{2}-2 \right)$d$y$
Với $x=-2\Rightarrow-y^{3}-2y+1=-2\Leftrightarrow-y^{3}-2y+3=0\Leftrightarrow\left( y-1 \right)\left( -y^{2}-y-3 \right)=0\Leftrightarrow y=1$
$x=1\Rightarrow-y^{3}-2y+1=1\Leftrightarrow-y^{3}-2y=0\Leftrightarrow y\left( -y^{2}-2 \right)=0\Leftrightarrow y=0$
Do đó $\int\limits_{-2}^{1} f(x)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{0} y\left( -3y^{2}-2 \right)\text{d}y=\int\limits_{0}^{1} (3y^{3}+2y)\text{d}y=\left. \left( \frac{3}{4}y^{4}+y^{2} \right) \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{7}{4}$
Suy ra $a=7,b=4\Rightarrow a^{2}+b^{2}=65$.

noi_dung: Cho $f\left( x \right)$ là hàm số liên tục có đạo hàm $f'(x)$ trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$, $f\left( 0 \right)=0$. Biết $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}dx=\frac{1}{3},\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\;dx=-\frac{1}{3}$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]dx=\frac{1}{3}\,\,\,\left( 1 \right)$
Xét tích phân: $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{1}{3}$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ dv=dx \end{array} \right.\,$, ta chọn $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'\left( x \right)dx \\ v=x-1 \end{array} \right.$
Khi đó: $I=\left( x-1 \right)f\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.\,-\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)dx=-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)dx$
$\Rightarrow-\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{1}{3}\,\,\Leftrightarrow-\,\,\int\limits_{0}^{1} 2\left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{2}{3}\,\,\left( 2 \right)$
Ta lại có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( x-1 \right)^{2}dx=\frac{1}{3}\,\,\left( 3 \right)$
Cộng vế với vế của $\left( 1 \right),\,\,\left( 2 \right)$ và $\left( 3 \right)$ ta được:
$\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ \left( f'\left( x \right) \right)^{2}-2\left( x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right)+\left( x-1 \right)^{2} \right]dx=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}=0$$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}dx=0$
$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=x-1\,,\,\,\forall x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\left( * \right)\,\,$
Nguyên hàm hai vế của $\,\left( * \right)$ ta được:
$f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{2}}{2}-x+C$
Mà $f\left( 0 \right)=0\Rightarrow C=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{2}}{2}-x$
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \left( \frac{x^{2}}{2}-x \right)dx=-\frac{5}{48}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$, $xf'\left( x \right)=e^{x^{2}}-1,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R},\,f\left( 1 \right)=0$. Giá trị $\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)dx$bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $xf'\left( x \right)=e^{x^{2}}-1\Rightarrow x^{2}f'\left( x \right)=x\left( e^{x^{2}}-1 \right)$.
Xét $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf\left( x \right)dx$. Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ dv=xdx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=f'\left( x \right)dx \\ v=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $I=\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{1}{2}f\left( 1 \right)-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\left( e^{x}-1 \right)dx=-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\left( e^{x^{2}}-1 \right)dx$.
Xét $J=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x\left( e^{x^{2}}-1 \right)dx=\int\limits_{0}^{1} xe^{x^{2}}dx-\int\limits_{0}^{1} xdx$.
Đặt $t=x^{2}\Rightarrow dt=2xdx\Rightarrow J=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} e^{t}dt-\left. \frac{x^{2}}{2} \right|_{0}^{1}=\left. \frac{1}{2}e^{t} \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}e-1=\frac{1}{2}\left( e-2 \right)$.
Vậy $I=-\frac{1}{2}.J=-\frac{1}{4}\left( e-2 \right)$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=3$ và $f\left( x \right)+f\left( 2-x \right)=x^{2}-2x+2,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.$ Tính $I=\int_{0}^{2} x.f'\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
* Với $x=0,$ ta có: $f\left( 0 \right)+f\left( 2 \right)=2\Leftrightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=-1$
$f\left( x \right)+f\left( 2-x \right)=x^{2}-2x+2,\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.$
$\begin{array}{l} \Rightarrow\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx+\int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx=\int_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2}-2x+2 \right)dx \\ \Leftrightarrow\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx+\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{8}{3} \end{array}$
$\Leftrightarrow\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{4}{3}$
* Xét $I=\int_{0}^{2} x.f'\left( x \right)dx$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ dv=f'\left( x \right).dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=d \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$
$I=\left. x.f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=2.f\left( 2 \right)-\frac{4}{3}=-\frac{10}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ xác định và có đạo hàm $f'\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $[1;3]$. $f(x)\ne 0$ với mọi $x\in[1;3]$, đồng thời$f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}=\left[ \left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=-1$. Biết rằng $\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=a\ln 3+b$$\left( a,b\in\mathbb{Z} \right)$. Tính tổng $S=a+b^{2}$
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}=\left[ \left( f^{2}\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}\Leftrightarrow\frac{f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}{f^{4}(x)}=(x-1)^{2} \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{x} \frac{f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}{f^{4}(x)}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{x} (x-1)^{2}dx \\ \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{x} \left( \frac{1}{f^{4}(x)}+\frac{2}{f^{3}(x)}+\frac{1}{f^{2}(x)} \right)d(f(x))=\frac{(x-1)^{3}}{3}+\frac{0}{3} \\ \Leftrightarrow-\frac{1}{3f^{3}(x)}-\frac{1}{f^{2}(x)}-\frac{1}{f(x)}-\frac{1}{3}=\frac{(x-1)^{3}}{3}=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}-x^{2}+x-\frac{1}{3} \\ \Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{3}\left( \frac{-1}{f(x)} \right)^{3}-\left( \frac{-1}{f(x)} \right)^{2}+\left( \frac{-1}{f(x)} \right)=\frac{1}{3}x^{3}-x^{2}+x \end{array}$
Ta xét hàm đặc trưng: $y=f=g(t)=\frac{1}{3}t^{3}-t^{2}+t$ có $g'(t)=t^{2}-2t+1=(t-1)^{2}\ge 0\forall t\in[1;3]$
Suy ra $g(t)$ đồng biến trên R $\Rightarrow g\left( \frac{-1}{f(x)} \right)=g(x)\Leftrightarrow\frac{-1}{f(x)}=x\Leftrightarrow f(x)=\frac{-1}{x}$
Vậy $\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \frac{-dx}{x}=-\ln 3=a\ln 3+b$. Mà $a,b\in Z$nên $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=-1 \\ b=0 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow S=a+b^{2}=-1$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ xác định và liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0 \right\}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=-2$, $f\left( x \right)\ne-\frac{1}{x}$ và $x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)+\left( 2x-1 \right)f\left( x \right)=xf'\left( x \right)-1$ $\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0 \right\}$. Tính $\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$.
loi_giai:
$\begin{array}{l} x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)+\left( 2x-1 \right)f\left( x \right)=xf'\left( x \right)-1 \\ \Leftrightarrow x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)+2xf\left( x \right)-f\left( x \right)=xf'\left( x \right)-1 \\ \Leftrightarrow x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)+2xf\left( x \right)+1=xf'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right) \\ \Leftrightarrow\left[ xf\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}=\left( xf\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}\Leftrightarrow\left[ xf\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}=\left( xf\left( x \right)+1 \right)^{\prime}. \end{array}$
Do đó $\frac{\left( xf\left( x \right)+1 \right)^{\prime}}{\left[ xf\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}}=1\Rightarrow\int \frac{\left( xf\left( x \right)+1 \right)^{\prime}}{\left[ xf\left( x \right)+1 \right]^{2}}dx=\int dx\Rightarrow-\frac{1}{xf\left( x \right)+1}=x+C$.
Mà $f\left( 1 \right)=-2\Rightarrow-\frac{1}{f\left( 1 \right)+1}=1+C\Rightarrow-\frac{1}{-2+1}=1+C\Rightarrow C=0$.
Nên $-\frac{1}{xf\left( x \right)+1}=x\Rightarrow xf\left( x \right)+1=-\frac{1}{x}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{x}$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \left( -\frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{x} \right)dx=\left. \left( \frac{1}{x}-\ln x \right) \right|_{1}^{4}=\frac{1}{4}-\ln 4-1+\ln 1=-2\ln 2-\frac{3}{4}$.

noi_dung: Hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm cấp hai trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn: $f^{2}\left( 1-x \right)=\left( x^{2}+3 \right).f\left( x+1 \right)$.Biết rằng $f\left( x \right)\ne 0,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$, tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 2x-1 \right)f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=2x-1 \\ \text{dv}=f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{du}=2\text{dx} \\ \text{v}=f'\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
Ta có $I=\left. \left( 2x-1 \right)f'\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-2\int\limits_{0}^{2} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-\left. 2f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}$
$=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-2\left( f\left( 2 \right)-f\left( 0 \right) \right)$.
Xét $f^{2}\left( 1-x \right)=\left( x^{2}+3 \right).f\left( x+1 \right)\left( 1 \right)$.
Từ $\left( 1 \right)$ cho $x=-1,x=1$ta được hệ sau $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f^{2}\left( 2 \right)=4f\left( 0 \right) \\ f^{2}\left( 0 \right)=4f\left( 2 \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow f^{2}\left( 2 \right)f^{2}\left( 0 \right)=16f\left( 0 \right)f\left( 2 \right)\Rightarrow f\left( 0 \right)f\left( 2 \right)=16$(do $f\left( x \right)\ne 0,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$nên$f\left( 0 \right),f\left( 2 \right)\ne 0$)
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( 0 \right)=\frac{16}{f\left( 2 \right)}$.
Khi đó ta có $f^{2}\left( 2 \right)=4.\frac{16}{f\left( 2 \right)}\Leftrightarrow f^{3}\left( 2 \right)=64\Leftrightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=4\Rightarrow f\left( 0 \right)=4$.
Đạo hàm 2 vế của$\left( 1 \right)$ta được $-2f\left( 1-x \right)f'\left( 1-x \right)=2xf\left( x+1 \right)+\left( x^{2}+3 \right)f'\left( x+1 \right)\left( 2 \right)$
Từ $\left( 2 \right)$ cho $x=-1,x=1$ta được hệ sau$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} -2f\left( 2 \right)f'\left( 2 \right)=-2f\left( 0 \right)+4f'\left( 0 \right) \\ -2f\left( 0 \right)f'\left( 0 \right)=2f\left( 2 \right)+4f'\left( 2 \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\Leftrightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} -8f'\left( 2 \right)=-8+4f'\left( 0 \right) \\ -8f'\left( 0 \right)=8+4f'\left( 2 \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\Leftrightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f'\left( 0 \right)=-2 \\ f'\left( 2 \right)=2 \end{array} \right.$.
Vậy $I=3f'\left( 2 \right)+f'\left( 0 \right)-2\left( f\left( 2 \right)-f\left( 0 \right) \right)$
$=3.2-2-2\left( 4-4 \right)$
$=4$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ xác định và có đạo hàm $f'\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$, $f\left( x \right)\ne 0$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$, đồng thời $f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}=\left[ \left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=-1$. Biết rằng$\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=a\ln 3+b$, $a\,;\,b\in\mathbb{Z}$. Tính tổng $S=a+b^{2}$:
loi_giai:
Do $f\left( x \right)\ne 0$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1\,;\,3 \right]$ nên ta có: $f'\left( x \right)\left( 1+f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}=\left[ \left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}\left( x-1 \right) \right]^{2}$
$\Rightarrow$$f'\left( x \right)\left[ \frac{1}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}+\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)} \right]^{2}=\left( x-1 \right)^{2}$$\Rightarrow$$f'\left( x \right)\left[ \frac{1}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{4}}+\frac{2}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{3}}+\frac{1}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}} \right]=\left( x-1 \right)^{2}$
$\Rightarrow$$-\frac{1}{3\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{3}}-\frac{1}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}-\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=\frac{1}{3}\left( x-1 \right)^{3}+C$
Lại có: $f\left( 1 \right)=-1$$\Rightarrow$$C=\frac{1}{3}$$\Rightarrow$$-\frac{1}{3\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{3}}-\frac{1}{\left( f\left( x \right) \right)^{2}}-\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}=\frac{1}{3}\left( x-1 \right)^{3}+\frac{1}{3}$
$\Rightarrow$$\left[ \frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}+1 \right]^{3}=\left( 1-x \right)^{3}$$\Rightarrow$$\frac{1}{f\left( x \right)}+1=1-x$$\Rightarrow$$f\left( x \right)=-\frac{1}{x}$
$\Rightarrow$$\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( -\frac{1}{x} \right)dx=-\ln\left| x \right|\left| \begin{array}{l} 3 \\ 1 \end{array} \right.=-\ln 3$
Vậy $a=-1$; $b=0$$\Rightarrow$$S=a+b^{2}=-1$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $3f'\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)-x^{2}-1}-\frac{2x}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=0$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=1$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $3f'\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)-x^{2}-1}-\frac{2x}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=0\Leftrightarrow 3f'\left( x \right).\frac{e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}}{e^{x^{2}+1}}-\frac{2x}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=0$
$\Leftrightarrow 3f'\left( x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}-2x.e^{x^{2}+1}=0\Leftrightarrow 3f'\left( x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=2x.e^{x^{2}+1}$
$\Rightarrow\int 3f'\left( x \right).f^{2}\left( x \right).e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\int 2x.e^{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow\int \left( f^{3}\left( x \right) \right)^{\prime}.e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}\text{d}x=\int \left( x^{2}+1 \right)^{\prime}.e^{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow\int e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}\text{d}\left( f^{3}\left( x \right) \right)=\int e^{x^{2}+1}\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)$.
$\Leftrightarrow e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=e^{x^{2}+1}+C$.
Thay $x=0$ vào $\Leftrightarrow e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=e^{x^{2}+1}+C$ ta được $e^{f^{3}\left( 0 \right)}=e^{0^{2}+1}+C\Leftrightarrow C=0$.
Do đó $e^{f^{3}\left( x \right)}=e^{x^{2}+1}\Leftrightarrow f^{3}\left( x \right)=x^{2}+1\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}$.
Khi đó $\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} x.\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} \left( x^{2}+1 \right)^{\prime}.\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}\text{d}x$
$=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{7}} \sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1}\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)=\frac{3}{8}\left. \left( x^{2}+1 \right)\sqrt[3]{x^{2}+1} \right|_{0}^{\sqrt{7}}=\frac{48}{8}-\frac{3}{8}=\frac{45}{8}$.

loi: công thức hỏng hoặc có hình
noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$, đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ đi qua điểm $A\left( 1;0 \right)$ và nhận điểm $I\left( 2;2 \right)$ làm tâm đối xứng. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{1}^{3} x\left( x-2 \right)\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Cách 1.
Đặt $t=4-x\Rightarrow dt=-dx$.
Đồ thị hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$có $I\left( 2;2 \right)$ là tâm đối xứng nên $\frac{f\left( x \right)+f\left( 4-x \right)}{2}=2$.
Như vậy $f\left( x \right)+f\left( 4-x \right)=4\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)-f'\left( 4-x \right)=0\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=f'\left( 4-x \right),\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$.
Ta có $I=\int\limits_{1}^{3} x\left( x-2 \right)\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx$
$=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( 4-t \right)\left( 2-t \right)\left[ f\left( 4-t \right)+f'\left( 4-t \right) \right]dt$
$=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)\left[ 4-f\left( t \right)+f'\left( t \right) \right]dt$
$=\int\limits_{1}^{3} 4\left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)dt-\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left[ t^{2}-2t-4\left( t-2 \right) \right].\left[ f\left( t \right)+f'\left( t \right) \right]dt+\int\limits_{1}^{3} 2\left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)f'\left( t \right)dt$
$=2.\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)dt+\int\limits_{1}^{3} 2\left( t-2 \right)\left[ f\left( t \right)+f'\left( t \right) \right]dt+\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)f'\left( t \right)dt$
$=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( t^{2}-6t+8 \right)dt+\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( 2t-4 \right)f\left( t \right)dt+\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( t^{2}-4t+4 \right)f'\left( t \right)dt$
$=\left. \left( \frac{t^{3}}{3}-3t^{2}+8t \right) \right|_{1}^{3}+\left. \left( t^{2}-4t+4 \right)f\left( t \right) \right|_{1}^{3}=\frac{16}{3}$.
Cách 2. Chọn hàm $f\left( x \right)=a\left( x-2 \right)^{3}+2$.
[[img:image572.emf]]
Ta có $A\left( 1;0 \right)\in$đồ thị $\left( C \right):y=f\left( x \right)$.
Khi đó $a\left( -1 \right)^{3}+2=0\Leftrightarrow a=2\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=2\left( x-2 \right)^{3}+2$ và có $f'\left( x \right)=6\left( x-2 \right)^{2}$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{1}^{3} x\left( x-2 \right)\left[ f\left( x \right)+f'\left( x \right) \right]dx=\int\limits_{1}^{3} x\left( x-2 \right)\left[ 2\left( x-2 \right)^{3}+6\left( x-2 \right)^{2} \right]dx=\frac{16}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$, $f\left( x \right)>0$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$ và có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 1;4 \right]$, thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $\left[ 2f\left( x \right)+x.f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$. Khi đó $\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Vì $f\left( x \right)>0$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;4 \right]$ nên giả thiết $\left[ 2f\left( x \right)+x.f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}=\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x}$
$\Leftrightarrow 2f\left( x \right)+x.f'\left( x \right)=\frac{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}{\sqrt{x}}$
$\Leftrightarrow 2.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}+\frac{x.f'\left( x \right)}{\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( 2x \right)^{\prime}.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}+2x.\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{2\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left( 2x.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)} \right)^{\prime}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$
$\Leftrightarrow 2x.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}dx$
$\Leftrightarrow 2x.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}=2\sqrt{x}+C$
Vì $f\left( 1 \right)=1\Rightarrow 2.1.\sqrt{f\left( 1 \right)}=2\sqrt{1}+C\Rightarrow C=0$
Do đó $2x.\sqrt{f\left( x \right)}=2\sqrt{x}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{x}$.
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{4} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{4} \frac{1}{x}dx=\left. \left( \ln\left| x \right| \right) \right|_{1}^{4}=\ln 4=2\ln 2.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 0 \right)=3$ và $f\left( x \right)+f\left( 2-x \right)=x^{2}-2x+2$, $\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$. Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có: $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} x\text{d}\left( f\left( x \right) \right)=\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Do $f\left( x \right)+f\left( 2-x \right)=x^{2}-2x+2$, $\forall x\in\mathbb{R}$$\Rightarrow f\left( 0 \right)+f\left( 2 \right)=2$$\Rightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=2-f\left( 0 \right)=2-3=-1$
$\Rightarrow\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}=2\cdot f\left( 2 \right)-0\cdot f\left( 0 \right)=2\cdot\left( -1 \right)=-2$$\Rightarrow I=-2-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$
Đặt $t=2-x$$\Rightarrow\text{d}t=-\text{d}x$. Đổi cận $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=0\Rightarrow t=2 \\ x=2\Rightarrow t=0 \end{array} \right.$ $\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{2}^{0} f\left( 2-x \right)\left( -\text{d}x \right)=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x$$\Rightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ f\left( x \right)+f\left( 2-x \right) \right]\,\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2}-2x+2 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{x^{3}}{3}-x^{2}+2x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}=\frac{2^{3}}{3}-2^{2}+2\cdot 2=\frac{8}{3}$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{4}{3}$
Vậy $I=-2-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-2-\frac{4}{3}=-\frac{10}{3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f(x)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;3 \right]$thỏa mãn $f(3)=4,\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{1}{27}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{3}f(x)dx=\frac{333}{4}.$ Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{3} f(x)dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Xét: $\frac{333}{4}=\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{3}f(x)dx=\frac{x^{4}}{4}f(x)\left| {}_{0}^{3} \right.-\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}.f'\left( x \right)dx$ Vì $f(3)=4$ nên ta có:
$\frac{333}{4}=81-\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}.f'\left( x \right)dx\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}.f'\left( x \right)dx=-9$
Ta lại có $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{8}dx=\frac{x^{9}}{9}\left| {}_{0}^{3} \right.=3^{7}$.
Do đó: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ 9f'(x)+\frac{x^{4}}{27} \right]^{2}dx=81\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'(x) \right]^{2}dx+\frac{2}{3}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}f'(x)dx+\frac{1}{3^{6}}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{8}=\frac{81}{27}+\frac{2}{3}\left( -9 \right)+\frac{3^{7}}{3^{6}}=0$
Suy ra: $9f'(x)+\frac{x^{4}}{27}=0\Rightarrow f'(x)=-\frac{x^{4}}{3^{5}}\Rightarrow f(x)=-\frac{x^{5}}{5.3^{5}}+C$
Mà $f(3)=4\Rightarrow-\frac{3^{5}}{5.3^{5}}+C=4\Rightarrow C=\frac{21}{5}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{x^{5}}{5.3^{5}}+\frac{21}{5}\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( x \right)dx=\frac{25}{2}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f(x)$ xác định có đạo hàm liên tục trê $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f(0)=3$ và $f(x)+f(2-x)=x^{2}-2x+2,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.$ Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'(x)\mathrm{dx}$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có:
$f(x)+f(2-x)=x^{2}-2x+2,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.\Rightarrow f(0)+f(2)=2\Rightarrow f(2)=2-f(0)=2-3=-1$
Ta lại có $\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ f(x)+f(2-x) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2}-2x+2 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{8}{3}.$
Mà $I=\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left[ f(x)+f(2-x) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)dx+\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(2-x)\mathrm{d}x$
Xét$\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(2-x)\mathrm{d}\text{x}$
Đặt $t=2-x\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(2-x)\mathrm{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(t)\text{d}t\Rightarrow I=2\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x=\frac{8}{3}\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\text{d}x=\frac{4}{3}$
Xét $\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'(x)\mathrm{d}x=xf(x)\left| {}_{0}^{2} \right.-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\mathrm{d}x=2f(2)-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\mathrm{d}x==-2-\int\limits_{0}^{2} f(x)\mathrm{d}x=-2-\frac{4}{3}=-\frac{10}{3}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương, có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;2 \right]$. Biết $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ và $f\left( x \right)f\left( 2-x \right)=e^{2x^{2}-4x}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;2 \right]$. Tính tích phân $I=\int_{0}^{2} \frac{\left( x^{3}-3x^{2} \right)f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}dx$.
loi_giai:
Theo giả thiết, ta có $f\left( x \right).f\left( 2-x \right)=e^{2x^{2}-4x}$ và $f\left( x \right)$ nhận giá trị dương nên $\ln\left[ f\left( x \right).f\left( 2-x \right) \right]=\ln e^{2x^{2}-4x}\Leftrightarrow\ln f\left( x \right)+\ln f\left( 2-x \right)=2x^{2}-4x$.
Mặt khác, với $x=0$, ta có: $f\left( 0 \right).f\left( 2 \right)=1$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=1$ nên $f\left( 2 \right)=1$
Xét $I\,=\,\int\limits_{0}^{2} \frac{\left( x^{2}\,-\,3x^{2} \right)f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}x$, ta có $I\,=\,\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( x^{2}\,-\,3x^{2} \right)\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x^{3}-3x^{2} \\ \text{d}v=\frac{f'\left( x \right)}{f\left( x \right)}\text{d}x \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=\left( 3x^{2}-6x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=\ln f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$.
Suy ra $I=\left. \left[ \left( x^{3}-3x^{2} \right)\ln f\left( x \right) \right] \right|_{0}^{2}-\,\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3x^{2}\,-\,6x \right)\ln f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ $=\,-\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3x^{2}\,-\,6x \right)\ln f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ (1).
Đổi biến $x=2-t\Rightarrow dx=-dt$. Khi $x=0\Rightarrow t=2$ và $x=2\Rightarrow t=0$
Khi đó:
$I\,=\,-\int\limits_{2}^{0} \left( 3t^{2}-6t \right)\ln f\left( 2-t \right)\left( -\text{d}t \right)$$=\,-\,\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3t^{2}-6t \right)\ln f\left( 2-t \right)\text{d}t$ $=\,-\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3x^{2}-6x \right)\ln f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x$ (2).
Từ $\left( 1 \right)$ và $\left( 2 \right)$ ta cộng vế theo vế, ta được $2I=\,-\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3x^{2}\,-\,6x \right)\left[ \ln f\left( x \right)\,+\,\ln f\left( 2\,-\,x \right) \right]\text{d}x$
Hay$I=-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 3x^{2}\,-\,6x \right)\left( 2x^{2}\,-\,4x \right)\text{d}x$$=\,-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{2} \left( 6x^{4}\,-\,24x^{3}\,-\,24x^{2} \right)\text{d}x$$=\,-\frac{1}{2}\left. \left( \frac{6}{5}x^{5}\,-\,6x^{4}\,-\,8x^{3} \right) \right|_{0}^{2}\,=\,-\frac{16}{5}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$ thỏa mãn: $x^{2}.f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2x^{3}+x^{2}$, $\forall x>0$. Biết rằng $f\left( 1 \right)=0$. Tính giá trị của $f\left( \frac{1}{2} \right)$.
loi_giai:
Xét: $x^{2}.f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2x^{3}+x^{2}\Leftrightarrow\text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}.f'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{x^{2}}.\text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}.f\left( x \right)=\left( 2x+1 \right).\text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}$
$\Rightarrow\left. \left( \text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}.f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}=\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} \left( 2x+1 \right).\text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}\text{d}x=\int_{-2}^{-1} \left( \frac{-2}{x^{3}}+\frac{1}{x^{2}} \right).\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x=I$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\text{e}^{x}\Rightarrow\text{d}u=\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x \\ \text{d}v=\left( \frac{-2}{x^{3}}+\frac{1}{x^{2}} \right)\text{d}x,\,v=\frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{x} \end{array} \right.$, khi đó: $I=\left( \frac{2}{\text{e}}-\frac{3}{4\text{e}^{2}} \right)+\int_{-2}^{-1} \frac{1}{x}.\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x-\int_{-2}^{-1} \frac{1}{x^{2}}.\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$.
Đặt $I'=\int_{-2}^{-1} \frac{1}{x^{2}}.\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$, đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=\text{e}^{x}\Rightarrow\text{d}u=\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x \\ \text{d}v=\frac{1}{x^{2}}\text{d}x,\,v=\frac{-1}{x^{2}} \end{array} \right.$, khi đó: $I'=\frac{1}{\text{e}}-\frac{1}{2\text{e}^{2}}+\int_{-2}^{-1} \frac{1}{x}.\text{e}^{x}\text{d}x$.
Suy ra: $I=\frac{1}{\text{e}}-\frac{1}{4\text{e}^{2}}=\left. \left( \text{e}^{\frac{-1}{x}}.f\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}=\frac{-1}{\text{e}^{2}}.f\left( \frac{1}{2} \right)\Leftrightarrow f\left( \frac{1}{2} \right)=\frac{1}{4}-\text{e}$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\left[ -1;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)-1=\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( x+e^{t} \right)f\left( t \right)\text{d}t$. Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{x}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Từ $f\left( x \right)-1=\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( x+e^{t} \right)f\left( t \right)\text{d}t\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=x\int\limits_{-1}^{1} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t+\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{t}f\left( t \right)\text{d}t+1$, do đó $f\left( x \right)=ax+b$.
Suy ra $ax+b=x\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( at+b \right)\text{d}t+\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{t}\left( at+b \right)\text{d}t+1$. $\left( * \right)$
+ Tính $x\int\limits_{-1}^{1} \left( at+b \right)\text{d}t=x\left. \left( \frac{at^{2}}{2}+bt \right) \right|_{-1}^{1}=2bx$.
+ Tính $\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{t}\left( at+b \right)\text{d}t$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=at+b \\ \text{d}v=e^{t}\text{d}t \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=a\text{d}t \\ v=e^{t} \end{array} \right.$.
Do đó $\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{t}\left( at+b \right)\text{d}t=\left. e^{t}\left( at+b \right) \right|_{-1}^{1}-a\int\limits_{-1}^{1} e^{t}\text{d}t=\left. e^{t}\left( at+b-a \right) \right|_{-1}^{1}=be-\frac{1}{e}\left( -2a+b \right)$. $\left( ** \right)$
Thay vào $\left( * \right)$ ta được $ax+b=2bx+be-\frac{1}{e}\left( -2a+b \right)+1$.
Đồng nhất thức ta được $a=2b$ và $b=be+\frac{3b}{e}+1\Leftrightarrow b\left( 1-e-\frac{3}{e} \right)=1\Leftrightarrow b=\frac{e}{e-e^{2}-3}$.
Thay vào $\left( ** \right)$ ta có $I=be-\frac{1}{e}\left( -2a+b \right)=\frac{e}{e-e^{2}-3}\cdot e+\frac{1}{e}\cdot\frac{3e}{e-e^{2}-3}=\frac{e^{2}+3}{-e^{2}+e-3}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục và có đạo hàm trên $\left[ -2;2 \right]$ thoả mãn $\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left[ f^{2}\left( x \right)-2f\left( x \right)\left( x+2 \right) \right].\text{d}x=-\frac{64}{3}$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x$.
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left( x+2 \right)^{2}.\text{d}x=\frac{64}{3}$.
Suy ra $\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left[ f^{2}\left( x \right)-2f\left( x \right)\left( x+2 \right) \right].\text{d}x+\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left( x+2 \right)^{2}.\text{d}x=0$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left[ f^{2}\left( x \right)-2f\left( x \right)\left( x+2 \right)+\left( x+2 \right)^{2} \right].\text{d}x=0$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{-2}^{2} \left[ f\left( x \right)-\left( x+2 \right) \right]^{2}.\text{d}x=0$
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)-\left( x+2 \right)=0$
$\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=\left( x+2 \right)$.
Do đó $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x+2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x$$=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}\left( x^{2}+1 \right)+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x$
$=\frac{1}{2}\left. \ln\left( x^{2}+1 \right) \right|_{0}^{1}+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\ln 2+\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x$.
Xét $K=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x$.
Đặt $x=\tan t,t\in\left( -\frac{\pi}{2};\frac{\pi}{2} \right)\Rightarrow\text{d}x=\left( 1+\tan^{2}t \right)\text{d}t$.
Đổi cận $\left. x \right|_{0}^{1}\Rightarrow\left. t \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}$.
Ta có $K=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{2}{\tan^{2}t+1}\left( \tan^{2}t+1 \right).\text{d}t=2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \text{d}t=2\left. t \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{\pi}{2}$.
Vậy $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}+1}.\text{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\ln 2+\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{\pi+\ln 2}{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=5$, $\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=10$. Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos x\,f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( 2x \right)\text{d}x=10$
Đặt $2x=t\Rightarrow 2\text{d }x=\text{d t}$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{1}{4}}^{\frac{1}{2}} f\left( 2x \right)\,\text{d }x=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t=10$$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t=\int\limits_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=20$.
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x=25$.
$I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos x\,f\left( \sin x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $\sin x=t$$\Rightarrow\cos x\,\text{d}x=\text{d }t$$\Rightarrow I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( t \right)\,\text{d}t$$=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$$=25$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x.f'\left( 2x-4 \right)dx=8;\,\,\,f\left( 2 \right)=2$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{-2}^{1} f\left( 2x \right)dx$.
loi_giai:
Xét $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x.f'\left( 2x-4 \right)dx=8\,\,\,\,\,\left( * \right)$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x \\ dv=f'\left( 2x-4 \right)dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=dx \\ v=\frac{1}{2}f\left( 2x-4 \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\begin{array}{l} \left( * \right)\Leftrightarrow\left. \frac{1}{2}xf\left( 2x-4 \right) \right|_{0}^{3}-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( 2x-4 \right)dx=8 \\ \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\Leftrightarrow\frac{3}{2}f\left( 2 \right)-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( 2x-4 \right)dx=8 \\ \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} f\left( 2x-4 \right)dx=-10\,. \end{array}$
Đặt $2t=2x-4\,\,\,\Rightarrow dt=dx$
$x$
$0$
$3$
$t$
$-2$
$1$
Suy ra: $\int\limits_{-2}^{1} f\left( 2t \right)dt=-10$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục và dương trên $\left( 0;+\infty \right)$, thỏa mãn $3xf\left( x \right)=x^{2}f'\left( x \right)+2f^{2}\left( x \right),\forall x>0$ và $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{1}{2}$. Giá trị của tích phân $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}dx$
loi_giai:
Ta có $3xf\left( x \right)=x^{2}f'\left( x \right)+2f^{2}\left( x \right),\forall x>0$
$\Leftrightarrow 3x^{2}f\left( x \right)-x^{3}f'\left( x \right)=2xf^{2}\left( x \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow\frac{3x^{2}f\left( x \right)-x^{3}f'\left( x \right)}{f^{2}\left( x \right)}=2x\Rightarrow\left( \frac{x^{3}}{f\left( x \right)} \right)^{\prime}=2x\Rightarrow\frac{x^{3}}{f\left( x \right)}=x^{2}+C$.
Thay $x=0$ ta được $\frac{1}{f\left( 1 \right)}=1+C\Leftrightarrow 2=1+C\Leftrightarrow C=1\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{3}}{x^{2}+1}\Rightarrow\frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}=\frac{x}{x^{2}+1}$.
Khi đó $\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{x}{x^{2}+1}dx$. Đặt $t=x^{2}+1\Rightarrow dx=2xdx\Leftrightarrow xdx=\frac{1}{2}dt$.
Đổi cận $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x=1\Rightarrow t=2 \\ x=2\Rightarrow t=5 \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{2} \frac{f\left( x \right)}{x^{2}}dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{2}^{5} \frac{1}{t}dt=\frac{1}{2}\left. \left( \ln\left| t \right| \right) \right|_{2}^{5}=\frac{1}{2}.\ln\frac{5}{2}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ và thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{5}$, $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x=\frac{4}{9}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{37}{180}$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ v'=x^{3} \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u'=f'\left( x \right) \\ v=\frac{x^{4}}{4} \end{array} \right.$, suy ra:
$\frac{37}{180}=\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{3}f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\left. \frac{x^{4}}{4}f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{1}-\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{37}{180}=\frac{1}{4}f\left( 1 \right)-\frac{1}{4}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{2}{9}$.
Mặt khác ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4x^{8}\text{d}x=\left. \frac{4}{9}x^{9} \right|_{0}^{1}=\frac{4}{9}$.
Suy ra: $\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}\text{d}x+4\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{4}f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{1} 4x^{8}\text{d}x=\frac{4}{9}-\frac{8}{9}+\frac{4}{9}=0$
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left[ f'\left( x \right)+2x^{4} \right]^{2}\text{d}x=0$$\Rightarrow f'\left( x \right)=-2x^{4}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{2}{5}x^{5}+C$.
Mặt khác $f\left( 1 \right)=\frac{3}{5}$$\Leftrightarrow\frac{3}{5}=-\frac{2}{5}+C\Leftrightarrow C=1\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-\frac{2}{5}x^{5}+1$.
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left( -\frac{2}{5}x^{5}+1 \right)\text{d}x=\frac{14}{15}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0 \right\}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=0,f\left( x \right)\ne\frac{1}{x}$ và $x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)-\left( 2x+1 \right)f\left( x \right)=xf'\left( x \right)-1\,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}\backslash\left\{ 0 \right\}$. Tính $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx$
loi_giai:
Ta có $x^{2}f^{2}\left( x \right)-\left( 2x+1 \right)f\left( x \right)=xf'\left( x \right)-1\,$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ xf\left( x \right) \right]^{2}-2xf\left( x \right)+1=f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{2}=f\left( x \right)+xf'\left( x \right)=\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{\prime}$, với $f\left( x \right)\ne\frac{1}{x}$
$\Rightarrow\frac{\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{\prime}}{\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{{}^{2}}}=1$$\Rightarrow\int dx=\int \frac{d\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]}{\left[ xf\left( x \right)-1 \right]^{2}}=-\frac{1}{xf\left( x \right)-1}+C$
$\Rightarrow x=\frac{1}{1-xf\left( x \right)}+C$, với $f\left( 1 \right)=0,f\left( x \right)\ne\frac{1}{x}$, suy ra $C=0\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^{2}}.$
Khi đó $I=\int\limits_{1}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\int\limits_{1}^{2} \left( \frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^{2}} \right)dx=\left. \left( \ln x+\frac{1}{x} \right) \right|_{1}^{2}=\ln 2-\frac{1}{2}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f\left( x \right)+f\left( \frac{\pi}{2}-x \right)=\sin x.\cos x$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$ và $f\left( 0 \right)=0$. Giá trị của tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} x.f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Thay $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ vào đẳng thức $f\left( x \right)+f\left( \frac{\pi}{2}-x \right)=\sin x.\cos x$$\Rightarrow f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)+f\left( 0 \right)=0\Leftrightarrow f\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=0$.
Xét $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} x.f'\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\, \\ dv=f'\left( x \right)dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=dx\,\,\, \\ v=f\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow I=\left. x.f\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx=-\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx$$\left( 1 \right)$
Lại có: $\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx+\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( \frac{\pi}{2}-x \right)\,dx=\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin x.\cos x\,dx$
$\Leftrightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin 2x\,dx$$\Leftrightarrow 2\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx=\frac{1}{2}\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f\left( x \right)\,dx=\frac{1}{4}$.
Vậy $I=-\frac{1}{4}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $y=f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\left[ 1;3 \right]$, biết $f\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $f\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right)+x-4=\left( x-2 \right)f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)$ với $\forall x\in\left[ 1;3 \right]$. Biết $\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\frac{a}{b}+2\sqrt{c}$ (với $a,b,c$ là các số nguyên dương, $\frac{a}{b}$ là phân số tối giản). Khi đó, tổng $a+b+c$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( x \right).f'\left( x \right)+x-4=\left( x-2 \right)f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)$
$\Rightarrow\int f\left( x \right)f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+\int \left( x-4 \right)\text{d}x=\int \left[ \left( x-2 \right)f'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x$
$\Rightarrow\frac{f^{2}\left( x \right)}{2}+\frac{x^{2}}{2}-4x=\left( x-2 \right)f\left( x \right)+C$.
Theo bài, $f\left( 1 \right)=1\Rightarrow\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2}-4=-1+C\Leftrightarrow C=-2$.
Khi đó, $\frac{f^{2}\left( x \right)}{2}+\frac{x^{2}}{2}-4x=\left( x-2 \right)f\left( x \right)-2\Leftrightarrow\left[ f\left( x \right)-\left( x-2 \right) \right]^{2}=4x\Leftrightarrow f\left( x \right)=2\sqrt{x}+x-2$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{1}^{3} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{3} \left( 2\sqrt{x}+x-2 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{4}{3}\sqrt[]{x^{3}}+\frac{x^{2}}{2}-2x \right) \right|_{1}^{3}=-\frac{4}{3}+4\sqrt{3}$.
Do đó, $a=4,\,\,b=3,\,\,c=12$.
Vậy $a+b+c=4+3+12=19$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;3 \right]$thỏa mãn $f\left( 3 \right)=14$, $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx=\frac{2187}{20}$ và $\int\limits_{0}^{3} xf\left( x \right)dx=\frac{531}{20}$. Giá trị của $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f\left( x \right)-1 \right]\text{ }dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $\int\limits_{0}^{3} xf\left( x \right)dx=\frac{531}{20}$
$\Leftrightarrow\frac{x^{2}}{2}f\left( x \right)\left| \begin{array}{l} {}^{3} \\ {}_{0} \end{array} \right.-\int\limits_{0}^{3} \frac{x^{2}}{2}f'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{531}{20}\Leftrightarrow 63-\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{531}{20}\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{729}{10}$
Ta có: $\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}dx=\frac{243}{5}$
Tìm k sao cho $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-kx^{2} \right]^{2}dx=0$
$\begin{array}{l} \Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right) \right]^{2}dx-2k\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{2}f'\left( x \right)dx+k^{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x^{4}dx=0\Leftrightarrow\frac{2187}{20}-2k.\frac{729}{10}+k^{2}.\frac{243}{5}=0 \\ \Leftrightarrow 972k^{2}-2916k+2187=0\Leftrightarrow k=\frac{3}{2} \end{array}$
$\Rightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f'\left( x \right)-\frac{3}{2}x^{2} \right]^{2}dx=0\Leftrightarrow f'\left( x \right)=\frac{3}{2}x^{2}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{3}}{2}+C$
Ta có $f\left( 3 \right)=14\Rightarrow C=\frac{1}{2}\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=\frac{x^{3}}{2}+\frac{1}{2}$
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left[ f\left( x \right)-1 \right]\text{ }dx=\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( \frac{x^{3}}{2}+\frac{1}{2}-1 \right)\text{ }dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left( x^{3}-1 \right)dx=\frac{69}{8}$

noi_dung: Cho hai hàm $f\left( x \right)$ và $g\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm trên $\left[ 1;2021 \right],$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 2021 \right)=g\left( 2021 \right)=0$, $\frac{x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}g\left( x \right)+2020x=\left( x+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)$ và $\frac{x^{3}}{x+1}g'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2021x^{2}$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 1;2021 \right]$. Tích phân $\int\limits_{1}^{2021} \left[ \frac{x}{x+1}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $\frac{x}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}g\left( x \right)+2020x=\left( x+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)\Rightarrow\frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f'\left( x \right)=-2020$ (1).
Mặt khác $\frac{x^{3}}{x+1}g'\left( x \right)+f\left( x \right)=2021x^{2}\Rightarrow\frac{x}{x+1}g'\left( x \right)+\frac{1}{x^{2}}f\left( x \right)=2021$ (2).
Cộng vế theo vế (1) và (2), ta được $\left[ \frac{1}{\left( x+1 \right)^{2}}g\left( x \right)+\frac{x}{x+1}g'\left( x \right) \right]-\left[ \frac{x+1}{x}f'\left( x \right)-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f\left( x \right) \right]=1$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \frac{x}{x+1}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=1$ (*).
Lấy nguyên hàm hai vế (*), ta được $\frac{x}{x+1}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f\left( x \right)=x+C$
Vì $f\left( 2021 \right)=g\left( 2021 \right)=0$ nên $0=2021+C\Leftrightarrow C=-2021.$
Suy ra $\frac{x}{x+1}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f\left( x \right)=x-2021.$
Vậy $\int\limits_{1}^{2021} \left[ \frac{x}{x+1}g\left( x \right)-\frac{x+1}{x}f\left( x \right) \right]\text{d}x=\int\limits_{1}^{2021} \left( x-2021 \right)\text{d}x=\left. \left( \frac{1}{2}x^{2}-2021x \right) \right|_{1}^{2021}$
$=-\frac{1}{2}.2021^{2}+2021-\frac{1}{2}.$

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm cấp 2 liên tục trên đoạn $\left[ 0;1 \right]$ thỏa mãn $f\left( 1 \right)=0;f'\left( 1 \right)=1$ và $10f\left( x \right)-5xf'\left( x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=0\,$với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]$. Khi đó tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx$bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $10f\left( x \right)-5xf'\left( x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=0\,$ với mọi $x\in\left[ 0;1 \right]$.
$\Leftrightarrow\int\limits_{0}^{1} 10f\left( x \right)dx-\int\limits_{0}^{1} 5xf'\left( x \right)dx+\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx=0$
Đặt $I=\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx$, theo phương pháp tích phân từng phần, ta được:
$\begin{array}{l} \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)dx=xf\left( x \right)|_{0}^{1}-\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=-I \\ \int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx=x^{2}f'\left( x \right)|_{0}^{1}-2\int\limits_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)dx=1-2\left( -I \right)=1+2I \end{array} \right. \\ \Rightarrow 10I-5\left( -I \right)+1+2I=0\Leftrightarrow I=-\frac{1}{17} \end{array}$
Vậy $\int\limits_{0}^{1} f\left( x \right)dx=-\frac{1}{17}$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)=\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x^{2}-3x\;\;\text{khi}\;\;x\le 8 \\ \frac{40}{x-7}\;\;\;\;\,\text{khi}\;\;\;x>8 \end{array} \right.$. Tích phân $I=\int\limits_{e^{2}}^{e^{4}} \frac{f\left( \ln^{2}x \right)}{x\ln x}dx$ bằng
loi_giai:
Đặt: $t=\ln^{2}x\Rightarrow dt=2\frac{\ln x}{x}dx$.
Đổi cận: $x=e^{2}\Rightarrow t=4\;;\;\;x=e^{4}\Rightarrow t=16$.
Ta có: $I=\int\limits_{e^{2}}^{e^{4}} \frac{f\left( \ln^{2}x \right)}{x\ln x}dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{e^{2}}^{e^{4}} \frac{2\ln x.f\left( \ln^{2}x \right)}{x\ln^{2}x}dx=\frac{1}{2}\int\limits_{4}^{16} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt=\frac{1}{2}\left( \int\limits_{4}^{8} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt+\int\limits_{8}^{16} \frac{f\left( t \right)}{t}dt \right)$
$=\frac{1}{2}\left( \int\limits_{4}^{8} \frac{t^{2}-3t}{t}dt+\int\limits_{8}^{16} \frac{40}{t\left( t-7 \right)}dt \right)=\frac{1}{2}\left( \int\limits_{4}^{8} \left( t-3 \right)dt+\int\limits_{8}^{16} \left( \frac{40}{7}.\frac{1}{t-7}-\frac{40}{7}.\frac{1}{t} \right)dt \right)$
$=\frac{1}{2}\left. \left( \frac{t^{2}}{2}-3t \right) \right|_{4}^{8}+\frac{1}{2}\left. \left( \frac{40}{7}.\ln\left| t-7 \right|-\frac{40}{7}\ln\left| t \right| \right) \right|_{8}^{16}$
$=\frac{1}{2}\left( 24-12 \right)+\frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{40}{7}\ln 9-\frac{40}{7}\ln 2 \right)$
$=6+\frac{40}{7}\ln 3-\frac{20}{7}\ln 2$.

noi_dung: Cho hàm số $f\left( x \right)$ có đạo hàm liên tục trên $\mathbb{R}$ và thỏa mãn các điều kiện sau: $f\left( 0 \right)=-2$ và $\left( x^{2}+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)+xf\left( x \right)=-x,\forall x\in\mathbb{R}.$ Tính tích phân $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} xf\left( x \right)\,\text{d}x$
loi_giai:
$\left( x^{2}+1 \right)f'\left( x \right)+xf\left( x \right)=-x\Leftrightarrow\sqrt{x^{2}+1}.f'\left( x \right)+\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}f\left( x \right)=-\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}$
$\Leftrightarrow\left[ \sqrt{x^{2}+1}.f\left( x \right) \right]^{\prime}=-\left( \sqrt{x^{2}+1} \right)^{\prime}\Rightarrow\sqrt{x^{2}+1}.f\left( x \right)=-\sqrt{x^{2}+1}+C$
Mà $f\left( 0 \right)=-2$ nên $C=-1\Rightarrow f\left( x \right)=-1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}}$
Khi đó $I=\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \left( -x-\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+1}} \right)\,\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} x\,\text{d}x-\int\limits_{0}^{\sqrt{3}} \text{d}\left( \sqrt{x^{2}+1} \right)$
$\Leftrightarrow I=\left. \left( -\frac{x^{2}}{2}-\sqrt{x^{2}+1} \right) \right|_{0}^{\sqrt{3}}=-\frac{5}{2}$

noi_dung: Giả sử hàm số $f$ có đạo hàm đến cấp hai trên $\mathbb{R}$ thỏa mãn $f'\left( 2 \right)=2$ và $f\left( 2-x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=2x$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị tích phân $\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng:
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( 2-x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=2x$$\Rightarrow$$f\left( 2 \right)=0$
Lại có: $\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x+\int\limits_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\int\limits_{0}^{2} 2x\text{d}x=x^{2}\left| \begin{array}{l} 2 \\ 0 \end{array} \right.=4$
Xét $I_{1}=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $2-x=t$$\Rightarrow$$\text{d}x=-\text{d}t$
Với $x=0$$\Rightarrow$$t=2$
$x=2$$\Rightarrow$$t=0$
$\Rightarrow$$I_{1}=-\int\limits_{2}^{0} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( t \right)\text{d}t=\int\limits_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=f\left( x \right) \\ \text{d}v=\text{d}x \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow$$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x \\ v=x \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow$$I_{1}=\left. \left( xf\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( 2 \right)-\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=-\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Xét $I_{2}=\int\limits_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x^{2} \\ \text{d}v=f''\left( x \right)\text{d}x \end{array} \right.$$\Rightarrow$$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \text{d}u=2x\text{d}x \\ v=f'\left( x \right) \end{array} \right.$
$\Rightarrow$$I_{2}=\left. \left( x^{2}f'\left( x \right) \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int\limits_{0}^{2} 2xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=4f'\left( 2 \right)-2\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=8-2\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$
Vậy $-\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x+8-2\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=4$$\Rightarrow$$\int\limits_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=\frac{4}{3}$.

noi_dung: Giả sử hàm số $f$ có đạo hàm đến cấp hai trên $\mathbb{R}$, thỏa mãn $f'\left( 2 \right)=2$ và $f\left( 2-x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=2x$ với mọi $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Giá trị của tích phân $\int_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có: $f\left( 2-x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right)=2x$.
Cho $x=0\Rightarrow f\left( 2 \right)=0.$
Khi đó: $\int_{0}^{2} \left( f\left( 2-x \right)+x^{2}f''\left( x \right) \right)dx=\int_{0}^{2} 2xdx=4$
$\Rightarrow\int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx+\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx=4$
Đặt $I_{1}=\int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx$; $I_{2}=\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx.$
Xét $I_{1}=\int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx$
Đặt $t=2-x\Rightarrow dx=-dt.$
Đổi cận:
$x$
$0$
$2$
$t$
$2$
$0$
$I_{1}=\int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx=\int_{0}^{2} f\left( t \right)dt.=\int_{0}^{2} f\left( x \right)dx=\left. xf\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-\int_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)dx=2f\left( 2 \right)-\int_{0}^{2} xf'\left( x \right)dx$
Xét $I_{2}=\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx$
Đặt $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} u=x^{2} \\ dv=f''\left( x \right)dx \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} du=2xdx \\ v=f'\left( x \right) \end{array} \right..$
Khi đó $I_{2}=\left. x^{2}f'\left( x \right) \right|_{0}^{2}-2\int_{0}^{2} x.f'\left( x \right)dx=8-2\int_{0}^{2} x.f'\left( x \right)dx$
$\begin{array}{l} \int_{0}^{2} f\left( 2-x \right)dx+\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}f''\left( x \right)dx=4 \\ \Rightarrow 8-3\int_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)dx=4 \\ \Rightarrow\int_{0}^{1} xf'\left( x \right)dx=\frac{4}{3}. \end{array}$

noi_dung: Cho $a,b,c$ là các số thực và $f\left( x \right)=x^{3}+ax^{2}+bx+c$ thỏa mãn $f'\left( t \right)=f'\left( t+5 \right)=2$ với $t$ là hằng số. Giá trị $\int\limits_{t}^{t+5} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x$ bằng
loi_giai:
Ta có $f'\left( x \right)=3x^{2}+2ax+b$. Vì $f'\left( t \right)=f'\left( t+5 \right)=2$ nên $t$ và $t+5$ là hai nghiệm của phương trình $f'\left( x \right)-2=0\Leftrightarrow 3x^{2}+2ax+b-2=0$.
Theo Viet ta có $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} t+t+5=-\frac{2a}{3} \\ t\left( t+5 \right)=\frac{b-2}{3} \end{array} \right.\Rightarrow\left\{ \begin{array}{l} a=-\frac{3}{2}\left( 2t+5 \right) \\ b=3\left( t^{2}+5t \right)+2 \end{array} \right.$.
Do đó
$I=\int\limits_{t}^{t+5} f'\left( x \right)\text{d}x=f\left( t+5 \right)-f\left( t \right)=\left[ \left( t+5 \right)^{3}-t^{3} \right]+a\left[ \left( t+5 \right)^{2}-t^{2} \right]+b\left[ \left( t+5 \right)-t \right]$
$=\left[ \left( t+5-t \right)^{3}+3t\left( t+5 \right)\left( t+5-t \right) \right]+a.5.\left( 2t+5 \right)+5b$
$=125+15\left( t^{2}+5t \right)-\frac{15}{2}\left( 2t+5 \right)^{2}+5\left[ 3\left( t^{2}+5t \right)+2 \right]$
$=135+30\left( t^{2}+5t \right)-\frac{15}{2}\left( 4t^{2}+20t+25 \right)=-\frac{105}{2}$.
